phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам также нужно установить время, когда пациента в последний раз видели в нормальном состоянии.

phrasebook.translation_uz: Reperfuzion davolashga qarshi ko'rsatmalar bor-yo'qligini aniqlashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нужно выяснить, есть ли противопоказания к реперфузионной терапии.

phrasebook.phrase: The stroke team will assess whether thrombolysis or mechanical thrombectomy is appropriate.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Insult jamoasi tromboliz yoki mexanik trombektomiya mos keladimi, baholaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Инсультная команда оценит, подходит ли тромболизис или механическая тромбэктомия.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Discuss possible treatment without promising it.

phrasebook.phrase: The management would be completely different.

phrasebook.phrase: We are moving quickly because every minute can matter in acute stroke.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz tez harakat qilyapmiz, chunki o'tkir insultda har bir daqiqa muhim bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы действуем быстро, потому что при остром инсульте каждая минута может иметь значение.

grammar.title: Grammar focus: Past Simple + Time Expressions
grammar.title_en: Grammar focus: Past Simple + Time Expressions
grammar.title_uz: Modul grammatikasi: Past Simple + Time Expressions
grammar.title_ru: Грамматика модуля: Past Simple + Time Expressions
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V2 (V-ed) | Did + subject + V1? | was / were | since + starting point (since yesterday) | for + period (for three days) | period + ago (two hours ago)
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu modulda Past Simple o'tkir voqeaning ketma-ketligini, simptomlarning qachon boshlanganini va aniq vaqtga bog'langan klinik voqealarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Time expressions esa tarixni aniq timeline ko'rinishida tuzishga yordam beradi. Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Simple используется для завершённых событий в прошлом. В этом диалоге он особенно важен, потому что врач восстанавливает точную временную последовательность начала инсульта. Главное: при остром инсульте пациент должен уметь рассказать события в правильной временной последовательности. Поэтому Past Simple + time expressions являются центральным языковым инструментом этого модуля. Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. "Since" gives the starting point ("since yesterday"), "for" the length of time ("for three days") and "ago" counts back from now ("two hours ago"). Exact times ("at about 7:15 this morning") are essential in time-critical conditions such as stroke. Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when

grammar.title: Past Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Positive: subject + V2 | Negative: subject + did not + V1 | Question: Did + subject + V1...? | Wh-Question: What/When + did + subject + V1...?
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Simple o'tmishda aniq vaqtda tugagan voqealarni bildiradi: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Vaqt tugagan yoki aniq ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa shu zamon ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Simple описывает завершённые события в определённое время в прошлом: «The pain started yesterday», «When did you take the last dose?». Используется, когда время закончилось или названо. Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: A sudden completed change in the past. Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.

grammar.title: Sequencing a Clinical Event
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Acute history-takingda Past Simple ko'pincha voqealarni ketma-ket joylashtirish uchun ishlatiladi: Bu usul talabaga faqat grammar emas, balki klinik timeline tuzishni ham o'rgatadi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: При сборе анамнеза острого состояния Past Simple часто используется, чтобы выстроить события по порядку. Такой подход учит студента не только грамматике, но и построению клинической хронологии.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: In acute history-taking, Past Simple is often used to put events in order. This approach teaches the student not only grammar but also how to build a clinical timeline.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I noticed something was wrong at about 7:15 this morning while I was having breakfast.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What was the first symptom?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: My right hand suddenly became weak. I dropped my cup and couldn't pick it up again.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What happened after that?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: A few minutes later, I tried to speak to my wife, but my words came out strangely.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you understand what your wife was saying to you?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I understood everything, but I couldn't express myself properly.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you have any difficulty walking?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. When I stood up, my right leg felt weak and I nearly fell.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you lose consciousness at any stage?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I remained conscious throughout.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you develop a sudden severe headache?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you notice any visual disturbance?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: My vision became blurred for a few minutes, but then it improved.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What time did the ambulance arrive?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: At approximately 7:45.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good. The exact time of symptom onset is crucial because some stroke treatments are time-dependent.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is it possible to treat the blockage?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Potentially, yes. First we need urgent brain imaging to determine whether this is an ischemic stroke or a haemorrhage.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'll arrange immediate transfer for CT imaging and continue neurological observations.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We also need to establish the last-known-well time and confirm whether there are any contraindications to reperfusion therapy.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What happens if the scan shows a blood clot?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If it confirms an eligible ischemic stroke, the stroke team will assess whether thrombolysis or mechanical thrombectomy is appropriate.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: And if there is bleeding?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: The management would be completely different, which is why imaging must be obtained before we make that decision.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand. I just want to know what we can do.

questions_to_ask_doctor: Is it possible to treat the blockage?
What happens if the scan shows a blood clot?
And if there is bleeding?

modules.description_en: Clinical communication module: Severe Infection & Sepsis Assessment. Grammar focus: Passive Voice + Present Perfect Continuous. Includes a reference doctor–patient dialogue, 48 vocabulary items, 19 smart phrases, 5 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: How long have you been feeling unwell?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've been feeling progressively weaker for about two days. I've also been having repeated episodes of fever and chills.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you been coughing or experiencing any urinary symptoms?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've had a cough with yellow sputum, and I've been feeling short of breath.

dialogue.label: Relative
dialogue.text: He became much more confused this morning and almost fainted when he stood up.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: His temperature is 39.2°C, blood pressure is 88 over 54, pulse 122, respiratory rate 28, and oxygen saturation is 90% on room air.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Thank you. These observations are concerning. Have you been treated for an infection recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I was treated for a chest infection last week.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Were antibiotics prescribed?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes, but I stopped them after three days because I started feeling better.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. At the moment, we need to consider a severe systemic infection and possible sepsis.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Is sepsis life-threatening?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It can be. The important thing is that it is recognised and treated promptly.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started, provided this does not cause a significant delay.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Exactly. Blood samples will be taken for cultures, full blood count, renal function, electrolytes, lactate, and other relevant tests.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will I need oxygen?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Your oxygen saturation is low, so supplemental oxygen will be given and your response will be monitored closely.

dialogue.label: Relative
dialogue.text: Does he need to go to intensive care?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We'll assess his response to initial treatment. If his blood pressure remains low or organ dysfunction develops, higher-level care may be required.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Intravenous access has been established. I'm preparing the prescribed fluids and medications.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. Appropriate antimicrobial treatment should be started promptly if a serious bacterial infection is suspected.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will the doctors know which antibiotic is best immediately?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Not always. Treatment may begin empirically and then be adjusted when culture results identify the organism and its sensitivities.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I expect over the next few hours?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Your blood pressure, urine output, oxygenation, mental state, and laboratory markers will be monitored closely. We'll reassess you repeatedly rather than relying on a single measurement.

dialogue.label: Relative
dialogue.text: So the situation is serious, but you are treating it now?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. The priority is to control the infection, support your vital organs, and identify the source as quickly as possible.

phrasebook.phrase: How long have you been feeling unwell?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qancha vaqtdan beri o'zingizni yomon his qilyapsiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как долго вы плохо себя чувствуете?
phrasebook.clinical_use: Obtain the duration of the patient's current illness.

phrasebook.phrase: I've been feeling progressively weaker for about two days.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Taxminan ikki kundan beri tobora kuchsizlanib boryapman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я чувствую себя всё слабее уже около двух дней.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Describe a symptom that has been continuing over time.

phrasebook.phrase: I've also been having repeated episodes of fever and chills.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Menda isitma va titroq xurujlari ham takrorlanmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У меня также повторяются приступы жара и озноба.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you been coughing or experiencing any urinary symptoms?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yo'tal yoki siydik chiqarish bilan bog'liq simptomlar bo'lyaptimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас был кашель или какие-либо мочевые симптомы?
phrasebook.clinical_use: Screen for possible respiratory or urinary sources of infection.

phrasebook.phrase: These observations are concerning.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Эти показатели вызывают беспокойство.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Communicate that the clinical observations suggest serious illness.

phrasebook.phrase: At the moment, we need to consider a severe systemic infection and possible sepsis.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hozir biz og'ir tizimli infeksiya va ehtimoliy sepsisni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: На данный момент нам необходимо рассмотреть тяжёлую системную инфекцию и возможный сепсис.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain the working clinical assessment without presenting it as a confirmed diagnosis.

phrasebook.phrase: Is sepsis life-threatening?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сепсис опасен для жизни?
phrasebook.clinical_use: Ask about the seriousness of the condition.

phrasebook.phrase: The important thing is that it is recognised and treated promptly.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Muhimi, bu holat tezda aniqlanib, davolanishidir.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Важно, чтобы это состояние было быстро распознано и пролечено.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain why early recognition and treatment matter.

phrasebook.phrase: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started, provided this does not cause a significant delay.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar bu sezilarli kechikishga olib kelmasa, antibiotiklar boshlanishidan oldin qon kulturasi olinishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Посев крови можно взять до начала антибиотиков, если это не вызовет значительной задержки.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain the timing of microbiological investigation.

phrasebook.phrase: Blood samples will be taken for cultures, full blood count, renal function, electrolytes, lactate, and other relevant tests.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kultura, umumiy qon tahlili, buyrak faoliyati, elektrolitlar, laktat va boshqa tegishli tekshiruvlar uchun qon namunalari olinadi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Будут взяты образцы крови для посева, общего анализа крови, оценки функции почек, электролитов, лактата и других необходимых исследований.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain the planned investigations using clinical passive voice.

phrasebook.phrase: Your oxygen saturation is low, so supplemental oxygen will be given and your response will be monitored closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kislorod saturatsiyangiz past, shuning uchun qo'shimcha kislorod beriladi va javobingiz yaqindan kuzatiladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваша сатурация кислорода низкая, поэтому будет назначен дополнительный кислород, а ваша реакция будет тщательно контролироваться.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll assess his response to initial treatment.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz uning boshlang'ich davolashga javobini baholaymiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы оценим его реакцию на первоначальное лечение.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain how treatment response will guide the next decision.

phrasebook.phrase: If his blood pressure remains low or organ dysfunction develops, higher-level care may be required.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar uning qon bosimi pastligicha qolsa yoki a'zolar faoliyati buzilsa, yuqori darajadagi tibbiy yordam talab qilinishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если его давление останется низким или разовьётся нарушение функции органов, может потребоваться помощь более высокого уровня.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain when escalation of care may become necessary.

phrasebook.phrase: Intravenous access has been established.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Венозный доступ уже установлен.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Report that IV access has already been established.

phrasebook.phrase: Appropriate antimicrobial treatment should be started promptly if a serious bacterial infection is suspected.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar jiddiy bakterial infeksiyaga shubha qilinsa, tegishli antimikrob davolash tezda boshlanishi kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: При подозрении на серьёзную бактериальную инфекцию соответствующее антимикробное лечение следует начать незамедлительно.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain the need for prompt antimicrobial treatment.

phrasebook.phrase: Treatment may begin empirically and then be adjusted when culture results identify the organism and its sensitivities.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Davolash empirik tarzda boshlanishi, keyin esa kultura natijalari mikroorganizm va uning sezuvchanligini ko'rsatgach o'zgartirilishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Лечение может быть начато эмпирически, а затем скорректировано после определения микроорганизма и его чувствительности по результатам посева.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain how treatment can change after microbiological results.

phrasebook.phrase: Your blood pressure, urine output, oxygenation, mental state, and laboratory markers will be monitored closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon bosimingiz, siydik chiqishi, kislorodlanish, ong holatingiz va laborator ko'rsatkichlaringiz yaqindan kuzatiladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваше давление, диурез, оксигенация, психическое состояние и лабораторные показатели будут тщательно контролироваться.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain ongoing monitoring for deterioration or response.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll reassess you repeatedly rather than relying on a single measurement.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bitta o'lchovga tayanmasdan, sizni qayta-qayta baholaymiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы будем неоднократно оценивать ваше состояние, а не полагаться на одно измерение.

phrasebook.phrase: The priority is to control the infection, support your vital organs, and identify the source as quickly as possible.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Asosiy maqsad infeksiyani nazorat qilish, hayotiy muhim a'zolaringizni qo'llab-quvvatlash va manbani imkon qadar tez aniqlashdir.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Главная задача — контролировать инфекцию, поддерживать жизненно важные органы и как можно быстрее определить источник.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Summarise the immediate priorities of management.

grammar.title: Grammar focus: Passive Voice + Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.title_en: Grammar focus: Passive Voice + Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.title_uz: Modul grammatikasi: Passive Voice + Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.title_ru: Грамматика модуля: Passive Voice + Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: be (am/is/are/was/were/will be/has been) + V3 | modal + be + V3 | have / has + been + V-ing
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect Continuous — o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayonni bildiradi. Ayniqsa simptomlarning qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini aytishda foydali. Passive Voice — ish-harakatni kim bajarganidan ko'ra, bajarilayotgan ish yoki tibbiy jarayon muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Bu modulda Present Perfect Continuous bemorning ma'lum vaqt davomida davom etib kelayotgan simptomlari va holatini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Passive Voice esa klinik jarayonlarda kim ishni bajarayotganidan ko'ra, nima qilinayotgani yoki nima qilinishi muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Asosiy klinik vazifa: bemorning davom etayotgan simptomlarini aniqlash, tekshiruv va davolash jarayonlarini passive voice orqali aniq ifodalash. Signal so'zlar: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect Continuous используется, когда действие началось в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента или его результат заметен сейчас. Passive Voice используется, когда важно само действие, процедура или медицинский процесс, а не человек, который его выполняет. Сигнальные слова: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Passive Voice is used when the action or the patient matters more than who performs it — typical for tests, procedures and treatment plans: "Blood samples will be taken", "You will be referred to a specialist", "The wound has been cleaned". Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.signal_words: by, will be, has been, needs to be

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: Positive: subject + have/has + been + V-ing | Negative: subject + have/has not + been + V-ing | Question: Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing...? | Wh-Question: How long/What + have/has + subject + been + V-ing...?
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect Continuous odatda o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan yoki hozirgi holatga ta'sir qilayotgan jarayonni bildiradi. Symptomning qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini so'raydi. Holat taxminan ikki kundan beri davom etayotganini ko'rsatadi. Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect Continuous описывает действие, которое началось в прошлом и всё ещё продолжается (или только что закончилось и результат заметен). Ключевое время для длительности симптомов: «How long have you been feeling unwell?» — «I have been coughing for five days». Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

examples.sentence: I've been feeling progressively weaker for about two days.
examples.translation_uz: Taxminan ikki kundan beri tobora kuchsizlanib boryapman.
examples.translation_ru: Я чувствую себя всё слабее уже около двух дней.

examples.sentence: He hasn't been improving.
examples.translation_ru: Его состояние не улучшается.
examples.note: Negative: subject + have/has not + been + V-ing

examples.sentence: How long have you been feeling unwell?
examples.translation_uz: Qancha vaqtdan beri o'zingizni yomon his qilyapsiz?
examples.translation_ru: Как долго вы плохо себя чувствуете?

examples.sentence: How long have you been coughing?
examples.translation_ru: Как давно вы кашляете?
examples.note: Wh-Question: How long/What + have/has + subject + been + V-ing...?

examples.sentence: I've also been having repeated episodes of fever and chills.
examples.translation_uz: Menda isitma va titroq xurujlari ham takrorlanmoqda.
examples.translation_ru: У меня также повторяются приступы жара и озноба.
examples.note: Takrorlanayotgan simptomlar ma'lum vaqt davomida davom etayotganini bildiradi.
examples.note_en: Shows that recurring symptoms have continued over a period of time.
examples.note_ru: Показывает, что повторяющиеся симптомы продолжаются в течение некоторого времени.

examples.sentence: Have you been coughing or experiencing any urinary symptoms?

examples.translation_ru: У вас был кашель или какие-либо мочевые симптомы?
examples.note: Yaqin vaqtgacha davom etgan simptomlar haqida so'raydi.
examples.note_en: Asks about symptoms that have continued until recently.
examples.note_ru: Вопрос о симптомах, продолжавшихся до недавнего времени.

grammar.title: Passive Voice
grammar.structure_pattern: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + past participle | Future Passive: will be + past participle | Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + past participle | Modal Passive: modal + be + past participle
grammar.signal_words: by, will be, has been, needs to be
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Passive Voice clinical Englishda tekshiruv, muolaja, monitoring va davolash jarayonlarini obyektiv va professional tarzda ifodalash uchun juda ko'p ishlatiladi. Qon kulturasi antibiotiklar boshlanishidan oldin olinishi mumkin. Vena ichiga kirish yo'li allaqachon o'rnatilgan. Signal so'zlar: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Passive Voice используется, когда важнее само действие или пациент, а не исполнитель — типично для анализов, процедур и плана лечения: «Blood samples will be taken», «You will be referred to a specialist», «The wound has been cleaned». Present Simple описывает привычные, регулярные действия, общие факты и постоянные состояния. В клинике используется для типичных симптомов («The pain usually starts at night»), регулярного приёма лекарств и общих медицинских фактов. Сигнальные слова: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Passive Voice is used when the action or the patient matters more than who performs it — typical for tests, procedures and treatment plans: "Blood samples will be taken", "You will be referred to a specialist", "The wound has been cleaned". Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: by, will be, has been, needs to be.

examples.sentence: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started.
examples.translation_uz: Antibiotiklar boshlanishidan oldin qon kulturasi olinishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Посев крови можно взять до начала антибиотиков.
examples.note: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + past participle

examples.sentence: Blood samples will be taken for cultures and other tests.
examples.translation_uz: Kultura va boshqa tahlillar uchun qon namunalari olinadi.
examples.translation_ru: Будут взяты образцы крови для посева и других анализов.
examples.note: Future Passive: will be + past participle
examples.note_en: Blood samples are taken for various laboratory tests.
examples.note_ru: Образцы крови берутся для различных лабораторных исследований.

examples.sentence: Intravenous access has been established.
examples.translation_ru: Венозный доступ уже установлен.
examples.note: Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + past participle

examples.sentence: Supplemental oxygen will be given. / Higher-level care may be required.
examples.translation_uz: Qo'shimcha kislorod beriladi. / Yuqori darajadagi parvarish talab qilinishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Будет дан дополнительный кислород. / Может потребоваться более интенсивная помощь.
examples.note: Modal Passive: modal + be + past participle
examples.note_en: States that oxygen will be given and the patient's response closely monitored.
examples.note_ru: Сообщается, что будет дан кислород и реакция пациента будет тщательно контролироваться.

examples.sentence: Blood samples will be taken for cultures, full blood count, renal function, electrolytes, lactate, and other relevant tests.
examples.translation_uz: Kultura, umumiy qon tahlili, buyrak faoliyati, elektrolitlar, laktat va boshqa tegishli tekshiruvlar uchun qon namunalari olinadi.
examples.translation_ru: Будут взяты образцы крови для посева, общего анализа крови, оценки функции почек, электролитов, лактата и других необходимых исследований.
examples.note: Qon namunalari turli laborator tekshiruvlar uchun olinadi.
examples.note_en: Blood samples are taken for various laboratory tests.
examples.note_ru: Образцы крови берутся для различных лабораторных исследований.

examples.sentence: Supplemental oxygen will be given and your response will be monitored closely.
examples.translation_uz: Qo'shimcha kislorod beriladi va javobingiz yaqindan kuzatiladi.
examples.translation_ru: Будет дан дополнительный кислород, и ваша реакция будет тщательно контролироваться.
examples.note: Kislorod berilishi va bemorning javobi yaqindan kuzatilishi aytilmoqda.
examples.note_en: States that oxygen will be given and the patient's response closely monitored.
examples.note_ru: Сообщается, что будет дан кислород и реакция пациента будет тщательно контролироваться.

examples.sentence: Appropriate antimicrobial treatment should be started promptly.
examples.translation_uz: Tegishli antimikrob davolash tezda boshlanishi kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Соответствующую антимикробную терапию следует начать незамедлительно.
examples.note: Tegishli antimikrob davolash tezda boshlanishi kerak.

examples.sentence: Treatment may be adjusted when culture results identify the organism and its sensitivities.
examples.translation_uz: Kultura natijalari mikroorganizm va uning sezuvchanligini aniqlaganda davolash o'zgartirilishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Лечение может быть скорректировано, когда результаты посева определят микроорганизм и его чувствительность.
examples.note: Davolash kultura natijalariga ko'ra o'zgartirilishi mumkin.
examples.note_en: Treatment may be changed according to the culture results.
examples.note_ru: Лечение может быть изменено в соответствии с результатами посева.

grammar.title: Common Mistakes
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ushbu modul grammatikasida talabalar eng ko'p yo'l qo'yadigan xatolar va ularning to'g'ri klinik varianti.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Самые частые ошибки студентов в грамматике этого модуля с исправленным клиническим вариантом.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous + for is appropriate for a continuing symptom. The question asks about a condition continuing up to now. Future Passive requires will be + past participle. After be, use the past participle. Modal Passive requires can + be + past participle.

common_mistakes.incorrect: I am feeling weak since two days.
common_mistakes.correct: I've been feeling weak for two days.

common_mistakes.incorrect: How long are you feeling unwell?
common_mistakes.correct: How long have you been feeling unwell?

common_mistakes.incorrect: Blood cultures can taken before antibiotics are started.
common_mistakes.correct: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started.

grammar.title: Smart Phrases for Clinical Communication
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Agar bu sezilarli kechikishga olib kelmasa. Infeksiya manbasini imkon qadar tez aniqlash.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Полезные клинические фразы из этого диалога: вопрос о том, как долго пациент плохо себя чувствует, осторожное обозначение текущей клинической вероятности («At the moment, we need to consider…») и объяснение, что источник инфекции нужно определить как можно быстрее — если это не приведёт к значительной задержке.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Useful clinical phrases from this dialogue: asking how long the patient has been unwell, cautiously stating the current clinical possibility ("At the moment, we need to consider…"), and explaining that the source of infection must be identified as quickly as possible — provided this does not cause a significant delay.

examples.sentence: How long have you been feeling unwell?
examples.translation_uz: Qancha vaqtdan beri o'zingizni yomon his qilyapsiz?
examples.translation_ru: Как долго вы плохо себя чувствуете?
examples.note_en: Asking how long the patient's condition has lasted.
examples.note_ru: Вопрос о длительности состояния пациента.

examples.sentence: At the moment, we need to consider...
examples.translation_uz: Hozircha biz … ni hisobga olishimiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: На данный момент нам нужно рассмотреть…
examples.note: Hozirgi klinik ehtimolni ehtiyotkorlik bilan aytish.
examples.note_en: Cautiously stating the current clinical possibility.
examples.note_ru: Осторожное обозначение текущей клинической вероятности.

examples.sentence: The important thing is that it is recognised and treated promptly.
examples.translation_uz: Muhimi, bu holat tezda aniqlanib, davolanishidir.
examples.translation_ru: Важно, чтобы это состояние было быстро распознано и пролечено.
examples.note: Jiddiy holatda tezkor davolash muhimligini tushuntirish.

examples.sentence: Your response will be monitored closely.
examples.translation_ru: Ваша реакция будет тщательно контролироваться.

examples.sentence: We'll assess his response to initial treatment.
examples.translation_uz: Biz uning boshlang'ich davolashga javobini baholaymiz.
examples.translation_ru: Мы оценим его реакцию на первоначальное лечение.
examples.note_en: Assessing the response to initial treatment.
examples.note_ru: Оценка ответа на начальное лечение.

examples.sentence: Treatment may be adjusted...
examples.translation_ru: Лечение может быть скорректировано…
examples.note_en: Explaining that treatment may be changed later.
examples.note_ru: Объяснение, что лечение может быть скорректировано позже.

examples.sentence: We'll reassess you repeatedly.
examples.translation_ru: Мы будем регулярно повторно оценивать ваше состояние.

examples.sentence: The priority is to...
examples.translation_ru: Приоритет — …

tests.question: Which term means: "Start appropriate treatment without unnecessary delay."?
tests.question_en: Which term means: "Start appropriate treatment without unnecessary delay."?
tests.explanation_en: "treat promptly" — Start appropriate treatment without unnecessary delay.

tests.question_en: Which term means: "Organs essential for maintaining life."?
tests.explanation_en: "vital organs" — Organs essential for maintaining life.. Example: "The priority is to control the infection, support your vital organs, and identify the source as quickly as possible..

tests.question_en: Which term means: "The percentage of oxygen carried in the blood."?

practice.setting: general medical clinic / hospital admissions unit
practice.role_play: The student is the DOCTOR. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: William Foster
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative but anxious about the diagnosis

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I've been feeling progressively weaker for about two days. I've also been having repeated episodes of fever and chills.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How long have you been feeling unwell?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've been feeling progressively weaker for about two days. I've also been having repeated episodes of fever and chills.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you been coughing or experiencing any urinary symptoms?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've had a cough with yellow sputum, and I've been feeling short of breath.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you. These observations are concerning. Have you been treated for an infection recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I was treated for a chest infection last week.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Were antibiotics prescribed?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes, but I stopped them after three days because I started feeling better.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. At the moment, we need to consider a severe systemic infection and possible sepsis.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is sepsis life-threatening?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It can be. The important thing is that it is recognised and treated promptly.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started, provided this does not cause a significant delay.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Exactly. Blood samples will be taken for cultures, full blood count, renal function, electrolytes, lactate, and other relevant tests.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will I need oxygen?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your oxygen saturation is low, so supplemental oxygen will be given and your response will be monitored closely.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Does he need to go to intensive care?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We'll assess his response to initial treatment. If his blood pressure remains low or organ dysfunction develops, higher-level care may be required.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Intravenous access has been established. I'm preparing the prescribed fluids and medications.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good. Appropriate antimicrobial treatment should be started promptly if a serious bacterial infection is suspected.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will the doctors know which antibiotic is best immediately?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Not always. Treatment may begin empirically and then be adjusted when culture results identify the organism and its sensitivities.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should I expect over the next few hours?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your blood pressure, urine output, oxygenation, mental state, and laboratory markers will be monitored closely. We'll reassess you repeatedly rather than relying on a single measu…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: So the situation is serious, but you are treating it now?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started, provided this does not cause a significant delay.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Exactly. Blood samples will be taken for cultures, full blood count, renal function, electrolytes, lactate, and other relevant tests.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will I need oxygen?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your oxygen saturation is low, so supplemental oxygen will be given and your response will be monitored closely.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Does he need to go to intensive care?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We'll assess his response to initial treatment. If his blood pressure remains low or organ dysfunction develops, higher-level care may be required.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Intravenous access has been established. I'm preparing the prescribed fluids and medications.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good. Appropriate antimicrobial treatment should be started promptly if a serious bacterial infection is suspected.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will the doctors know which antibiotic is best immediately?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Not always. Treatment may begin empirically and then be adjusted when culture results identify the organism and its sensitivities.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should I expect over the next few hours?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your blood pressure, urine output, oxygenation, mental state, and laboratory markers will be monitored closely. We'll reassess you repeatedly rather than relying on a single measu…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: So the situation is serious, but you are treating it now?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Tell me what happened before the abdominal pain became severe.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had eaten a large meal about two hours earlier, and I had gone to bed feeling slightly nauseated.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What had you eaten?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had eaten fried meat, potatoes, and a rich dessert.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you experienced abdominal pain before you went to bed?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had already noticed a dull discomfort, but I thought it was indigestion.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: When did the pain become severe?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It woke me at around midnight. The pain was much stronger than it had been earlier.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Where did it begin?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It started in the upper abdomen and later moved towards the right side.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you vomited before the pain became severe?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I hadn't. I felt nauseated, but I didn't vomit until later.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: His temperature is 38.1°C, pulse 112, and he appears uncomfortable.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had any previous abdominal surgery or known gallbladder problems?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No previous surgery. I've never been diagnosed with gallstones.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you eaten anything unusual before the symptoms started?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, although the meal had been much heavier than usual.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Does the pain radiate to your back or shoulder?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It seems to go through to my back at times.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I'm going to examine your abdomen now. Tell me if the pain becomes significantly worse when I press or release.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It's particularly tender in the upper right side.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We need to consider several possibilities, including biliary disease, pancreatitis, peptic pathology and other causes of acute abdominal pain.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Could it be appendicitis?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It is less typical given the location, but we cannot exclude diagnoses solely on the basis of one symptom.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'll prepare blood samples for the requested tests and arrange the imaging pathway.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We'll check inflammatory markers, liver enzymes, pancreatic enzymes, renal function and other relevant investigations.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will I need surgery?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That depends entirely on what we find. At this stage, it would be premature to say that an operation is necessary.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I do while we're waiting?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Remain fasting until we have clarified whether a procedure may be required, and tell us immediately if the pain, vomiting, or weakness becomes significantly worse.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: All right. I understand.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. The examination and investigation results will help us narrow the differential diagnosis and decide on the safest treatment.

phrasebook.phrase: Tell me what happened before the abdominal pain became severe.

phrasebook.clinical_use: Establish the sequence of events before severe pain.

phrasebook.phrase: When did the pain become severe?

phrasebook.clinical_use: Establish the time of severe symptom onset.

phrasebook.phrase: Where did it begin?

phrasebook.clinical_use: Establish the initial location of pain.

phrasebook.phrase: It started in the upper abdomen and later moved towards the right side.

phrasebook.translation_ru: Боль началась в верхней части живота, а затем переместилась вправо.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Describe pain location and subsequent movement.

phrasebook.phrase: Had you vomited before the pain became severe?

phrasebook.phrase: Tell me if the pain becomes significantly worse when I press or release.

phrasebook.translation_ru: Скажите мне, если боль значительно усилится, когда я нажму или отпущу.

phrasebook.phrase: It's particularly tender in the upper right side.

phrasebook.clinical_use: Report a focal area of tenderness.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to consider several possibilities.

phrasebook.phrase: It is less typical given the location.

phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain why one diagnosis is less typical without excluding it.

phrasebook.phrase: We cannot exclude diagnoses solely on the basis of one symptom.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Faqat bitta simptom asosida tashxislarni istisno qila olmaymiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы не можем исключать диагнозы только на основании одного симптома.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain why a full assessment is required.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll prepare blood samples for the requested tests and arrange the imaging pathway.
phrasebook.translation_uz: So'ralgan tekshiruvlar uchun qon namunalarini tayyorlayman va tasviriy tekshiruvni tashkil qilaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я подготовлю образцы крови для назначенных анализов и организую визуализационные исследования.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll check inflammatory markers, liver enzymes, pancreatic enzymes, renal function and other relevant investigations.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yallig'lanish markerlari, jigar fermentlari, oshqozon osti bezi fermentlari, buyrak faoliyati va boshqa tegishli tekshiruvlarni tekshiramiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы проверим маркеры воспаления, печёночные ферменты, ферменты поджелудочной железы, функцию почек и другие необходимые показатели.

phrasebook.phrase: At this stage, it would be premature to say that an operation is necessary.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hozircha operatsiya zarur deb aytish uchun hali erta.
phrasebook.translation_ru: На данном этапе преждевременно говорить о необходимости операции.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Avoid making a premature treatment decision.

phrasebook.phrase: Remain fasting until we have clarified whether a procedure may be required.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Muolaja kerak bo'lish-bo'lmasligi aniqlanguncha och qoling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Оставайтесь натощак, пока мы не выясним, может ли потребоваться процедура.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Give a safety instruction while awaiting further assessment.

phrasebook.phrase: Tell us immediately if the pain, vomiting, or weakness becomes significantly worse.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Og'riq, qusish yoki kuchsizlik ancha kuchaysa, darhol bizga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите нам, если боль, рвота или слабость значительно усилятся.

phrasebook.phrase: The examination and investigation results will help us narrow the differential diagnosis.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Tekshiruv va tahlil natijalari differensial tashxisni toraytirishga yordam beradi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Результаты осмотра и исследований помогут нам сузить дифференциальный диагноз.

grammar.title: Grammar focus: Past Perfect + Past Simple
grammar.title_en: Grammar focus: Past Perfect + Past Simple
grammar.title_uz: Modul grammatikasi: Past Perfect + Past Simple
grammar.title_ru: Грамматика модуля: Past Perfect + Past Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: had + V3 | Subject + V2 (V-ed) | Did + subject + V1? | was / were
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Perfect o'tmishda boshqa bir voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgan ishni ko'rsatadi. Past Simple esa keyin sodir bo'lgan asosiy voqealarni beradi. Shuning uchun clinical historyda timeline tuzishda ikkala zamonni birga ishlatish juda muhim. Bu modulda Past Perfect oldinroq sodir bo'lgan voqeani, Past Simple esa keyin sodir bo'lgan yoki klinik timeline'da asosiy voqeani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Acute abdominal pain history-takingda shifokor simptomlardan oldin nima bo'lganini va og'riq qachon kuchayganini aniqlaydi. Signal so'zlar: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Perfect используется для действия, которое произошло раньше другого действия в прошлом. В этом диалоге он помогает врачу восстановить последовательность событий до усиления боли. Past Simple используется для основных завершённых событий в прошлом: когда боль усилилась, где она началась и куда переместилась. Сигнальные слова: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Perfect shows that one past action happened before another past action: "I had eaten a large meal before the pain started". It orders events in the clinical timeline. Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.signal_words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when

grammar.title: Past Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: Positive: subject + had + V3 | Negative: subject + had not + V3 | Question: Had + subject + V3...? | Wh-Question: What/Where + had + subject + V3...?
grammar.signal_words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Perfect oldin sodir bo'lgan voqeani keyingi o'tgan voqeaga nisbatan ko'rsatadi. Signal so'zlar: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Perfect показывает, что одно действие в прошлом произошло раньше другого: «I had eaten a large meal before the pain started». Упорядочивает события в клинической хронологии. Сигнальные слова: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: The meal happened before the abdominal pain became severe. Signal words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.

grammar.title: Sequencing a Clinical Event
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu timeline'da Past Perfect oldingi voqealarni, Past Simple esa keyingi asosiy voqealarni ajratib beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: В этой хронологии Past Perfect обозначает более ранние события, а Past Simple — последующие основные события.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: In this timeline, Past Perfect marks the earlier events, while Past Simple marks the later, main events.

grammar.title: Key Time Expressions
grammar.structure_pattern: since + starting point (since yesterday) | for + period (for three days) | period + ago (two hours ago)
grammar.signal_words: since, for, ago, at about, over the last, until
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: about two hours earlier — oldinroq sodir bo'lgan voqeani ko'rsatadi before — bir voqea ikkinchisidan oldin sodir bo'lganini bildiradi already — voqea o'sha vaqtgacha sodir bo'lganini ta'kidlaydi until later — voqea keyinroq sodir bo'lganini bildiradi at around midnight — aniq/taxminiy vaqtni ko'rsatadi later — keyingi voqeani bildiradi at times — ba'zan, vaqti-vaqti bilan Signal so'zlar: since, for, ago, at about, over the last, until.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «Since» указывает точку начала («since yesterday»), «for» — продолжительность («for three days»), «ago» — отсчёт назад от настоящего («two hours ago»). Точное время («at about 7:15 this morning») критично при инсульте и других неотложных состояниях. Сигнальные слова: since, for, ago, at about, over the last, until.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Since" gives the starting point ("since yesterday"), "for" the length of time ("for three days") and "ago" counts back from now ("two hours ago"). Exact times ("at about 7:15 this morning") are essential in time-critical conditions such as stroke. Signal words: since, for, ago, at about, over the last, until.

grammar.title: Common Mistakes
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ushbu modul grammatikasida talabalar eng ko'p yo'l qo'yadigan xatolar va ularning to'g'ri klinik varianti.

grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Perfect = had + V3. Past Perfect is used consistently for the earlier event. After did, use V1. The main narrative events can be expressed in Past Simple. Had + V3.

practice.setting: general medical clinic / hospital admissions unit
practice.role_play: The student is the DOCTOR. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Henry Cole
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative but anxious about the diagnosis

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I had eaten a large meal about two hours earlier, and I had gone to bed feeling slightly nauseated.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Tell me what happened before the abdominal pain became severe.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had eaten a large meal about two hours earlier, and I had gone to bed feeling slightly nauseated.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What had you eaten?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had eaten fried meat, potatoes, and a rich dessert.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you experienced abdominal pain before you went to bed?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had already noticed a dull discomfort, but I thought it was indigestion.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When did the pain become severe?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It woke me at around midnight. The pain was much stronger than it had been earlier.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Where did it begin?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It started in the upper abdomen and later moved towards the right side.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you vomited before the pain became severe?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I hadn't. I felt nauseated, but I didn't vomit until later.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had any previous abdominal surgery or known gallbladder problems?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No previous surgery. I've never been diagnosed with gallstones.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you eaten anything unusual before the symptoms started?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, although the meal had been much heavier than usual.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Does the pain radiate to your back or shoulder?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It seems to go through to my back at times.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I'm going to examine your abdomen now. Tell me if the pain becomes significantly worse when I press or release.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It's particularly tender in the upper right side.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We need to consider several possibilities, including biliary disease, pancreatitis, peptic pathology and other causes of acute abdominal pain.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Could it be appendicitis?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It is less typical given the location, but we cannot exclude diagnoses solely on the basis of one symptom.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'll prepare blood samples for the requested tests and arrange the imaging pathway.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We'll check inflammatory markers, liver enzymes, pancreatic enzymes, renal function and other relevant investigations.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will I need surgery?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That depends entirely on what we find. At this stage, it would be premature to say that an operation is necessary.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should I do while we're waiting?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Remain fasting until we have clarified whether a procedure may be required, and tell us immediately if the pain, vomiting, or weakness becomes significantly worse.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: All right. I understand.

questions_to_ask_doctor: Could it be appendicitis?
Will I need surgery?
What should I do while we're waiting?

modules.description_en: Clinical communication module: Urinary Tract Infection, Pyelonephritis & Kidney Function. Grammar focus: Modal Verbs. Includes a reference doctor–patient dialogue, 48 vocabulary items, 19 smart phrases, 9 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What symptoms have brought you to the clinic today?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've had burning when I urinate, and I've been needing to pass urine much more frequently.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed blood in your urine or any change in its appearance?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. It looked darker yesterday, and I noticed a small amount of blood.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you developed fever, chills, nausea, or pain in your back or side?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've had a fever since last night, and there is severe pain in my right flank.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Her temperature is 38.8°C, pulse 108, and blood pressure 106 over 68.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That combination may indicate that the infection has moved beyond the bladder and may involve the upper urinary tract.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Could it be a kidney infection?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It might be. We must assess how severe the infection is and whether your kidney function has been affected.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What tests do I need?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You must provide a urine sample for urinalysis and culture. We should also check your blood count, inflammatory markers, renal function and electrolytes.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'll collect the urine sample and prepare the blood tubes.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Should I drink a lot of water?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You should maintain adequate hydration unless there is another medical reason for restricting fluids. However, drinking excessive amounts will not replace antibiotic treatment.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Should I take painkillers?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You should check with us before taking them, particularly if your kidney function is impaired.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Do I have to stay in hospital?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You may have to stay if you are unable to keep fluids down, if your infection is severe, or if there are signs of kidney dysfunction or systemic infection.

dialogue.label: Relative
dialogue.text: She has been vomiting since this morning. Does that make admission more likely?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes, persistent vomiting can make oral treatment difficult and may increase the need for intravenous fluids and antibiotics.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What happens if the urine culture shows a resistant bacterium?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We may have to change the antibiotic according to the organism's susceptibility results.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: And if I start feeling better tomorrow?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You should still complete the prescribed course unless your doctor specifically changes it. Feeling better does not necessarily mean the infection has been eradicated.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'll explain the warning signs before discharge if she is well enough to go home.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If you develop worsening flank pain, persistent vomiting, confusion, fainting, or severe weakness, you must seek urgent medical attention.

vocabulary.definition_en: Advice about warning signs and when to seek urgent help.

phrasebook.phrase: What symptoms have brought you to the clinic today?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bugun sizni klinikaga olib kelgan qanday simptomlar bor?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какие симптомы привели вас сегодня в клинику?
phrasebook.clinical_use: Open a medical consultation and identify the main complaint.

phrasebook.phrase: I've had burning when I urinate.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У меня жжение при мочеиспускании.

phrasebook.phrase: I've been needing to pass urine much more frequently.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men odatdagidan ancha tez-tez siyishimga to'g'ri kelmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мне приходится мочиться гораздо чаще, чем обычно.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you noticed blood in your urine?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы замечали кровь в моче?

phrasebook.phrase: That combination may indicate that the infection has moved beyond the bladder.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu belgilar kombinatsiyasi infeksiya siydik pufagidan yuqoriga tarqalganini ko'rsatishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Такое сочетание может указывать на то, что инфекция распространилась за пределы мочевого пузыря.

phrasebook.phrase: We must assess how severe the infection is.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz infeksiyaning qanchalik og'irligini baholashimiz shart.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы должны оценить, насколько тяжёлая инфекция.

phrasebook.phrase: You must provide a urine sample for urinalysis and culture.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Siydik tahlili va kulturasi uchun siydik namunasi berishingiz shart.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы должны предоставить образец мочи для анализа и посева.

phrasebook.phrase: We should also check your blood count, inflammatory markers, renal function and electrolytes.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon tahlili, yallig'lanish markerlari, buyrak faoliyati va elektrolitlarni ham tekshirishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам также следует проверить общий анализ крови, маркеры воспаления, функцию почек и электролиты.

phrasebook.phrase: You should maintain adequate hydration.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует поддерживать достаточную гидратацию.

phrasebook.phrase: Drinking excessive amounts will not replace antibiotic treatment.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Haddan tashqari ko'p suyuqlik ichish antibiotik davolashning o'rnini bosa olmaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Чрезмерное употребление жидкости не заменит лечение антибиотиками.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Correct a possible misconception about hydration.

phrasebook.phrase: You should check with us before taking them.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ularni qabul qilishdan oldin biz bilan maslahatlashishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует проконсультироваться с нами перед их приёмом.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Give a safety recommendation about painkillers.

phrasebook.phrase: You may have to stay if you are unable to keep fluids down.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar suyuqlikni qayt qilmasdan ushlab turolmasangiz, kasalxonada qolishingizga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам, возможно, придётся остаться в больнице, если вы не сможете удерживать жидкость.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain a possible reason for admission.

phrasebook.phrase: Persistent vomiting can make oral treatment difficult.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Davomli qusish og'iz orqali davolashni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Постоянная рвота может затруднить пероральное лечение.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain why vomiting affects treatment choice.

phrasebook.phrase: We may have to change the antibiotic according to the organism's susceptibility results.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Mikroorganizmning sezuvchanlik natijalariga ko'ra antibiotikni o'zgartirishimizga to'g'ri kelishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам, возможно, придётся изменить антибиотик в соответствии с результатами чувствительности микроорганизма.

phrasebook.phrase: You should still complete the prescribed course.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Shunga qaramay, buyurilgan davolash kursini to'liq tugatishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам всё равно следует полностью завершить назначенный курс.

phrasebook.phrase: Feeling better does not necessarily mean the infection has been eradicated.
phrasebook.translation_uz: O'zingizni yaxshi his qilishingiz infeksiya butunlay yo'qolganini anglatmaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Улучшение самочувствия не обязательно означает, что инфекция полностью устранена.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Explain why symptom improvement does not always equal cure.

phrasebook.phrase: You must seek urgent medical attention.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Siz shoshilinch tibbiy yordamga murojaat qilishingiz shart.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы должны обратиться за неотложной медицинской помощью.

phrasebook.phrase: If you develop worsening flank pain, persistent vomiting, confusion, fainting, or severe weakness...
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar yonbosh og'rig'i kuchaysa, davomli qusish, ong chalkashishi, hushidan ketish yoki kuchli holsizlik paydo bo'lsa...
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если у вас усилится боль в боку, появятся постоянная рвота, спутанность сознания, обморок или сильная слабость...
phrasebook.clinical_use: Identify red-flag symptoms requiring urgent assessment.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll explain the warning signs before discharge.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kasalxonadan chiqarishdan oldin xavf belgilarini tushuntirib beraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я объясню предупреждающие признаки перед выпиской.

grammar.title: Should — advice — recommendation
grammar.structure_pattern: should / ought to + V1 | shouldn't + V1
grammar.signal_words: advice, recommendation
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Should" va "ought to" maslahat va tavsiya beradi — bemorga nima qilish kerakligini aytishning eng keng tarqalgan usuli: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «Should» и «ought to» выражают совет и рекомендацию — самый частый способ сказать пациенту, что делать: «You should drink plenty of fluids», «You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice». Сигнальные слова: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal words: advice, recommendation.

examples.sentence: You should maintain adequate hydration.
examples.translation_ru: Вам следует поддерживать достаточную гидратацию.

examples.sentence: You should check with us before taking them.
examples.translation_uz: Ularni qabul qilishdan oldin biz bilan maslahatlashishingiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Вам следует проконсультироваться с нами перед их приёмом.

examples.sentence: You should still complete the prescribed course.
examples.translation_uz: Shunga qaramay, buyurilgan davolash kursini to'liq tugatishingiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Вам всё равно следует полностью завершить назначенный курс.
examples.note: should + base verb. It gives advice or a clinical recommendation.

examples.sentence: Negative: should not / shouldn't + base verb.
examples.translation_uz: should = kerak, ma'qul. Russian: следует, стоит.
examples.translation_ru: Отрицание: should not / shouldn't + базовая форма глагола.

grammar.title: Must — strong necessity — urgent instruction
grammar.structure_pattern: must + V1 | have to / has to + V1 | mustn't + V1 (prohibition) | don't have to + V1 (not necessary)
grammar.signal_words: necessity, obligation, prohibition
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Must" so'zlovchining qat'iy talabini bildiradi ("You must take the full course of antibiotics"); "have to" — tashqi qoida yoki talab. "Mustn't" — taqiqlangan, "don't have to" esa — shart emas. Signal so'zlar: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «Must» выражает строгую необходимость со стороны говорящего («You must take the full course of antibiotics»); «have to» — внешнее правило или требование. «Mustn't» — запрещено, «don't have to» — не обязательно. Сигнальные слова: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Must" expresses strong necessity from the speaker ("You must take the full course of antibiotics"); "have to" — an external rule or requirement. "Mustn't" means it is forbidden, while "don't have to" means it is not necessary. Signal words: necessity, obligation, prohibition.

examples.sentence: We must assess how severe the infection is.
examples.translation_uz: Biz infeksiyaning qanchalik og'irligini baholashimiz shart.
examples.translation_ru: Мы должны оценить, насколько тяжёлая инфекция.

examples.sentence: You must provide a urine sample.
examples.translation_ru: Вы должны сдать анализ мочи.

examples.sentence: You must seek urgent medical attention.
examples.translation_uz: Siz shoshilinch tibbiy yordamga murojaat qilishingiz shart.
examples.translation_ru: Вы должны обратиться за неотложной медицинской помощью.
examples.note: must + base verb. It expresses strong necessity, obligation, or an urgent instruction.

examples.sentence: must not / mustn't means prohibition: You must not ignore severe warning signs.
examples.translation_uz: must = shart, albatta kerak. Russian: должен, необходимо, обязан.
examples.translation_ru: must not / mustn't означает запрет: Нельзя игнорировать серьёзные тревожные признаки.

grammar.title: MAY — possibility — permission depending on context
grammar.structure_pattern: may / might + V1 | may / might + have + V3 (past possibility)
grammar.signal_words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "May" va "might" ehtimollik va ehtiyotkor klinik xulosani bildiradi: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" muloyim ruxsat ham beradi. "Might have + V3" — o'tmishdagi ehtimol. Signal so'zlar: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «May» и «might» выражают возможность и осторожное клиническое суждение: «It may be an infection», «You might need to stay in hospital». «May» также даёт вежливое разрешение. «Might have + V3» — возможное событие в прошлом. Сигнальные слова: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "May" and "might" express possibility and cautious clinical judgement: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" also gives polite permission. "Might have + V3" refers to a possible past event. Signal words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.

examples.translation_ru: Возможно, нам придётся сменить антибиотик.

examples.note: may + base verb for a possible situation or outcome.

examples.sentence: Past: had to + base verb. Future: will have to + base verb.

examples.sentence: Must often expresses a strong instruction or requirement from the speaker: "You must provide a urine sample." Have to often describes a necessity caused by the clinical situation: "You may have to stay if the infection is severe.
examples.translation_uz: Must ko'pincha so'zlovchining qat'iy ko'rsatmasi yoki talabini bildiradi: "You must provide a urine sample." Have to esa klinik vaziyat tufayli yuzaga kelgan zaruratni bildiradi: "You may have to stay if the infection is severe."
examples.translation_ru: must — необходимо/должны; have to — приходится/необходимо из-за обстоятельств. Uzbek: must — shart; have to — vaziyat sabab majbur bo'lmoq.

examples.sentence: Both express possibility. In this dialogue, may is commonly used for a possible clinical outcome or interpretation, while might is used for a more tentative possibility: "It might be.
examples.translation_uz: Ikkalasi ham ehtimolni bildiradi. Bu dialogda may ehtimoliy klinik natija yoki talqin uchun, might esa ko'proq taxminiy ehtimol uchun ishlatiladi: "It might be."
examples.translation_ru: Оба выражают возможность. В этом диалоге may используется для вероятного клинического исхода или интерпретации, а might — для более осторожного предположения: «It might be.»
examples.note: the difference is often about degree of certainty and context, not a fixed percentage.

grammar.structure_pattern: modal + base verb: should drink, must assess, may indicate, might be | have to + base verb: have to stay, have to change
grammar.signal_words: advice, recommendation
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Should" va "ought to" maslahat va tavsiya beradi — bemorga nima qilish kerakligini aytishning eng keng tarqalgan usuli: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.

grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". "Must" expresses strong necessity from the speaker ("You must take the full course of antibiotics"); "have to" — an external rule or requirement. "Mustn't" means it is forbidden, while "don't have to" means it is not necessary. Signal words: advice, recommendation.

examples.sentence: Negative: should not, must not, may not; don't have to = not necessary.
examples.translation_uz: Inkor: should not, must not, may not; don't have to = shart emas.
examples.translation_ru: Отрицание: should not, must not, may not; don't have to = не обязательно.

grammar.title: Clinical Functions in the Dialogue
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Modal fe'llar klinik vazifalarni ifodalaydi: maslahat (should — "You should maintain adequate hydration"), qat'iy klinik talab (must — "You must provide a urine sample") va ehtimol (may/might — "The infection may involve the upper urinary tract").
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Модальные глаголы выражают клинические функции: совет (should — «You should maintain adequate hydration»), строгое клиническое требование (must — «You must provide a urine sample») и возможность (may/might — «The infection may involve the upper urinary tract»).
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Modal verbs express clinical functions: advice (should — "You should maintain adequate hydration"), a strong clinical requirement (must — "You must provide a urine sample") and possibility (may/might — "The infection may involve the upper urinary tract").

examples.sentence: Advice: You should maintain adequate hydration.
examples.translation_ru: Вам следует поддерживать достаточную гидратацию.

examples.sentence: Strong clinical requirement: You must provide a urine sample.
examples.translation_uz: Qat'iy klinik talab: Siydik namunasini topshirishingiz shart.

practice.module: Urinary Tract Infection, Pyelonephritis & Kidney Function
practice.setting: general medical clinic / hospital admissions unit
practice.role_play: The student is the DOCTOR. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Charlotte Reed
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative but anxious about the diagnosis

medical_condition.exact_diagnosis: Urinary Tract Infection, Pyelonephritis & Kidney Function
medical_condition.chief_complaint: I've had burning when I urinate, and I've been needing to pass urine much more frequently.
doctor_explanations_from_reference_dialo: That combination may indicate that the infection has moved beyond the bladder and may involve the upper urinary tract.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What symptoms have brought you to the clinic today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've had burning when I urinate, and I've been needing to pass urine much more frequently.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you noticed blood in your urine or any change in its appearance?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. It looked darker yesterday, and I noticed a small amount of blood.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you developed fever, chills, nausea, or pain in your back or side?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've had a fever since last night, and there is severe pain in my right flank.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That combination may indicate that the infection has moved beyond the bladder and may involve the upper urinary tract.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Could it be a kidney infection?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It might be. We must assess how severe the infection is and whether your kidney function has been affected.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What tests do I need?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You must provide a urine sample for urinalysis and culture. We should also check your blood count, inflammatory markers, renal function and electrolytes.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'll collect the urine sample and prepare the blood tubes.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You should maintain adequate hydration unless there is another medical reason for restricting fluids. However, drinking excessive amounts will not replace antibiotic treatment.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Should I take painkillers?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You should check with us before taking them, particularly if your kidney function is impaired.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Do I have to stay in hospital?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You may have to stay if you are unable to keep fluids down, if your infection is severe, or if there are signs of kidney dysfunction or systemic infection.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: She has been vomiting since this morning. Does that make admission more likely?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes, persistent vomiting can make oral treatment difficult and may increase the need for intravenous fluids and antibiotics.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What happens if the urine culture shows a resistant bacterium?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We may have to change the antibiotic according to the organism's susceptibility results.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: And if I start feeling better tomorrow?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You should still complete the prescribed course unless your doctor specifically changes it. Feeling better does not necessarily mean the infection has been eradicated.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'll explain the warning signs before discharge if she is well enough to go home.

questions_to_ask_doctor: Could it be a kidney infection?
What tests do I need?
Should I drink a lot of water?
Should I take painkillers?
Do I have to stay in hospital?
