dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You've been feeling exhausted for several months. Can you tell me about your menstrual bleeding?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: My periods have become much heavier over the last six months, and I'm exhausted most of the time.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: How would you describe the bleeding?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I need to change sanitary products very frequently, and the first two days are particularly heavy.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If the bleeding continues at this level, does it interfere with your daily activities?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I sometimes have to sit down after walking a short distance because I become breathless and light-headed.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you experienced palpitations or chest discomfort?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I sometimes feel my heart racing, especially when I climb stairs.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Her pulse is 106. She appears pale, although her blood pressure is stable.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If your hemoglobin is significantly reduced, these symptoms could be related to iron-deficiency anemia.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What will happen if the blood tests confirm anemia?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If your iron stores are depleted, we'll investigate the source of the blood loss and discuss iron replacement.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will I automatically need a blood transfusion?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: No. If your hemoglobin is severely low and you are clinically unstable, transfusion may be considered, but it is not automatically required.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What if the bleeding continues despite treatment?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If the bleeding continues, we'll need to investigate the underlying cause, including possible fibroids, hormonal causes or other gynecological conditions.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: And what would happen if my iron levels were normal?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If iron deficiency were excluded, we would look for other causes of anemia, such as vitamin deficiency, chronic disease or a hematological disorder.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'll arrange a full blood count, ferritin, iron studies and the other tests requested by the doctor.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Could anemia explain my shortness of breath?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. If your hemoglobin is significantly reduced, your blood carries less oxygen, which can cause exertional breathlessness and fatigue.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: If I start taking iron, will I feel better immediately?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You may notice gradual improvement, but the response is not usually immediate. More importantly, we need to identify and control the cause of the blood loss.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What would you do if the bleeding became much heavier?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If you were soaking through pads repeatedly, became faint, developed severe weakness, or experienced significant shortness of breath, you would need urgent assessment.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand. I want to find out why this is happening.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That is exactly the right approach. Correcting the anemia is important, but treating the underlying cause is equally important.

phrasebook.phrase: Can you tell me about your menstrual bleeding?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hayz paytidagi qon ketishingiz haqida aytib bera olasizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Расскажите о ваших менструальных кровотечениях.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Ask about menstrual bleeding pattern and severity.

phrasebook.phrase: My periods have become much heavier over the last six months.
phrasebook.translation_uz: So'nggi olti oyda hayzlarim ancha ko'paydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: За последние шесть месяцев месячные стали намного обильнее.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Describe a change in menstrual bleeding.

phrasebook.phrase: I need to change sanitary products very frequently.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Gigiyenik vositalarni juda tez-tez almashtirishimga to'g'ri keladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мне приходится очень часто менять средства гигиены.

phrasebook.phrase: If the bleeding continues at this level, does it interfere with your daily activities?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar qon ketishi shu darajada davom etsa, kundalik faoliyatingizga xalaqit beradimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если кровотечение продолжится в таком объёме, мешает ли это вашей повседневной жизни?

phrasebook.phrase: I become breathless and light-headed.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У меня появляется одышка и головокружение.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Describe possible symptoms associated with significant anemia.

phrasebook.phrase: I sometimes feel my heart racing.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ba'zan yuragim juda tez urayotgandek bo'ladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Иногда я чувствую сильное учащённое сердцебиение.

phrasebook.phrase: If your hemoglobin is significantly reduced, these symptoms could be related to iron-deficiency anemia.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar gemoglobiningiz sezilarli darajada past bo'lsa, bu simptomlar temir tanqisligi kamqonligi bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если гемоглобин значительно снижен, эти симптомы могут быть связаны с железодефицитной анемией.
phrasebook.clinical_use: Link symptoms to a possible diagnosis.

phrasebook.phrase: If your iron stores are depleted, we'll investigate the source of the blood loss.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar temir zaxiralaringiz kamaygan bo'lsa, qon yo'qotish manbasini tekshiramiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если запасы железа истощены, мы выясним источник кровопотери.

phrasebook.phrase: If your hemoglobin is severely low and you are clinically unstable, transfusion may be considered.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar gemoglobiningiz juda past bo'lsa va klinik jihatdan beqaror bo'lsangiz, qon quyish ko'rib chiqilishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если гемоглобин очень низкий и состояние клинически нестабильно, может рассматриваться переливание крови.

phrasebook.phrase: If the bleeding continues, we'll need to investigate the underlying cause.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar qon ketishi davom etsa, asosiy sababni tekshirishimiz kerak bo'ladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если кровотечение продолжится, нам нужно будет выяснить основную причину.

phrasebook.phrase: If iron deficiency were excluded, we would look for other causes of anemia.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar temir tanqisligi istisno qilinganida, kamqonlikning boshqa sabablarini izlagan bo'lardik.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если бы дефицит железа был исключён, мы бы искали другие причины анемии.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll arrange a full blood count, ferritin, iron studies and the other tests requested.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Umumiy qon tahlili, ferritin, temir tahlillari va boshqa kerakli tekshiruvlarni tashkil qilamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы назначим общий анализ крови, ферритин, исследования железа и другие необходимые анализы.

phrasebook.phrase: If your hemoglobin is significantly reduced, your blood carries less oxygen.

phrasebook.translation_ru: Если гемоглобин значительно снижен, кровь переносит меньше кислорода.

phrasebook.phrase: You may notice gradual improvement, but the response is not usually immediate.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Siz asta-sekin yaxshilanishni sezishingiz mumkin, ammo ta'sir odatda darhol bo'lmaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы можете заметить постепенное улучшение, но эффект обычно не наступает сразу.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to identify and control the cause of the blood loss.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon ketishining sababini aniqlashimiz va nazorat qilishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо определить и контролировать причину кровопотери.

phrasebook.phrase: If you were soaking through pads repeatedly, you would need urgent assessment.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar prokladkalarni qayta-qayta to'liq ho'l qiladigan darajada qon ketsa, sizga shoshilinch baholash kerak bo'lardi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если бы прокладки постоянно промокали насквозь, вам потребовалась бы срочная медицинская оценка.

phrasebook.phrase: If you became faint, developed severe weakness, or experienced significant shortness of breath, you would need urgent assessment.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar hushdan ketadigan bo'lsangiz, kuchli holsizlik yoki sezilarli nafas qisishi paydo bo'lsa, shoshilinch baholash kerak bo'ladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если вы потеряете сознание, у вас появится сильная слабость или выраженная одышка, потребуется срочная оценка.

phrasebook.phrase: Correcting the anemia is important, but treating the underlying cause is equally important.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kamqonlikni tuzatish muhim, ammo asosiy sababni davolash ham xuddi shunday muhim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Коррекция анемии важна, но лечение основной причины не менее важно.

grammar.title: Grammar focus: First & Second Conditional
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Past Simple, would / could / might + V1
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: First Conditional haqiqiy yoki kelajakda yuz berishi mumkin bo'lgan holatlar uchun ishlatiladi: Agar qon ketishi davom etsa, sababini tekshiramiz. Second Conditional faraziy yoki hozircha aniq bo'lmagan holatlar uchun ishlatiladi: Agar temir darajasi normal bo'lganida, kamqonlikning boshqa sabablarini izlagan bo'lardik. Signal so'zlar: if, if I were you.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Second Conditional описывает нереальную или маловероятную ситуацию в настоящем/будущем: «If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better». «If I were you, I would…» — тактичный совет. Сигнальные слова: if, if I were you.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Conditional sentences describe a condition and its result. In this dialogue, First Conditional is used for realistic or possible future clinical outcomes, while Second Conditional is used for hypothetical or less certain situations. Signal words: if, if I were you.
grammar.signal_words: if, if I were you

grammar.title: First Conditional — Real — Possible Future
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Present Simple, will + base verb.
grammar.signal_words: if, unless, as soon as, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: First Conditional real, ehtimoliy kelajakdagi vaziyat va uning natijasini bildiradi. Shifokor ogohlantirish, reja va xavfsizlik ko'rsatmalari uchun ishlatadi: "If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately". "If" dan keyin "will" ishlatilmaydi. Present Simple odatiy, takrorlanuvchi harakatlar, umumiy faktlar va doimiy holatlarni bildiradi. Klinikada odatdagi simptomlar ("The pain usually starts at night"), muntazam dori qabuli va umumiy tibbiy faktlar uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: First Conditional описывает реальную, возможную ситуацию в будущем и её результат. Врач использует его для предупреждений, планов и рекомендаций по безопасности: «If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately». После «if» «will» не ставится. Present Simple описывает привычные, регулярные действия, общие факты и постоянные состояния. В клинике используется для типичных симптомов («The pain usually starts at night»), регулярного приёма лекарств и общих медицинских фактов. Сигнальные слова: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: First Conditional describes a real, possible future situation and its result. Clinicians use it for warnings, plans and safety-netting: "If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately". Do not use "will" after "if". Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: if, unless, as soon as, when.

grammar.title: Second Conditional — Hypothetical — Less Certain
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Past Simple, would + base verb.
grammar.signal_words: if, if I were you
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Second Conditional hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi noreal, ehtimoli kam vaziyatni bildiradi: "If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better". "If I were you, I would…" — muloyim maslahat berish qolipi. Past Simple o'tmishda aniq vaqtda tugagan voqealarni bildiradi: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Vaqt tugagan yoki aniq ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa shu zamon ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: if, if I were you.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Second Conditional описывает нереальную или маловероятную ситуацию в настоящем/будущем: «If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better». «If I were you, I would…» — тактичный совет. Past Simple описывает завершённые события в определённое время в прошлом: «The pain started yesterday», «When did you take the last dose?». Используется, когда время закончилось или названо. Сигнальные слова: if, if I were you.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Second Conditional describes an unreal or unlikely present/future situation: "If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better". "If I were you, I would…" gives tactful advice. Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: if, if I were you.

grammar.title: First vs Second Conditional
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Past Simple, would / could / might + V1
grammar.signal_words: if, if I were you
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Second Conditional hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi noreal, ehtimoli kam vaziyatni bildiradi: "If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better". "If I were you, I would…" — muloyim maslahat berish qolipi. Signal so'zlar: if, if I were you.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Second Conditional описывает нереальную или маловероятную ситуацию в настоящем/будущем: «If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better». «If I were you, I would…» — тактичный совет. Сигнальные слова: if, if I were you.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Second Conditional describes an unreal or unlikely present/future situation: "If we knew exactly what he had taken, we could assess the risk better". "If I were you, I would…" gives tactful advice. Signal words: if, if I were you.

grammar.title: Could — Might with Conditional Meaning
grammar.structure_pattern: can / could + V1 | Can you …? | Could you …, please? | may / might + V1 | may / might + have + V3 (past possibility)
grammar.signal_words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Can" qobiliyat, ruxsat va hozirgi ehtimollikni bildiradi ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" yumshoqroq, muloyimroq ("Could you describe the pain?") va o'tmishdagi qobiliyatni ifodalaydi. "May" va "might" ehtimollik va ehtiyotkor klinik xulosani bildiradi: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" muloyim ruxsat ham beradi. "Might have + V3" — o'tmishdagi ehtimol. Signal so'zlar: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «Can» выражает способность, разрешение и возможность в настоящем («DKA can become life-threatening»); «could» — более мягкий, вежливый вариант («Could you describe the pain?») и способность в прошлом. «May» и «might» выражают возможность и осторожное клиническое суждение: «It may be an infection», «You might need to stay in hospital». «May» также даёт вежливое разрешение. «Might have + V3» — возможное событие в прошлом. Сигнальные слова: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Can" expresses ability, permission and present possibility ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" is more tentative or polite ("Could you describe the pain?") and refers to past ability. "May" and "might" express possibility and cautious clinical judgement: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" also gives polite permission. "Might have + V3" refers to a possible past event. Signal words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.

grammar.title: Common Mistakes
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ushbu modul grammatikasida talabalar eng ko'p yo'l qo'yadigan xatolar va ularning to'g'ri klinik varianti.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Самые частые ошибки студентов в грамматике этого модуля с исправленным клиническим вариантом.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Use Present Simple after if in the First Conditional. Use Past Simple after if in the Second Conditional. Use the -ing form for an ongoing action. This is a real future question, so First Conditional is appropriate.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I need to change sanitary products very frequently, and the first two days are particularly heavy.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If the bleeding continues at this level, does it interfere with your daily activities?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I sometimes have to sit down after walking a short distance because I become breathless and light-headed.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you experienced palpitations or chest discomfort?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I sometimes feel my heart racing, especially when I climb stairs.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If your hemoglobin is significantly reduced, these symptoms could be related to iron-deficiency anemia.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What will happen if the blood tests confirm anemia?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If your iron stores are depleted, we'll investigate the source of the blood loss and discuss iron replacement.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will I automatically need a blood transfusion?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: No. If your hemoglobin is severely low and you are clinically unstable, transfusion may be considered, but it is not automatically required.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What if the bleeding continues despite treatment?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If the bleeding continues, we'll need to investigate the underlying cause, including possible fibroids, hormonal causes or other gynecological conditions.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: And what would happen if my iron levels were normal?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If iron deficiency were excluded, we would look for other causes of anemia, such as vitamin deficiency, chronic disease or a hematological disorder.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'll arrange a full blood count, ferritin, iron studies and the other tests requested by the doctor.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. If your hemoglobin is significantly reduced, your blood carries less oxygen, which can cause exertional breathlessness and fatigue.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: If I start taking iron, will I feel better immediately?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You may notice gradual improvement, but the response is not usually immediate. More importantly, we need to identify and control the cause of the blood loss.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What would you do if the bleeding became much heavier?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If you were soaking through pads repeatedly, became faint, developed severe weakness, or experienced significant shortness of breath, you would need urgent assessment.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand. I want to find out why this is happening.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. Please take a seat. What brings you in for a full assessment today?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've been feeling increasingly tired and short of breath for about a month, and the symptoms have become much more noticeable over the last week.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: When did you first notice the problem?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I first noticed it about four weeks ago. At that stage, I could still do everything normally, but I was getting tired earlier than usual.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Has the breathlessness been getting worse with exertion?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I've been becoming breathless much more easily, particularly when I climb stairs or walk quickly.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What happens during an episode?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: My heart starts beating faster, I feel light-headed, and I sometimes need to stop and rest.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you ever experienced anything similar?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I haven't.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Did anything happen before the symptoms began?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had been under considerable stress at work, but I hadn't had any major infection or acute illness.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Do you have any chronic conditions?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have hypertension, which has generally been controlled well.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Are you taking your medication regularly?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I usually take it every morning, although I've missed several doses recently.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: His blood pressure is 148 over 88, pulse 102, respiratory rate 20, and oxygen saturation 96% on room air.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed weight loss, bleeding, black stools, fever, cough, or swelling of your legs?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've lost about two kilograms without trying. I haven't noticed bleeding, black stools, or fever.

dialogue.label: Relative
dialogue.text: He has also looked unusually pale over the last few weeks.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Thank you. That is clinically relevant. I'm going to examine your heart, lungs, abdomen and peripheral circulation, and I'll check for pallor and signs of fluid retention.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What conditions are you considering?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We need to determine whether the symptoms are cardiovascular, hematological, respiratory, endocrine, metabolic, or related to another condition.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Should I prepare blood samples and an ECG?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. We'll request a full blood count, ferritin and iron studies, renal and thyroid function, glucose, electrolytes, and an ECG.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Could this be anemia?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It could be. However, given the exertional symptoms and tachycardia, we also need to exclude a cardiovascular cause.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Could it be something serious?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It could be, but we shouldn't make assumptions before we have the examination and investigation results.

dialogue.label: Relative
dialogue.text: What should he do while we're waiting?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: He should avoid strenuous activity until we have a clearer picture. If he develops severe chest pain, fainting, or significant difficulty breathing, he must seek emergency medical attention.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: And once the results are available?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Once we have the results, we'll review the findings together, narrow the differential diagnosis, and decide whether you need treatment, specialist referral, or further investigation.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'd rather find the cause than simply treat the symptoms.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Exactly. A good clinical assessment is about identifying the underlying cause and choosing the safest evidence-based management.

grammar.title: Grammar focus: Mixed Grammar / Revision
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect — hozirgi holat bilan bog'liq tajriba yoki holat. Present Perfect Continuous — o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon. Past Simple — o'tmishda aniq va tugallangan voqea. Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgan holat. Past Perfect Continuous — o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin davom etib kelgan jarayon. Passive Voice — kim bajarganidan ko'ra, tibbiy jarayon muhim bo'lganda. First Conditional — kelajakdagi real xavf yoki ehtimoliy vaziyat. Would rather — bir variantni boshqasidan afzal ko'rish. Bu modulda Mixed Grammar / Revision ishlatiladi. Asosiy maqsad — klinik konsultatsiyada avval o'tilgan grammatik strukturalarni birgalikda va tabiiy qo'llash: Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Simple, Past Perfect, Past Perfect Continuous, modal verbs, First Conditional, Passive Voice va "would rather". Asosiy klinik vazifa: simptomlarning davomiyligi va rivojlanishini aniqlash, avvalgi voqealarni tasvirlash, ehtimoliy sabablarni muhokama qilish, tekshiruv va xavfsizlik bo'yicha ko'rsatmalarni professional tarzda ifodalash.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect используется для опыта или состояния, связанного с настоящим: I haven't noticed bleeding. Present Perfect Continuous используется для действия, которое началось в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента: I've been feeling increasingly tired for a month. Past Simple используется для завершённого действия в прошлом: I first noticed it four weeks ago. Past Perfect показывает, что одно действие произошло раньше другого действия в прошлом: I hadn't had any major infection before the symptoms began. Passive Voice используется, когда важен медицинский процесс: Blood samples will be taken.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect — an experience or state connected to the present. Present Perfect Continuous — a process that started in the past and continues now. Past Simple — a definite, completed past event. Past Perfect — a state that happened before another past event. Past Perfect Continuous — a process that had been continuing before another past event. Passive Voice — when the medical procedure matters more than who performs it. First Conditional — a real future risk or likely situation. Would rather — preferring one option to another. This module revises mixed grammar: the aim is to use previously studied structures together and naturally in a clinical consultation — Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Simple, Past Perfect, Past Perfect Continuous, modal verbs, First Conditional, Passive Voice and "would rather". Key clinical tasks: establishing the duration and progression of symptoms, describing earlier events, discussing possible causes, and giving investigation and safety-netting instructions professionally.

grammar.title: Present Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: • Positive: subject + have/has + past participle | • Negative: subject + have/has not + past participle | • Question: Have/Has + subject + past participle...?
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: O'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgi holat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan tajriba yoki holatni bildiradi. Bemorning avval shunga o'xshash holatni boshdan kechirgan-kechirmaganini so'raydi. Hozirgacha kuzatilmagan simptomlarni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect связывает прошлое событие с настоящим: опыт, недавнее событие или результат, важный сейчас. При сборе анамнеза так спрашивают о симптомах вплоть до настоящего момента: «Have you had any fever?», «I have vomited three times». Причастие настоящего времени (-ing) описывает активный процесс («a spreading infection», «the patient lying in bed»); причастие прошедшего времени (V3) — состояние или результат («an infected wound», «samples taken immediately»). Они сокращают придаточные предложения. Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Present participles (-ing) describe an active process ("a spreading infection", "the patient lying in bed"); past participles (V3) describe a state or result ("an infected wound", "samples taken immediately"). They shorten relative clauses. Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: • Positive: subject + have/has + been + V-ing | • Negative: subject + have/has not + been + V-ing | • Question: Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing...?
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: O'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan yoki hozirgi holatga ta'sir qilayotgan jarayonni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect Continuous описывает действие, которое началось в прошлом и всё ещё продолжается (или только что закончилось и результат заметен). Ключевое время для длительности симптомов: «How long have you been feeling unwell?» — «I have been coughing for five days». Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

grammar.title: Past Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: • Positive: subject + V2 | • Negative: subject + did not + V1 | • Question: Did + subject + V1...?
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: O'tmishda aniq va tugallangan vaqtda sodir bo'lgan voqeani bildiradi. Aniq o'tgan vaqt — four weeks ago — bilan tugallangan voqea. Simptomlar boshlanishidan oldingi voqeani so'raydi. Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Simple описывает завершённые события в определённое время в прошлом: «The pain started yesterday», «When did you take the last dose?». Используется, когда время закончилось или названо. Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.

examples.sentence: I first noticed it about four weeks ago.
examples.translation_uz: Buni birinchi marta taxminan to'rt hafta oldin sezdim.
examples.translation_ru: Впервые я заметил это около четырёх недель назад.

examples.sentence: I didn't have any major infection.
examples.translation_ru: У меня не было серьёзной инфекции.

examples.sentence: Did anything happen before the symptoms began?

examples.translation_ru: Что-нибудь происходило до появления симптомов?

grammar.title: Past Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: • Positive: subject + had + past participle | • Negative: subject + had not + past participle
grammar.signal_words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi bir voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgan holatni bildiradi. Bu holat simptomlar boshlanishidan oldingi davrga tegishli. Signal so'zlar: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Perfect показывает, что одно действие в прошлом произошло раньше другого: «I had eaten a large meal before the pain started». Упорядочивает события в клинической хронологии. Причастие настоящего времени (-ing) описывает активный процесс («a spreading infection», «the patient lying in bed»); причастие прошедшего времени (V3) — состояние или результат («an infected wound», «samples taken immediately»). Они сокращают придаточные предложения. Сигнальные слова: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Perfect shows that one past action happened before another past action: "I had eaten a large meal before the pain started". It orders events in the clinical timeline. Present participles (-ing) describe an active process ("a spreading infection", "the patient lying in bed"); past participles (V3) describe a state or result ("an infected wound", "samples taken immediately"). They shorten relative clauses. Signal words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.

examples.note: • Negative: subject + had not + past participle

examples.sentence: Before the symptoms began, I had missed several doses.

examples.translation_ru: До появления симптомов я пропустил несколько доз.

examples.note_en: Shows which of two past events happened first.

grammar.title: Past Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: • Positive: subject + had + been + V-ing | • Negative: subject + had not + been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: for, since, before, until
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin ma'lum vaqt davom etib kelgan jarayonni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: for, since, before, until.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Perfect Continuous описывает действие, которое длилось некоторое время до другого события в прошлом: «I had been feeling dizzy for ten minutes before I collapsed». Подчёркивает длительность до ключевого события. Сигнальные слова: for, since, before, until.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Perfect Continuous describes an action that had been going on for some time before another past event: "I had been feeling dizzy for ten minutes before I collapsed". It stresses duration before the key event. Signal words: for, since, before, until.

examples.sentence: I had been experiencing considerable stress before the symptoms began.
examples.translation_uz: Simptomlar boshlanishidan oldin men kuchli stressni boshdan kechirgan edim.
examples.translation_ru: До появления симптомов я испытывал сильный стресс.

examples.sentence: I hadn't been taking my medication regularly.
examples.translation_ru: Я не принимал лекарства регулярно.
examples.note: • Negative: subject + had not + been + V-ing

grammar.title: Modal Verbs — Could — Should — Must
grammar.structure_pattern: • could + V1 | • should + V1 | • must + V1
grammar.signal_words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Can" qobiliyat, ruxsat va hozirgi ehtimollikni bildiradi ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" yumshoqroq, muloyimroq ("Could you describe the pain?") va o'tmishdagi qobiliyatni ifodalaydi. "Should" va "ought to" maslahat va tavsiya beradi — bemorga nima qilish kerakligini aytishning eng keng tarqalgan usuli: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal so'zlar: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «Can» выражает способность, разрешение и возможность в настоящем («DKA can become life-threatening»); «could» — более мягкий, вежливый вариант («Could you describe the pain?») и способность в прошлом. «Should» и «ought to» выражают совет и рекомендацию — самый частый способ сказать пациенту, что делать: «You should drink plenty of fluids», «You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice». Сигнальные слова: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: could — ehtimol / possibility; should — tavsiya; must — kuchli zarurat yoki majburiyat. Signal words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.

examples.sentence: Could this be anemia?
examples.translation_ru: Это может быть анемия?

examples.sentence: He should avoid strenuous activity.
examples.translation_uz: U og'ir jismoniy faoliyatdan saqlanishi kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Ему следует избегать интенсивной физической нагрузки.

examples.sentence: He must seek emergency medical attention.
examples.translation_uz: U shoshilinch tibbiy yordamga murojaat qilishi shart.
examples.translation_ru: Он должен обратиться за неотложной медицинской помощью.

grammar.title: First Conditional
grammar.structure_pattern: • If + Present Simple, subject + will / must / should + V1
grammar.signal_words: if, unless, as soon as, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Kelajakda real va mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. Safety-nettingda bemorga xavfli simptom paydo bo'lsa nima qilish kerakligini aytish uchun juda foydali. Signal so'zlar: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: First Conditional описывает реальную, возможную ситуацию в будущем и её результат. Врач использует его для предупреждений, планов и рекомендаций по безопасности: «If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately». После «if» «will» не ставится. Present Simple описывает привычные, регулярные действия, общие факты и постоянные состояния. В клинике используется для типичных симптомов («The pain usually starts at night»), регулярного приёма лекарств и общих медицинских фактов. Сигнальные слова: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: First Conditional describes a real, possible future situation and its result. Clinicians use it for warnings, plans and safety-netting: "If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately". Do not use "will" after "if". Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: if, unless, as soon as, when.

grammar.title: Passive Voice
grammar.structure_pattern: • Future Passive: will be + past participle | • Modal Passive: modal + be + past participle | • Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + past participle
grammar.signal_words: by, will be, has been, needs to be
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Passive Voice clinical Englishda ishni kim bajarayotganidan ko'ra, tibbiy jarayonning o'ziga urg'u berishda ishlatiladi. Qo'shimcha tekshiruv talab qilinishi mumkin. Signal so'zlar: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Passive Voice используется, когда важнее само действие или пациент, а не исполнитель — типично для анализов, процедур и плана лечения: «Blood samples will be taken», «You will be referred to a specialist», «The wound has been cleaned». «Will» выражает решение, принятое в момент речи, обещание, прогноз и успокоение пациента: «I will give you something for the pain», «The swelling will go down in a few days». Сигнальные слова: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Passive Voice is used when the action or the patient matters more than who performs it — typical for tests, procedures and treatment plans: "Blood samples will be taken", "You will be referred to a specialist", "The wound has been cleaned". "Will" expresses decisions made now, promises, predictions and reassurance: "I will give you something for the pain", "The swelling will go down in a few days". Signal words: by, will be, has been, needs to be.

examples.sentence: Blood samples will be taken.
examples.translation_ru: Будут взяты образцы крови.
examples.note: • Future Passive: will be + past participle

examples.sentence: Further investigation may be required.

examples.note: • Modal Passive: modal + be + past participle

examples.translation_ru: Установлен внутривенный доступ.

examples.note: Qo'shimcha tekshiruvlar uchun qon namunalari olinadi.

grammar.title: "would Rather"
grammar.structure_pattern: • subject + would rather + V1 + than + V1
grammar.signal_words: preference
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ikki variantdan birini afzal ko'rishni bildiradi. Men faqat simptomlarni davolashdan ko'ra sababini aniqlashni afzal ko'raman. Signal so'zlar: preference.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Я предпочёл бы найти причину, а не просто лечить симптомы. Сигнальные слова: preference.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Would rather + V1" and "would prefer to + V1" express preference politely: "I would rather save the tooth than extract it", "Would you prefer a crown or an implant?"

grammar.title: Mixed Grammar — Clinical Comparison
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Zamonlarni klinik gaplarda yonma-yon solishtiring: hozirgacha kuzatilmagan holat uchun Present Perfect ("I haven't noticed bleeding"), o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan simptom uchun Present Perfect Continuous ("I've been feeling increasingly tired for a month"), aniq o'tgan vaqtdagi tugallangan voqea uchun Past Simple ("I first noticed it four weeks ago").
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сравните времена в клинических предложениях: Present Perfect — состояние, не наблюдавшееся до настоящего момента («I haven't noticed bleeding»), Present Perfect Continuous — симптом, начавшийся в прошлом и продолжающийся сейчас («I've been feeling increasingly tired for a month»), Past Simple — завершённое событие в определённое время в прошлом («I first noticed it four weeks ago»).
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Compare the tenses side by side in clinical sentences: Present Perfect for something not observed up to now ("I haven't noticed bleeding"), Present Perfect Continuous for a symptom that started in the past and continues ("I've been feeling increasingly tired for a month"), and Past Simple for a completed event at a definite past time ("I first noticed it four weeks ago").

grammar.title: Common Mistakes
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: holat hozirgacha davom etmoqda. modal verbdan keyin to ishlatilmaydi. First Conditionalda if-clause ichida Present Simple ishlatiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Самые частые ошибки студентов в грамматике этого модуля с исправленным клиническим вариантом.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: davomiy simptom uchun Present Perfect Continuous + for. Future Passive = will be + past participle. would rather + V1.

common_mistakes.incorrect: I am feeling tired since a month.
common_mistakes.correct: I've been feeling tired for a month.

common_mistakes.incorrect: How long are you feeling breathless?
common_mistakes.correct: How long have you been feeling breathless?

common_mistakes.incorrect: He should to avoid strenuous activity.
If he will develop chest pain, he must seek help.
common_mistakes.correct: If he develops chest pain, he must seek help.

grammar.title: Learning Tip
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Avval vaqt va signal so'zlariga e'tibor bering: for a month, four weeks ago, before, ever, since, once, if. Keyin gapning ma'nosini aniqlang: davom etayotgan simptom bo'lsa Present Perfect Continuous, aniq o'tgan voqea bo'lsa Past Simple, o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldingi holat bo'lsa Past Perfect yoki Past Perfect Continuous, tibbiy jarayon muhim bo'lsa Passive Voice, xavfsizlik bo'yicha ko'rsatma bo'lsa First Conditional + modal verb ishlatiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сначала обратите внимание на слова времени и сигнальные слова: for a month, four weeks ago, before, ever, since, once, if. Затем определите смысл предложения: продолжающийся симптом → Present Perfect Continuous; конкретное прошедшее событие → Past Simple; состояние до другого события в прошлом → Past Perfect или Past Perfect Continuous; когда важна медицинская процедура → Passive Voice; инструкция по безопасности → First Conditional + модальный глагол.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: First pay attention to time and signal words: for a month, four weeks ago, before, ever, since, once, if. Then decide on the meaning of the sentence: an ongoing symptom → Present Perfect Continuous; a definite past event → Past Simple; a state before another past event → Past Perfect or Past Perfect Continuous; when the medical procedure matters → Passive Voice; a safety-netting instruction → First Conditional + modal verb.

practice.setting: general medical clinic / hospital admissions unit
practice.role_play: The student is the DOCTOR. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: James Carter
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative but anxious about the diagnosis

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I've been feeling increasingly tired and short of breath for about a month, and the symptoms have become much more noticeable over the last week.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. Please take a seat. What brings you in for a full assessment today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've been feeling increasingly tired and short of breath for about a month, and the symptoms have become much more noticeable over the last week.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When did you first notice the problem?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I first noticed it about four weeks ago. At that stage, I could still do everything normally, but I was getting tired earlier than usual.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Has the breathlessness been getting worse with exertion?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I've been becoming breathless much more easily, particularly when I climb stairs or walk quickly.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What happens during an episode?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: My heart starts beating faster, I feel light-headed, and I sometimes need to stop and rest.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you ever experienced anything similar?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I haven't.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did anything happen before the symptoms began?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had been under considerable stress at work, but I hadn't had any major infection or acute illness.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Do you have any chronic conditions?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I have hypertension, which has generally been controlled well.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Are you taking your medication regularly?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I usually take it every morning, although I've missed several doses recently.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you noticed weight loss, bleeding, black stools, fever, cough, or swelling of your legs?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've lost about two kilograms without trying. I haven't noticed bleeding, black stools, or fever.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you. That is clinically relevant. I'm going to examine your heart, lungs, abdomen and peripheral circulation, and I'll check for pallor and signs of fluid retention.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What conditions are you considering?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We need to determine whether the symptoms are cardiovascular, hematological, respiratory, endocrine, metabolic, or related to another condition.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Should I prepare blood samples and an ECG?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. We'll request a full blood count, ferritin and iron studies, renal and thyroid function, glucose, electrolytes, and an ECG.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Could this be anemia?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It could be. However, given the exertional symptoms and tachycardia, we also need to exclude a cardiovascular cause.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Could it be something serious?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It could be, but we shouldn't make assumptions before we have the examination and investigation results.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should he do while we're waiting?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: He should avoid strenuous activity until we have a clearer picture. If he develops severe chest pain, fainting, or significant difficulty breathing, he must seek emergency medical…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: And once the results are available?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Once we have the results, we'll review the findings together, narrow the differential diagnosis, and decide whether you need treatment, specialist referral, or further investigati…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: That makes sense. I'd rather find the cause than simply treat the symptoms.

questions_to_ask_doctor: What conditions are you considering?
Should I prepare blood samples and an ECG?
Could this be anemia?
Could it be something serious?
What should he do while we're waiting?

modules.description_uz: Bemor sovuq/issiq ta'sirida tishi og'rishidan shikoyat qiladi. Talaba og'riq turi, triggerlari, davomiyligi va kuchini aniqlaydi.
modules.description_ru: Модуль клинического общения: Зубная боль и чувствительность. Грамматика: Present Simple + Present Perfect + Past Simple + Past Continuous. Эталонный диалог, 29 терминов, 17 smart-фраз, 5 грамматических тем и симуляция с виртуальным пациентом.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. What brings you in today?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Good morning, Doctor. I've a toothache on the lower right side. The tooth has also become very sensitive.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. Can you tell me about your tooth pain?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It's usually a sharp pain, but sometimes it becomes throbbing. It comes and goes rather than being constant.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: How long have you had this pain?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've had this pain for about three days. It started gradually and has become worse over the last day.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Does it hurt when you eat or drink something cold or hot?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes, it does. Both cold and hot food or drinks can cause a sharp pain. Cold drinks usually make it worse, and the pain can be quite severe.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Where exactly do you feel the pain, and does it spread anywhere else?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It's around this tooth. Sometimes the pain radiates toward my jaw.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had any pain without eating or drinking anything?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I had some spontaneous pain last night while I was resting.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: How would you rate the worst pain on a scale of 0 to 10?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Around 7 out of 10.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: How long does the pain usually last after something triggers it?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Usually a few minutes. Then it gradually goes away.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Thank you. That gives me a clear picture of your symptoms. I'd like to examine the tooth now and check its sensitivity to cold and heat. I'll also check the area around the tooth to find the cause of the pain.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Okay, Doctor.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Please let me know if you feel any discomfort during the examination.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Of course.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. Let's take a look.

phrasebook.phrase: What brings you in today?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bugun sizni nima bezovta qilib, olib keldi?
phrasebook.patient_response: I've had a toothache on the lower right side.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Pastki o'ng tomonda tishim og'riyapti.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: У меня болит зуб с правой нижней стороны.

phrasebook.phrase: Can you tell me about your tooth pain?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /kæn juː tel mi əˈbaʊt jɔː tuːθ peɪn/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Tish og'rig'ingiz haqida aytib bera olasizmi?
phrasebook.patient_response: The tooth has also become very sensitive.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Tishim juda sezgir bo'lib qoldi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Зуб также стал очень чувствительным.

phrasebook.phrase: How long have you had this pain?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /haʊ lɒŋ hæv juː hæd ðɪs peɪn/
phrasebook.patient_response: I've had this pain for about three days.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Bu og'riq taxminan uch kundan beri bor.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Эта боль у меня около трёх дней.

phrasebook.phrase: When did the pain start?
phrasebook.patient_response: It started gradually.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: U asta-sekin boshlandi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Она началась постепенно.

phrasebook.phrase: Has it become worse?
phrasebook.patient_response: It has become worse over the last day.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Oxirgi bir kun ichida kuchaydi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: За последний день боль усилилась.

phrasebook.phrase: Does it hurt when you eat or drink something cold or hot?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /dʌz ɪt hɜːt wen juː iːt ɔː drɪŋk ˈsʌmθɪŋ kəʊld ɔː hɒt/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sovuq yoki issiq narsa yeb yoki ichganingizda og'riydimi?
phrasebook.patient_response: Both cold and hot food or drinks can cause a sharp pain.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Sovuq ham, issiq ovqat yoki ichimliklar ham o'tkir og'riq keltirib chiqaradi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: И холодная, и горячая еда или напитки могут вызвать острую боль.

phrasebook.phrase: What usually makes the pain worse?
phrasebook.patient_response: Cold drinks usually make it worse.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Sovuq ichimliklar odatda og'riqni kuchaytiradi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Холодные напитки обычно усиливают боль.

phrasebook.phrase: How would you describe the pain?
phrasebook.patient_response: It's usually a sharp pain, but sometimes it becomes throbbing.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Odatda o'tkir og'riq, ba'zan esa urib turadi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Обычно боль острая, но иногда она становится пульсирующей.

phrasebook.phrase: Is the pain constant?
phrasebook.patient_response: It comes and goes rather than being constant.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: U doimiy emas, kelib-ketib turadi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Она не постоянная, а периодически появляется и проходит.

phrasebook.phrase: How would you rate the worst pain on a scale of 0 to 10?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /haʊ wʊd juː reɪt ðə wɜːst peɪn ɒn ə skeɪl əv zɪərəʊ tə ten/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Eng kuchli og'riqni 0 dan 10 gacha necha ballga baholaysiz?
phrasebook.patient_response: Around 7 out of 10.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Taxminan 10 dan 7.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Примерно 7 из 10.

phrasebook.phrase: How severe is the pain?
phrasebook.patient_response: The pain can be quite severe.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Og'riq ancha kuchli bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Боль может быть довольно сильной.

phrasebook.phrase: Where exactly do you feel the pain?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /weər ɪɡˈzæktli dʊ juː fiːl ðə peɪn/
phrasebook.patient_response: It's around this tooth.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Mana shu tish atrofida.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Болит вокруг этого зуба.

phrasebook.phrase: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
phrasebook.patient_response: Sometimes the pain radiates toward my jaw.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Ba'zan og'riq jag'im tomon tarqaladi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Иногда боль отдаёт в сторону челюсти.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had any pain without eating or drinking anything?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæv juː hæd ˈeni peɪn wɪˈðaʊt ˈiːtɪŋ ɔː ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ˈeniθɪŋ/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hech narsa yemay yoki ichmay turganingizda ham og'riq bo'lganmi?
phrasebook.patient_response: I had some spontaneous pain last night while I was resting.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Kecha dam olayotganimda o'z-o'zidan og'riq bo'ldi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Вчера вечером во время отдыха у меня возникла самопроизвольная боль.

phrasebook.phrase: How long does the pain usually last after something triggers it?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /haʊ lɒŋ dʌz ðə peɪn ˈjuːʒuəli lɑːst/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biror narsa og'riqni qo'zg'atgandan keyin u odatda qancha davom etadi?
phrasebook.patient_response: Usually a few minutes. Then it gradually goes away.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Odatda bir necha daqiqa. Keyin asta-sekin yo'qoladi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Обычно несколько минут. Затем боль постепенно проходит.

phrasebook.phrase: Please let me know if you feel any discomfort during the examination.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /pliːz let miː nəʊ ɪf juː fiːl ˈeni dɪsˈkʌmfət/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Tekshiruv vaqtida noqulaylik sezsangiz, menga ayting.
phrasebook.patient_response: Okay, Doctor.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Xo'p, doktor.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Хорошо, доктор.

phrasebook.phrase: I'd like to examine the tooth now.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪd laɪk tə ɪɡˈzæmɪn ðə tuːθ naʊ/
phrasebook.patient_response: Of course.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Albatta.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Конечно.

grammar.title: Present Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V1 (he/she/it + V-s) | Do/Does + subject + V1?
grammar.signal_words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qachon ishlatiladi? Bemor og'riq odatda qanday bo'lishini yoki nima sababdan kuchayishini aytganda. Matndan misol / Пример из диалога: "Cold drinks usually make it worse." Sovuq ichimliklar odatda og'riqni kuchaytiradi. U doimiy emas, kelib-ketib turadi. Signal so'zlar: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Когда используется? Когда пациент говорит о том, что обычно происходит, или что обычно усиливает боль. Холодные напитки обычно усиливают боль. Она не постоянная, а периодически появляется и проходит. 🔑 Oson eslab qoling / Запомните: usually, sometimes → ko'pincha Present Simple. Ya'ni odatiy holat / то есть обычная или повторяющаяся ситуация. Сигнальные слова: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.title_uz: Present Simple — odatiy yoki takroriy holat

grammar.title: Present Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: for + vaqt
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qachon ishlatiladi? Og'riq oldin boshlangan, lekin hozir ham bor bo'lsa. Matndan misol / Пример из диалога: "I've had this pain for about three days." Bu og'riq taxminan uch kundan beri bor. Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Когда используется? Когда боль началась раньше, но продолжается сейчас. Эта боль у меня около трёх дней. Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

examples.sentence: for three days = uch kundan beri.
examples.translation_ru: for three days = уже три дня / в течение трёх дней.

grammar.title_uz: Present Perfect — o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat

grammar.title: Past Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V2 (V-ed) | Did + subject + V1? | was / were
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qachon ishlatiladi? O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va tugagan voqeani aytganda. Matndan misol / Пример из диалога: "It started gradually." Matndan yana bir misol / Ещё один пример из диалога: "I had some spontaneous pain last night." 🔑 last night, yesterday, ago → o'tmish / прошлое → ko'pincha Past Simple. Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Когда используется? Когда говорится о событии, которое произошло в прошлом. Вчера вечером у меня возникла самопроизвольная боль. Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.

examples.sentence: U asta-sekin boshlandi.
examples.translation_ru: Она началась постепенно.

grammar.title: Past Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: was / were + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: while, when, at that moment, all morning
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu dialogda: "while I was resting" shaklida ishlatilgan. Ya'ni og'riq paydo bo'lgan paytda bemor dam olayotgan edi. Matndan misol / Пример из диалога: "while I was resting" Signal so'zlar: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: В диалоге используется в выражении "while I was resting". То есть в тот момент, когда появилась боль, пациент отдыхал. когда я отдыхал(а) / пока я отдыхал(а) Сигнальные слова: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Continuous describes an action in progress at a moment in the past, often interrupted by a Past Simple event: "I was carrying boxes when I suddenly felt chest pain". It gives the background of the onset. Signal words: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.title_uz: Past Continuous — o'tmishda ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakat

grammar.title: Quick reference
grammar.structure_pattern: • for + vaqt | • was/were + -ing
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: • usually / sometimes → odatda nima bo'ladi? → Present Simple • last night / yesterday → qachon bo'ldi? → Past Simple Asosiysi: barcha grammatik qoidalarni darhol eslab qolish shart emas. Avval signal so'zni (usually, for, last night, was + -ing) toping, keyin gapning ma'nosini aniqlang.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: 6. Eng muhim farq / Самая важная разница В первом случае: боль всё ещё есть. Во втором: внимание на момент, когда боль началась. 7. Mini-qoida / Мини-правило Главное: не нужно сразу вспоминать все грамматические правила. Сначала найдите сигнал (usually, for, last night, was + -ing), затем определите смысл.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: • for + vaqt | • was/were + -ing.

practice.setting: dental clinic
practice.role_play: The student is the DENTIST. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Daniel Brooks
patient_profile.personality_trait: nervous about dental treatment, sensitive to pain

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good morning, Doctor. I've a toothache on the lower right side. The tooth has also become very sensitive.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. What brings you in today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good morning, Doctor. I've a toothache on the lower right side. The tooth has also become very sensitive.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. Can you tell me about your tooth pain?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It's usually a sharp pain, but sometimes it becomes throbbing. It comes and goes rather than being constant.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How long have you had this pain?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've had this pain for about three days. It started gradually and has become worse over the last day.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Does it hurt when you eat or drink something cold or hot?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes, it does. Both cold and hot food or drinks can cause a sharp pain. Cold drinks usually make it worse, and the pain can be quite severe.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Where exactly do you feel the pain, and does it spread anywhere else?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It's around this tooth. Sometimes the pain radiates toward my jaw.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had any pain without eating or drinking anything?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I had some spontaneous pain last night while I was resting.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How would you rate the worst pain on a scale of 0 to 10?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Around 7 out of 10.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How long does the pain usually last after something triggers it?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Usually a few minutes. Then it gradually goes away.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you. That gives me a clear picture of your symptoms. I'd like to examine the tooth now and check its sensitivity to cold and heat. I'll also check the area around the tooth…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Okay, Doctor.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Please let me know if you feel any discomfort during the examination.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Of course.

modules.title: Tooth Extraction
modules.description: Bemor tish oldirish kerakligi sababli murojaat qiladi. Talaba jarayonni tushuntiradi, xavotirlarini aniqlaydi va savollariga javob beradi.
modules.description_uz: Bemor tish oldirish kerakligi sababli murojaat qiladi. Talaba jarayonni tushuntiradi, xavotirlarini aniqlaydi va savollariga javob beradi.
modules.description_ru: Модуль клинического общения: Удаление зуба. Грамматика: Present Perfect Continuous + Future Simple. Эталонный диалог, 46 терминов, 14 smart-фраз, 5 грамматических тем и симуляция с виртуальным пациентом.
modules.description_en: Clinical communication module: Tooth Extraction. Grammar focus: Present Perfect Continuous + Future Simple. Includes a reference doctor–patient dialogue, 46 vocabulary items, 14 smart phrases, 5 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. Please have a seat. What seems to be the problem?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, doctor. I've been having severe pain in my lower right tooth for the last few days. It has become difficult to eat and sleep.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: When did the pain first start, and has it been getting worse recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It started about three days ago, and unfortunately, it has become much worse since yesterday.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Does anything make the pain worse, such as chewing or putting pressure on the tooth?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. It hurts a lot when I chew on that side, so I've been trying to use the other side of my mouth.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Let me examine the tooth. I may also need to take an X-ray to see what is happening underneath the gum.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you think the tooth can be saved?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Unfortunately, the tooth is badly damaged, and the infection has affected the surrounding area. In this case, extraction may be the safest option.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'm a little nervous about having it removed. Will it be painful?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Don't worry. We'll use a local anaesthetic to numb the area. You may feel some pressure during the extraction, but you shouldn't feel any sharp pain.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: How long will the procedure take?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If everything goes as expected, it should take around 20 to 30 minutes. However, the exact time depends on the position and condition of the tooth.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Is there anything I need to do before the procedure?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. Please tell me if you are taking any medications or if you have any allergies.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'm not allergic to any medication, and I'm not taking anything regularly.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. I'll give you the local anaesthetic now. Please let me know if you feel any pain during the procedure.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: All right, doctor.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: The tooth has been removed successfully. I'm placing a piece of gauze over the extraction site. Bite down on it firmly for about 30 to 45 minutes.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I avoid after the extraction?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Avoid smoking, drinking alcohol, and eating very hot or hard food for at least the first 24 hours. Also, don't rinse your mouth vigorously because it can disturb the blood clot.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Can I brush my teeth tonight?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes, but be very gentle around the extraction site. You should also avoid touching the area with your tongue or fingers.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What if the pain gets worse later?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Some pain and swelling are normal after an extraction. You can take the painkiller I recommend. However, if you develop severe swelling, persistent bleeding, fever, or increasing pain after a few days, contact the clinic immediately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Thank you, doctor. That makes me feel much more comfortable.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Follow the aftercare instructions carefully, and you should recover well.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + have/has + been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat yoki harakatni ifodalaydi. Dialogdan misol 2: "I've been trying to use the other side of my mouth." Og'zimning boshqa tomonidan foydalanishga harakat qilyapman. Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: действие или состояние началось в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента. Подлежащее + have/has + been + V-ing Я стараюсь пользоваться другой стороной рта. Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

examples.sentence: I've been having severe pain in my lower right tooth for the last few days.

grammar.title: Future Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + will + V1
grammar.signal_words: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: kelajakdagi harakat, reja, qaror yoki kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan holatni ifodalaydi. Signal so'zlar: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: действие, решение или событие, которое произойдёт в будущем. Подлежащее + will + V1 Сигнальные слова: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Will" expresses decisions made now, promises, predictions and reassurance: "I will give you something for the pain", "The swelling will go down in a few days". Signal words: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.

Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect Continuous описывает действие, которое началось в прошлом и всё ещё продолжается (или только что закончилось и результат заметен). Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". "Will" expresses decisions made now, promises, predictions and reassurance: "I will give you something for the pain", "The swelling will go down in a few days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

practice.setting: dental clinic
practice.role_play: The student is the DENTIST. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Michael Reed
patient_profile.personality_trait: nervous about dental treatment, sensitive to pain

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good afternoon, doctor. I've been having severe pain in my lower right tooth for the last few days. It has become difficult to eat and sleep.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good afternoon. Please have a seat. What seems to be the problem?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good afternoon, doctor. I've been having severe pain in my lower right tooth for the last few days. It has become difficult to eat and sleep.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When did the pain first start, and has it been getting worse recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It started about three days ago, and unfortunately, it has become much worse since yesterday.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Does anything make the pain worse, such as chewing or putting pressure on the tooth?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. It hurts a lot when I chew on that side, so I've been trying to use the other side of my mouth.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Let me examine the tooth. I may also need to take an X-ray to see what is happening underneath the gum.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Okay. Do you think the tooth can be saved?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Unfortunately, the tooth is badly damaged, and the infection has affected the surrounding area. In this case, extraction may be the safest option.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'm a little nervous about having it removed. Will it be painful?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Don't worry. We'll use a local anaesthetic to numb the area. You may feel some pressure during the extraction, but you shouldn't feel any sharp pain.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: How long will the procedure take?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If everything goes as expected, it should take around 20 to 30 minutes. However, the exact time depends on the position and condition of the tooth.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is there anything I need to do before the procedure?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. Please tell me if you are taking any medications or if you have any allergies.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'm not allergic to any medication, and I'm not taking anything regularly.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good. I'll give you the local anaesthetic now. Please let me know if you feel any pain during the procedure.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: All right, doctor.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: The tooth has been removed successfully. I'm placing a piece of gauze over the extraction site. Bite down on it firmly for about 30 to 45 minutes.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should I avoid after the extraction?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Avoid smoking, drinking alcohol, and eating very hot or hard food for at least the first 24 hours. Also, don't rinse your mouth vigorously because it can disturb the blood clot.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Can I brush my teeth tonight?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes, but be very gentle around the extraction site. You should also avoid touching the area with your tongue or fingers.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What if the pain gets worse later?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Some pain and swelling are normal after an extraction. You can take the painkiller I recommend. However, if you develop severe swelling, persistent bleeding, fever, or increasing…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Thank you, doctor. That makes me feel much more comfortable.

Will it be painful?

Is there anything I need to do before the procedure?
What should I avoid after the extraction?
