phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо рассмотреть несколько возможных причин.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to distinguish between a viral and a bacterial infection.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wiː niːd tə dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ bɪˈtwiːn ə ˈvaɪrəl ənd ə bækˈtɪəriəl ɪnˈfekʃən/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Virusli va bakterial infeksiyani farqlashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо различить вирусную и бактериальную инфекцию.

phrasebook.phrase: This rash does not have the typical appearance of chickenpox.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðɪs ræʃ dʌz nɒt hæv ðə ˈtɪpɪkəl əˈpɪərəns əv ˈtʃɪkɪnpɒks/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu toshma suvchechakning odatiy ko'rinishiga ega emas.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Эта сыпь не имеет типичного вида ветряной оспы.

phrasebook.phrase: The distribution of the rash is important.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðə ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃən əv ðə ræʃ ɪz ɪmˈpɔːtənt/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Важно расположение сыпи.

phrasebook.phrase: The appearance of the lesions can help us identify the cause.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ði əˈpɪərəns əv ðə ˈliːʒənz kən help ʌs aɪˈdentɪfaɪ ðə kɔːz/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Toshma elementlarining ko'rinishi sababni aniqlashga yordam beradi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Внешний вид элементов сыпи может помочь определить причину.

phrasebook.phrase: An antibiotic is not necessarily required.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Antibiotik har doim ham kerak bo'lavermaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Антибиотик не обязательно требуется.

phrasebook.phrase: An antibiotic is appropriate only for a bacterial infection that requires treatment.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ən ˌæntibaɪˈɒtɪk ɪz əˈprəʊpriət ˈəʊnli fə ə bækˈtɪəriəl ɪnˈfekʃən/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Antibiotik faqat antibiotik bilan davolashni talab qiladigan bakterial infeksiyada mos keladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Антибиотик показан только при бактериальной инфекции, требующей лечения.

phrasebook.phrase: If the illness is viral, antibiotics will not treat the underlying cause.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪf ði ˈɪlnəs ɪz ˈvaɪrəl ˌæntibaɪˈɒtɪks wɪl nɒt triːt ði ˌʌndəˈlaɪɪŋ kɔːz/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar kasallik virusli bo'lsa, antibiotiklar asosiy sababni davolamaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если заболевание вирусное, антибиотики не лечат основную причину.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll carry out a careful examination.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz ehtiyotkorlik bilan klinik ko'rik o'tkazamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы проведём тщательное клиническое обследование.

phrasebook.phrase: We may arrange a throat swab if clinically indicated.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wiː meɪ əˈreɪndʒ ə θrəʊt swɒb ɪf ˈklɪnɪkli ˈɪndɪkeɪtɪd/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Klinik jihatdan zarur bo'lsa, tomoq surtmasini olamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: При наличии клинических показаний мы можем взять мазок из горла.

phrasebook.phrase: Avoid scratching the affected areas.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Избегайте расчёсывания поражённых участков.

phrasebook.phrase: Please monitor the rash closely.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Внимательно наблюдайте за сыпью.

grammar.title: A — An → the
grammar.structure_pattern: a/an + noun | the + noun
grammar.signal_words: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu klinik ingliz tilida juda muhim struktura. Signal so'zlar: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «A/an» вводит одно неопределённое исчисляемое существительное («a rash», «an infection»); «the» указывает на конкретное или уже упомянутое («the rash on his arm»). Без артикля — обобщённое множественное число и неисчисляемые («children need fluids»). This/that, these/those, each/every указывают на конкретные предметы. Сигнальные слова: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: a fever → the fever a rash → the rash a lesion → the lesion an infection → the infection a lymph node → the lymph node Signal words: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every.

examples.sentence: The child has a rash. The rash is spreading.
examples.translation_ru: У ребёнка сыпь. Сыпь распространяется.

grammar.title: This — That
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: THIS — yaqin turgan yoki hozir muhokama qilinayotgan bitta narsa. THAT — uzoqroq yoki oldin tilga olingan bitta narsa.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: THIS — этот / эта / это — используется для одного близкого или обсуждаемого предмета. THAT — тот / та / то — используется для одного более удалённого или ранее упомянутого предмета.

examples.sentence: This rash is quite itchy.
examples.translation_ru: Эта сыпь довольно сильно зудит.

examples.sentence: This rash does not have the typical appearance of chickenpox.
examples.translation_uz: Bu toshma suvchechakning odatiy ko'rinishiga ega emas.
examples.translation_ru: Эта сыпь не имеет типичного вида ветряной оспы.

examples.sentence: That area looks irritated.
examples.translation_ru: Тот участок выглядит раздражённым.

examples.sentence: That side of his neck feels tender.
examples.translation_uz: Uning bo'ynining ana u tomoni paypaslaganda og'riqli.
examples.translation_ru: Та сторона шеи болезненна при пальпации.

grammar.title: These — Those
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: THESE — yaqin yoki hozir ko'rsatilayotgan ko'plikdagi narsalar. THOSE — uzoqroq yoki boshqa guruhdagi ko'plikdagi narsalar.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: THESE — эти — для нескольких близких предметов. THOSE — те — для нескольких более удалённых предметов.

examples.sentence: These spots are small and pink.
examples.translation_uz: Bu toshma elementlari kichik va pushti rangda.
examples.translation_ru: Эти пятна небольшие и розовые.

examples.sentence: These areas look irritated.
examples.translation_ru: Эти участки выглядят раздражёнными.

examples.sentence: Those lesions are slightly larger.
examples.translation_ru: Те элементы сыпи немного крупнее.

examples.sentence: Those areas require closer examination.
examples.translation_uz: Ana u sohalar yanada sinchiklab tekshirilishi kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Те участки требуют более тщательного обследования.

grammar.title: Each
grammar.structure_pattern: EACH + singular noun
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: EACH — "har bir" degan ma'noni beradi va alohida-alohida shaxs yoki narsaga urg'u beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: EACH означает "каждый / каждая" и подчёркивает каждый отдельный объект. После each используется существительное в единственном числе.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: EACH + singular noun.

examples.sentence: Each type of rash has certain characteristics.
examples.translation_uz: Toshmaning har bir turi ma'lum xususiyatlarga ega.
examples.translation_ru: Каждый тип сыпи имеет определённые характеристики.

examples.sentence: Each lesion should be examined carefully.
examples.translation_uz: Har bir teri elementini diqqat bilan tekshirish kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Каждый элемент сыпи следует тщательно осмотреть.

examples.sentence: We need to assess each symptom carefully.
examples.translation_uz: Har bir simptomni diqqat bilan baholashimiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Нам необходимо внимательно оценить каждый симптом.

grammar.title: Every
grammar.structure_pattern: EVERY + singular noun
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: EVERY — "har bir / barcha" ma'nosida ishlatiladi, lekin ko'proq umumiy guruh haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: EVERY означает "каждый / всякий" и обычно используется, когда речь идёт обо всей группе в целом. После every существительное ham birlikda keladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: EVERY + singular noun.

examples.sentence: Every child should receive routine vaccinations.
examples.translation_uz: Har bir bola rejali emlashlarni olishi kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Каждый ребёнок должен получать плановые прививки.

examples.sentence: Every patient requires an individual assessment.
examples.translation_uz: Har bir bemor individual baholashni talab qiladi.
examples.translation_ru: Каждый пациент требует индивидуальной оценки.

grammar.title: Each vs Every
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: EACH: Har bir alohida EACH: Har bir lezyon EVERY: Har bir bola
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: EACH: Каждый отдельный EVERY: Каждый в целом

examples.sentence: Each lesion has a different appearance.
examples.translation_ru: Каждый элемент сыпи имеет различный внешний вид.

examples.sentence: Every child needs appropriate medical care.
examples.translation_uz: Har bir bola tegishli tibbiy yordamga muhtoj.
examples.translation_ru: Каждый ребёнок нуждается в соответствующей медицинской помощи.

grammar.title: Articles + Determiners — Clinical Pattern
grammar.structure_pattern: a / an + singular countable (first mention) | the + specific / known noun | no article + general plural / uncountable
grammar.signal_words: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Talaba quyidagi strukturalarni tayyor qolip sifatida o'zlashtirishi kerak: Signal so'zlar: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «A/an» вводит одно неопределённое исчисляемое существительное («a rash», «an infection»); «the» указывает на конкретное или уже упомянутое («the rash on his arm»). Без артикля — обобщённое множественное число и неисчисляемые («children need fluids»). This/that, these/those, each/every указывают на конкретные предметы. Сигнальные слова: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "A/an" introduces one non-specific countable noun ("a rash", "an infection"); "the" refers to something specific or already mentioned ("the rash on his arm"). No article is used for general plurals and uncountable nouns ("children need fluids"). This/that, these/those and each/every point to particular items. Signal words: a, an, the, this, that, these, those, each, every.

practice.setting: paediatric outpatient clinic / children's emergency department (the doctor talks to the parent)
practice.role_play: The student is the DOCTOR. You play the MOTHER of the sick child (speak about your child in the third person).

patient_profile.name: Grace Hughes
patient_profile.personality_trait: worried parent, wants clear explanations

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good morning, doctor. Yes. He has a high temperature, and a red rash appeared on his chest and back. The rash seems to be spreading to his arms and legs as well.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. Please have a seat. I understand you've brought your son in because of a fever and a skin rash. Could you tell me what concerns you most?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good morning, doctor. Yes. He has a high temperature, and a red rash appeared on his chest and back. The rash seems to be spreading to his arms and legs as well.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. Is the rash itchy, painful, or uncomfortable in any way?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: He says the rash is quite itchy. He keeps scratching these areas on his arms. That is what worries me because some of the spots look irritated.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I understand. Does he have a cough, a runny nose, or a sore throat?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: He has a sore throat and a runny nose. He also complains of a headache.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you. Let me examine him. I'm going to look at the rash closely. These spots are small and pink, while those on his legs are slightly larger. I also notice a few areas where…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Doctor, could this be an infection?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes, an infectious illness is one possibility. We need to consider several causes, including a viral infection and a bacterial infection. Each type of rash has certain characteris…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Does this rash look like measles or chickenpox?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: This rash does not have the typical appearance of chickenpox. With chickenpox, we usually expect a mixture of spots, fluid-filled blisters, and crusted lesions. The lesions often…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What about measles?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Measles can cause a widespread rash together with fever and respiratory symptoms. However, the distribution and appearance of the rash are important. We also need to ask about eac…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: He has received every routine childhood vaccination according to his schedule.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That is useful information. Has anyone in his school or family had a similar illness recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. A boy in his class had a fever and rash last week. The school informed parents about an infectious illness.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That information is important. We should also check the inside of his mouth and the lymph nodes in his neck. Please let me know if any of these areas are painful.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: He says this side of his neck feels slightly tender.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: All right. I can feel a mildly enlarged lymph node on the right side. I'll examine the rest of his skin as well.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Does he need an antibiotic?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Not necessarily. An antibiotic is appropriate only for a bacterial infection that requires antibiotic treatment. If the illness is viral, antibiotics will not treat the underlying…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand. What should we do now?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: First, we'll carry out a careful examination and assess his symptoms. We may also arrange a throat swab if clinically indicated. In the meantime, give him plenty of fluids and avo…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Thank you, doctor. I feel much less worried now.

Does this rash look like measles or chickenpox?
What about measles?
Does he need an antibiotic?
What should we do now?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. How can I help you today?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Good morning, doctor. I brought my daughter because she is due for several vaccinations, but I'm a little worried about possible side effects.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I understand your concern. Before we proceed, I'd like to review her vaccination record and make sure she is well enough to receive the vaccines today.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Are there any specific things I should know before the vaccination?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. Parents should inform the healthcare provider about any previous serious reaction to a vaccine. You ought to mention any known allergies or medical conditions as well.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: She doesn't have any known allergies. Does she have to receive all the vaccines listed in her schedule today?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Not necessarily. We have to follow the recommended vaccination schedule, but the exact vaccines given today depend on her age, previous doses, and current clinical assessment.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: What happens if she has a mild fever? Can she still be vaccinated?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: A mild illness does not always prevent vaccination, but we must assess her condition first. If she has a significant acute illness, we may decide to postpone the vaccination until she feels better.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: I see. What side effects may occur after vaccination?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: She may develop mild pain, redness, or swelling at the injection site. She may also have a low-grade fever or feel tired for a short period.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Is there anything I should do after the injection?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You should encourage her to drink plenty of fluids and allow her to rest. You can use a cool, clean cloth on the injection site if it feels uncomfortable.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Should I give her medicine before the vaccination to prevent fever?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Routine preventive medication is not usually necessary. You should give medication only according to appropriate medical advice.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: What symptoms must I watch for after we leave?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You must seek urgent medical attention if she develops difficulty breathing, facial swelling, severe weakness, or another serious reaction. These reactions are uncommon, but parents should know the warning signs.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: How long should I monitor her?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You should observe her for any unusual symptoms after vaccination. The healthcare team may also ask you to remain here for a short period after the injection.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Can she go to school tomorrow?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If she feels well, she can return to her normal activities. However, she should rest if she feels tired or uncomfortable.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Thank you, doctor. I feel much more confident now.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Vaccination is an important part of disease prevention. Parents ought to keep their child's vaccination record up to date, and they must inform healthcare professionals about any previous serious vaccine reaction.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: That makes sense. We'll make sure her vaccination schedule stays up to date.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Excellent. We can proceed with the vaccination after completing the final assessment.

phrasebook.phrase: I'd like to review her vaccination record.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men uning emlash kartasini ko'rib chiqmoqchiman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я хотел(а) бы ознакомиться с её картой вакцинации.

phrasebook.phrase: She is due for several vaccinations.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Unga bir nechta vaksinani olish vaqti kelgan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ей необходимо получить несколько вакцин в соответствии с графиком.

phrasebook.phrase: We have to follow the recommended vaccination schedule.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz tavsiya etilgan emlash jadvaliga rioya qilishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы должны соблюдать рекомендованный график вакцинации.

phrasebook.phrase: Let's review her previous vaccine doses.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Keling, uning oldingi vaksina dozalarini ko'rib chiqamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Давайте рассмотрим предыдущие дозы вакцин.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to assess her condition before vaccination.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Emlashdan oldin uning holatini baholashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо оценить её состояние перед вакцинацией.

phrasebook.phrase: Parents should inform the healthcare provider about any previous serious reaction.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ota-onalar ilgari kuzatilgan har qanday jiddiy reaksiya haqida tibbiyot xodimiga xabar berishlari kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Родители должны сообщить медицинскому работнику о любой предыдущей серьёзной реакции.

phrasebook.phrase: You ought to mention any known allergies.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Siz ma'lum allergiyalar haqida aytishingiz lozim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует сообщить об известных аллергиях.

phrasebook.phrase: We must assess her clinical condition first.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Avvalo uning klinik holatini baholashimiz shart.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сначала мы должны оценить её клиническое состояние.

phrasebook.phrase: A significant acute illness may require postponement of vaccination.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Jiddiy o'tkir kasallik emlashni kechiktirishni talab qilishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: При серьёзном остром заболевании вакцинацию, возможно, придётся отложить.

phrasebook.phrase: She may develop mild pain at the injection site.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ukol qilingan joyda yengil og'riq paydo bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: В месте инъекции может появиться лёгкая боль.

phrasebook.phrase: Mild redness or swelling may occur.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yengil qizarish yoki shish paydo bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Может появиться лёгкое покраснение или отёк.

phrasebook.phrase: She may feel tired for a short period.
phrasebook.translation_uz: U qisqa vaqt davomida charchoqni his qilishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Она может чувствовать усталость в течение короткого времени.

phrasebook.phrase: A low-grade fever may occur after vaccination.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Emlashdan keyin biroz isitma ko'tarilishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: После вакцинации может повыситься температура.

phrasebook.phrase: You should encourage her to drink plenty of fluids.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Unga ko'proq suyuqlik ichirishga harakat qilishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует поощрять её пить больше жидкости.

phrasebook.phrase: You should allow her to rest.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Unga dam olishiga imkon berishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует дать ей возможность отдохнуть.

phrasebook.phrase: You can use a cool, clean cloth on the injection site.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ukol qilingan joyga salqin, toza mato qo'yishingiz mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы можете приложить прохладную чистую ткань к месту инъекции.

phrasebook.phrase: You should monitor her for unusual symptoms.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Siz uni noodatiy belgilar paydo bo'lishiga nisbatan kuzatib borishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует наблюдать за ней на предмет необычных симптомов.

phrasebook.phrase: Routine preventive medication is not usually necessary.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Odatda profilaktik dori berish zarur emas.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Обычно профилактические препараты не требуются.

phrasebook.phrase: You must seek urgent medical attention if she develops difficulty breathing.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar unda nafas olish qiyinlashsa, zudlik bilan tibbiy yordamga murojaat qilishingiz shart.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если у неё появится затруднённое дыхание, вы должны срочно обратиться за медицинской помощью.

phrasebook.phrase: Seek immediate medical attention for facial swelling.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yuzda shish paydo bo'lsa, darhol tibbiy yordamga murojaat qiling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: При появлении отёка лица немедленно обратитесь за медицинской помощью.

phrasebook.phrase: Severe weakness requires urgent assessment.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kuchli holsizlik shoshilinch baholashni talab qiladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сильная слабость требует срочной медицинской оценки.

phrasebook.phrase: Parents should know the important warning signs.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ota-onalar muhim ogohlantiruvchi belgilarni bilishlari kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Родители должны знать основные предупреждающие признаки.

phrasebook.phrase: The healthcare team may ask you to remain here for a short period.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Tibbiyot xodimlari sizdan qisqa vaqt davomida shu yerda qolishingizni so'rashlari mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Медицинская команда может попросить вас остаться здесь на короткое время.

phrasebook.phrase: We should monitor her condition closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz uning holatini diqqat bilan kuzatishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам следует внимательно наблюдать за её состоянием.

phrasebook.phrase: You can return to normal activities if she feels well.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar o'zini yaxshi his qilsa, odatdagi faoliyatiga qaytishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если она хорошо себя чувствует, она может вернуться к обычной деятельности.

grammar.title: Should
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + should + Verb 1
grammar.signal_words: advice, recommendation
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Should — maslahat, tavsiya yoki ma'qul bo'lgan harakatni bildiradi. kerak, ma'qul, tavsiya etiladi. Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Should используется для выражения совета, рекомендации или желательного действия. Вам следует сообщить врачу. Сигнальные слова: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal words: advice, recommendation.

examples.sentence: You should inform the doctor.
examples.translation_ru: Правило на русском

examples.sentence: You should drink plenty of fluids.
examples.translation_uz: Siz ko'p miqdorda suyuqlik ichishingiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Вам следует пить много жидкости.

examples.sentence: You should monitor the injection site.
examples.translation_uz: Ukol qilingan joyni kuzatib borishingiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Вам следует наблюдать за местом инъекции.

grammar.title: Ought to
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + ought to + Verb 1
grammar.signal_words: advice, recommendation
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ought to ham maslahat yoki tavsiyani bildiradi. Should ga juda yaqin, lekin biroz rasmiyroq eshitiladi. Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Ought to выражает совет, рекомендацию или моральную/практическую необходимость. По значению оно близко к should, но звучит немного более формально. Сигнальные слова: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal words: advice, recommendation.

examples.sentence: Parents ought to mention any known allergies.
examples.translation_uz: Ota-onalar ma'lum allergiyalar haqida aytishlari lozim.
examples.translation_ru: Родителям следует сообщить об известных аллергиях.

grammar.title: Must
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + must + Verb 1
grammar.signal_words: necessity, obligation, prohibition
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Must kuchli majburiyat yoki qat'iy zaruratni bildiradi. shart, majbur, albatta kerak. Signal so'zlar: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Must выражает строгую необходимость, обязанность или обязательное действие. Сигнальные слова: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Must" expresses strong necessity from the speaker ("You must take the full course of antibiotics"); "have to" — an external rule or requirement. "Mustn't" means it is forbidden, while "don't have to" means it is not necessary. Signal words: necessity, obligation, prohibition.

examples.sentence: You must seek urgent medical attention.
examples.translation_uz: Siz zudlik bilan tibbiy yordamga murojaat qilishingiz shart.
examples.translation_ru: Вы должны срочно обратиться за медицинской помощью.

examples.sentence: We must assess the child before vaccination.
examples.translation_uz: Biz emlashdan oldin bolani baholashimiz shart.
examples.translation_ru: Мы должны оценить состояние ребёнка перед вакцинацией.

grammar.title: Have to
grammar.structure_pattern: must + V1 | have to / has to + V1 | mustn't + V1 (prohibition) | don't have to + V1 (not necessary)
grammar.signal_words: necessity, obligation, prohibition
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Have to tashqi talab, qoida, protokol yoki zaruriyat sababli bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan harakatni bildiradi. majbur bo'lmoq, kerak bo'lmoq. MUST: Ichki/qat'iy zarurat HAVE TO: Tashqi talab yoki qoida MUST: Biz bolani baholashimiz shart. HAVE TO: Biz protokolga rioya qilishimiz kerak. Signal so'zlar: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Have to выражает обязанность, которая связана с правилом, инструкцией, протоколом или внешним требованием. MUST: Внутренняя/строгая необходимость HAVE TO: Внешнее требование или правило Сигнальные слова: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Must" expresses strong necessity from the speaker ("You must take the full course of antibiotics"); "have to" — an external rule or requirement. "Mustn't" means it is forbidden, while "don't have to" means it is not necessary. Signal words: necessity, obligation, prohibition.

examples.translation_uz: Biz emlash jadvaliga rioya qilishimiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Мы должны соблюдать график вакцинации.

We have to follow the protocol.

grammar.title: CAN
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + can + Verb 1
grammar.signal_words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Can" qobiliyat, ruxsat va hozirgi ehtimollikni bildiradi ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" yumshoqroq, muloyimroq ("Could you describe the pain?") va o'tmishdagi qobiliyatni ifodalaydi. Signal so'zlar: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: «Can» выражает способность, разрешение и возможность в настоящем («DKA can become life-threatening»); «could» — более мягкий, вежливый вариант («Could you describe the pain?») и способность в прошлом. Сигнальные слова: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Can" expresses ability, permission and present possibility ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" is more tentative or polite ("Could you describe the pain?") and refers to past ability. Signal words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.

examples.sentence: You can use a cool, clean cloth.
examples.translation_uz: Siz salqin, toza matodan foydalanishingiz mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Вы можете использовать прохладную чистую ткань.

grammar.title: MAY
grammar.structure_pattern: may / might + V1 | may / might + have + V3 (past possibility)
grammar.signal_words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: May asosan ehtimollik yoki ayrim holatlarda rasmiy ruxsatni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: May используется прежде всего для выражения возможности или вероятности, а также формального разрешения. Сигнальные слова: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "May" and "might" express possibility and cautious clinical judgement: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" also gives polite permission. "Might have + V3" refers to a possible past event. Signal words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.

examples.sentence: She may develop mild redness.
examples.translation_uz: Unda yengil qizarish paydo bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: У неё может появиться лёгкое покраснение.

grammar.title: CAN vs MAY
grammar.structure_pattern: can / could + V1 | Can you …? | Could you …, please? | may / might + V1 | may / might + have + V3 (past possibility)
grammar.signal_words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Can" qobiliyat, ruxsat va hozirgi ehtimollikni bildiradi ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" yumshoqroq, muloyimroq ("Could you describe the pain?") va o'tmishdagi qobiliyatni ifodalaydi. "May" va "might" ehtimollik va ehtiyotkor klinik xulosani bildiradi: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" muloyim ruxsat ham beradi. "Might have + V3" — o'tmishdagi ehtimol. Signal so'zlar: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: CAN чаще обозначает возможность или разрешение. MAY чаще обозначает вероятность или формальное разрешение. Сигнальные слова: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: CAN → ruxsat / imkoniyat Signal words: ability, permission, polite request, possibility.

grammar.title: Mustn't and Don't Have to
grammar.structure_pattern: must + V1 | have to / has to + V1 | mustn't + V1 (prohibition) | don't have to + V1 (not necessary)
grammar.signal_words: necessity, obligation, prohibition
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu ikki shaklni adashtirmaslik juda muhim. Mustn't = qilish taqiqlangan Don't have to = qilish shart emas MUSTN'T = TAQIQLANADI 🚫 Signal so'zlar: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: mustn't = нельзя, запрещено don't have to = не нужно, не обязательно Сигнальные слова: necessity, obligation, prohibition.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Must" expresses strong necessity from the speaker ("You must take the full course of antibiotics"); "have to" — an external rule or requirement. "Mustn't" means it is forbidden, while "don't have to" means it is not necessary. Signal words: necessity, obligation, prohibition.

grammar.title: The verb after a modal

grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Modal fe'ldan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi. Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: После большинства модальных глаголов используется начальная форма глагола без to. Сигнальные слова: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal words: advice, recommendation.

grammar.title: Clinical vaziyatlarda modal verbs
grammar.structure_pattern: modal (can / could / may / might / must / should / have to) + V1
grammar.signal_words: possibility, advice, necessity, permission
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: 🧠 Qisqa yodlash formulasi MUST → qat'iy majburiyat HAVE TO → qoida yoki tashqi talab Signal so'zlar: possibility, advice, necessity, permission.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Модальные глаголы передают отношение говорящего: возможность (may, might, could), способность/разрешение (can, could), совет (should, ought to), обязанность (must, have to) и запрет (mustn't). После модального глагола всегда стоит начальная форма. Сигнальные слова: possibility, advice, necessity, permission.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: OUGHT TO → lozimlik CAN → ruxsat / imkoniyat Signal words: possibility, advice, necessity, permission.

patient_profile.name: Sophie Turner
patient_profile.personality_trait: worried parent, wants clear explanations

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good morning, doctor. I brought my daughter because she is due for several vaccinations, but I'm a little worried about possible side effects.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. How can I help you today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good morning, doctor. I brought my daughter because she is due for several vaccinations, but I'm a little worried about possible side effects.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I understand your concern. Before we proceed, I'd like to review her vaccination record and make sure she is well enough to receive the vaccines today.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Are there any specific things I should know before the vaccination?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. Parents should inform the healthcare provider about any previous serious reaction to a vaccine. You ought to mention any known allergies or medical conditions as well.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: She doesn't have any known allergies. Does she have to receive all the vaccines listed in her schedule today?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Not necessarily. We have to follow the recommended vaccination schedule, but the exact vaccines given today depend on her age, previous doses, and current clinical assessment.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What happens if she has a mild fever? Can she still be vaccinated?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: A mild illness does not always prevent vaccination, but we must assess her condition first. If she has a significant acute illness, we may decide to postpone the vaccination until…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I see. What side effects may occur after vaccination?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: She may develop mild pain, redness, or swelling at the injection site. She may also have a low-grade fever or feel tired for a short period.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is there anything I should do after the injection?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You should encourage her to drink plenty of fluids and allow her to rest. You can use a cool, clean cloth on the injection site if it feels uncomfortable.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Should I give her medicine before the vaccination to prevent fever?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Routine preventive medication is not usually necessary. You should give medication only according to appropriate medical advice.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What symptoms must I watch for after we leave?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You must seek urgent medical attention if she develops difficulty breathing, facial swelling, severe weakness, or another serious reaction. These reactions are uncommon, but paren…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: How long should I monitor her?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You should observe her for any unusual symptoms after vaccination. The healthcare team may also ask you to remain here for a short period after the injection.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Can she go to school tomorrow?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If she feels well, she can return to her normal activities. However, she should rest if she feels tired or uncomfortable.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Thank you, doctor. I feel much more confident now.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: You're welcome. Vaccination is an important part of disease prevention. Parents ought to keep their child's vaccination record up to date, and they must inform healthcare professi…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: That makes sense. We'll make sure her vaccination schedule stays up to date.

Does she have to receive all the vaccines listed in her schedule today?
What happens if she has a mild fever?
Can she still be vaccinated?
What side effects may occur after vaccination?

modules.grammar_focus: Comparatives & Superlatives — smaller, taller, more nutritious, the most important

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. Please have a seat. I understand you're concerned about your son's growth and eating habits. Could you tell me what worries you most?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Good morning, doctor. Yes. He seems smaller than other children of the same age, and he is also a very selective eater. I'm worried that he may not be getting enough nutrients.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I understand your concern. Let's look at his growth measurements and compare them with the expected range for his age. How would you describe his appetite?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: His appetite is quite limited. He prefers bread, rice and sweets, but he refuses vegetables, meat and most dairy products.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. Compared with a balanced diet, his current diet sounds less nutritious. A variety of foods is generally more beneficial for healthy growth and development.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Does his height seem normal for his age?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: His height is slightly below the average for his age group, but his weight is within an acceptable range. We should consider his growth pattern rather than focusing on a single measurement.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Could his diet be affecting his growth?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It could be one contributing factor. Protein-rich foods, vegetables, fruits and dairy products provide more essential nutrients than foods that are high in sugar and low in nutritional value.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: What should I give him to help him grow taller?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Instead of focusing on one particular food, I would recommend a more balanced and nutrient-dense diet. Foods containing adequate protein, calcium, iron and other essential nutrients are particularly important.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: He usually drinks juice instead of milk. Is that a problem?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Large amounts of juice can be less nutritious than a balanced meal and may reduce his appetite for other foods. Water and nutritious meals should be the main components of his daily diet.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Which nutrients are the most important for his development?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Several nutrients are important, but adequate protein, iron, calcium and vitamin D are among the most important. They support physical growth, bone development and overall health.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: He also seems less active than some children in his class. Should I be worried?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We should assess his developmental progress as well. Physical activity, communication skills and social interaction are all important aspects of child development.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Is there anything I can do at home?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. Offer smaller portions more frequently and introduce a wider variety of nutritious foods. Try to make mealtimes relaxed rather than stressful.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Should I force him to finish everything on his plate?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I would avoid that. A child may eat better when meals are calm and predictable. It is often more effective to offer healthy choices than to create pressure around food.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: When should we come back for another assessment?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: A follow-up assessment can help us determine whether his growth is progressing appropriately. We can compare his height and weight with his previous measurements and review his nutritional intake.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Thank you, doctor. I feel much more reassured now.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Remember, healthy growth is influenced by several factors, and nutrition is one of the most important. Our goal is to support steady growth, healthy development and good eating habits.

phrasebook.phrase: Could you tell me what worries you most?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizni eng ko'p nima tashvishga solayotganini ayta olasizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Можете рассказать, что вас больше всего беспокоит?

phrasebook.phrase: He seems smaller than other children of the same age.
phrasebook.translation_uz: U xuddi shu yoshdagi boshqa bolalarga qaraganda kichikroq ko'rinadi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он выглядит меньше других детей того же возраста.

phrasebook.phrase: He is also a very selective eater.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он очень привередлив в еде.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm worried that he may not be getting enough nutrients.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men u yetarli oziq moddalarni olmayotganidan xavotirdaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я беспокоюсь, что он может получать недостаточно питательных веществ.

phrasebook.phrase: How would you describe his appetite?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как бы вы описали его аппетит?

phrasebook.phrase: Let's look at his growth measurements.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Keling, uning o'sish ko'rsatkichlarini ko'rib chiqamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Давайте посмотрим на показатели его роста.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to compare them with the expected range for his age.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz ularni uning yoshiga mos kutilayotgan diapazon bilan taqqoslashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо сравнить их с ожидаемым диапазоном для его возраста.

phrasebook.phrase: His height is slightly below the average for his age group.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uning bo'yi yosh guruhiga nisbatan o'rtacha ko'rsatkichdan biroz past.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его рост немного ниже среднего показателя для его возрастной группы.

phrasebook.phrase: His weight is within an acceptable range.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его вес находится в приемлемом диапазоне.

phrasebook.phrase: We should consider his growth pattern rather than a single measurement.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bitta o'lchovga emas, uning o'sish dinamikasiga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам следует учитывать динамику его роста, а не один отдельный показатель.

phrasebook.phrase: His current diet sounds less nutritious.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uning hozirgi ovqatlanishi kamroq to'yimli ko'rinadi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его нынешний рацион выглядит менее питательным.

phrasebook.phrase: A variety of foods is more beneficial for healthy growth.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Turli xil oziq-ovqatlar sog'lom o'sish uchun foydaliroq.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Разнообразное питание более полезно для здорового роста.

phrasebook.phrase: He needs a more balanced and nutrient-dense diet.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Unga yanada muvozanatli va oziq moddalarga boy ovqatlanish kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ему необходим более сбалансированный и богатый питательными веществами рацион.

phrasebook.phrase: Protein-rich foods provide essential nutrients.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Oqsilga boy oziq-ovqatlar muhim oziq moddalarni ta'minlaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Продукты, богатые белком, обеспечивают организм необходимыми питательными веществами.

phrasebook.phrase: Adequate protein is one of the most important nutrients for growth.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yetarli oqsil o'sish uchun eng muhim oziq moddalardan biridir.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Достаточное количество белка — одно из самых важных питательных веществ для роста.

phrasebook.phrase: Adequate protein is particularly important for growth.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yetarli oqsil o'sish uchun ayniqsa muhim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Достаточное количество белка особенно важно для роста.

phrasebook.phrase: Calcium is important for bone development.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Кальций важен для развития костей.

phrasebook.phrase: Iron is an essential nutrient for a growing child.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Temir o'sayotgan bola uchun muhim oziq moddalardan biridir.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Железо является необходимым питательным веществом для растущего ребёнка.

phrasebook.phrase: Vitamin D also plays an important role in healthy development.
phrasebook.translation_uz: D vitamini ham sog'lom rivojlanishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Витамин D также играет важную роль в здоровом развитии.

phrasebook.phrase: Offer smaller portions more frequently.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Предлагайте небольшие порции чаще.

phrasebook.phrase: Introduce a wider variety of nutritious foods.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вводите более разнообразные питательные продукты.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to make mealtimes relaxed rather than stressful.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ovqatlanish vaqtini stressli emas, xotirjam qilishga harakat qiling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Старайтесь сделать приёмы пищи спокойными, а не стрессовыми.

phrasebook.phrase: I would avoid forcing him to finish everything on his plate.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men uni likopchasidagi hamma narsani tugatishga majburlamaslikni tavsiya qilgan bo'lardim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я бы не рекомендовал заставлять его доедать всё на тарелке.

phrasebook.phrase: It is often more effective to offer healthy choices.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sog'lom tanlovlarni taklif qilish ko'pincha samaraliroq bo'ladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Часто более эффективно предлагать полезные варианты еды.

phrasebook.phrase: We should assess his developmental progress as well.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz uning rivojlanish jarayonini ham baholashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам также следует оценить прогресс его развития.

phrasebook.phrase: Physical activity is an important aspect of child development.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Jismoniy faollik bola rivojlanishining muhim jihatidir.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Физическая активность является важным аспектом развития ребёнка.

phrasebook.phrase: Communication skills are also important.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Навыки общения также важны.

phrasebook.phrase: Social interaction is another important area of development.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ijtimoiy muloqot rivojlanishning yana bir muhim sohasidir.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Социальное взаимодействие — ещё одна важная область развития.

phrasebook.phrase: A follow-up assessment can help us evaluate his growth.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qayta baholash uning o'sishini baholashga yordam beradi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Повторная оценка поможет нам оценить его рост.

phrasebook.phrase: We can compare his height and weight with previous measurements.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz uning bo'yi va vaznini oldingi o'lchovlar bilan taqqoslashimiz mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы можем сравнить его рост и вес с предыдущими показателями.

phrasebook.phrase: We can also review his nutritional intake.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz uning oziq moddalarni qabul qilishini ham ko'rib chiqishimiz mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы также можем оценить его потребление питательных веществ.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to monitor his growth closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz uning o'sishini diqqat bilan kuzatishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо внимательно наблюдать за его ростом.

grammar.title: Comparative Degree
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + comparative adjective + than + noun
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Comparative degree ikki shaxs, narsa yoki holatni taqqoslash uchun ishlatiladi. O'zbek tilida odatda "-roq", "...dan ko'ra", "...ga qaraganda" ma'nolarini beradi. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень (Comparative) используется для сравнения двух людей, предметов или состояний. Обычно переводится как "более...", "...-ее", "чем". Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: He is taller than his brother.
examples.translation_ru: Он выше, чем его брат.

grammar.title: Short Adjectives + -Er
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qisqa sifatlarga -ER qo'shilishi Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarning ko'pchiligiga qiyosiy daraja hosil qilish uchun -er qo'shiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Краткие прилагательные + -ER У большинства коротких прилагательных для образования сравнительной степени добавляется -er.

examples.sentence: The child is smaller than his peers.
examples.translation_ru: Ребёнок меньше, чем его сверстники.

examples.sentence: His brother is taller than him.
examples.translation_ru: Его брат выше него.

grammar.title: More + Adjective
grammar.structure_pattern: more + adjective
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Uzun sifatlar bilan MORE Uzunroq, ayniqsa ikki yoki undan ortiq bo'g'inli sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasini hosil qilishda odatda: Uzbek: to'yimli → to'yimliligi yuqoriroq Uzbek: foydali → foydaliroq Uzbek: muhim → muhimroq
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: С длинными прилагательными, особенно состоящими из двух и более слогов, для образования сравнительной степени обычно используется: Russian: питательный → более питательный Russian: полезный → более полезный Russian: важный → более важный
grammar.rule_explanation_en: nutritious → more nutritious beneficial → more beneficial important → more important

examples.sentence: This meal is more nutritious than a sugary snack.
examples.translation_uz: Bu ovqat shirin gazakka qaraganda to'yimliroq.
examples.translation_ru: Это блюдо более питательное, чем сладкий перекус.

grammar.title: Less + Adjective
grammar.structure_pattern: less + adjective biror xususiyatning boshqa narsaga qaraganda kamroq ekanini bildiradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Structure: less + adjective biror xususiyatning boshqa narsaga qaraganda kamroq ekanini bildiradi..
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Меньшая степень — LESS less + adjective показывает, что признак выражен в меньшей степени, чем у другого объекта.

examples.sentence: Juice is less nutritious than a balanced meal.
examples.translation_uz: Sharbat muvozanatli ovqatga qaraganda kamroq to'yimli.
examples.translation_ru: Сок менее питателен, чем сбалансированное питание.

grammar.title: Comparative + Than
grammar.structure_pattern: adj + -er than / more + adj + than | the + adj-est / the most + adj | good → better → the best
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ikki narsa yoki shaxsni taqqoslashda qiyosiy darajadan keyin than ishlatiladi. than = ...dan ko'ra / ...ga qaraganda Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: При сравнении двух объектов после сравнительной степени используется than. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: His height is higher than expected.
examples.translation_ru: Его рост выше, чем ожидалось.

examples.sentence: This diet is more balanced than his previous diet.
examples.translation_uz: Bu parhez uning avvalgi parheziga qaraganda muvozanatliroq.
examples.translation_ru: Этот рацион более сбалансированный, чем его предыдущий рацион.

grammar.title: Superlative Degree
grammar.structure_pattern: adj + -er than / more + adj + than | the + adj-est / the most + adj | good → better → the best
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Superlative degree uch yoki undan ortiq shaxs, narsa yoki holat ichidan eng yuqori darajadagini ko'rsatadi. O'zbek tilida "eng..." deb tarjima qilinadi. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Превосходная степень (Superlative) используется, когда один объект выделяется среди трёх или более объектов. Обычно переводится как "самый", "наиболее". Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

grammar.title: The + Adjective-Est
grammar.structure_pattern: the + adjective + est
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qisqa sifatlarning orttirma darajasi
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Краткие прилагательные + -EST
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: the + adjective + est.

examples.sentence: He is the tallest child in the group.
examples.translation_ru: Он самый высокий ребёнок в группе.

grammar.title: The Most + Adjective
grammar.structure_pattern: the most + adjective
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: important → the most important nutritious → the most nutritious beneficial → the most beneficial
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: С длинными прилагательными превосходная степень образуется с помощью:
grammar.rule_explanation_en: important → the most important nutritious → the most nutritious beneficial → the most beneficial

examples.sentence: Uzun sifatlarning orttirma darajasi
examples.translation_ru: THE MOST + прилагательное

examples.sentence: Adequate protein is one of the most important nutrients for growth.
examples.translation_uz: Yetarli oqsil o'sish uchun eng muhim oziq moddalardan biridir.
examples.translation_ru: Достаточное количество белка — одно из самых важных питательных веществ для роста.

grammar.title: Irregular Forms
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Ba'zi sifatlar -er/-est yoki more/most qoidalariga bo'ysunmaydi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Некоторые прилагательные имеют особые формы.

examples.sentence: His appetite is better than before.
examples.translation_ru: Его аппетит лучше, чем раньше.

examples.sentence: This is the best option for his nutritional needs.
examples.translation_uz: Bu uning oziqaviy ehtiyojlari uchun eng yaxshi variant.
examples.translation_ru: Это лучший вариант для его потребностей в питании.

grammar.title: Much — Far + Comparative
grammar.structure_pattern: much + comparative | far + comparative
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: much va far qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: much и far используются перед сравнительной степенью для её усиления. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: He is much taller than his brother.
examples.translation_ru: Он намного выше, чем его брат.

examples.sentence: This diet is far more nutritious.
examples.translation_ru: Этот рацион значительно более питательный.

grammar.title: As ... As
grammar.structure_pattern: as + adjective + as ikki shaxs yoki narsaning bir xil darajadagi xususiyatini bildiradi. | not as + adjective + as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "такой же ... как".
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Конструкция as + adjective + as используется для выражения одинаковой степени признака.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: | not as + adjective + as.

examples.sentence: The child is as active as his peers.
examples.translation_ru: Ребёнок такой же активный, как его сверстники.

examples.sentence: His diet is not as nutritious as a balanced diet.
examples.translation_uz: Uning ovqatlanishi muvozanatli ovqatlanishdek to'yimli emas.
examples.translation_ru: Его рацион не такой питательный, как сбалансированное питание.

grammar.title: One of the Most + Adjective
grammar.structure_pattern: one of the most + adjective + plural noun | comparative + THAN | THE + -EST | THE MOST + adjective | much/far + comparative | as + adjective + as
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu klinik ingliz tilida juda foydali B2 darajadagi konstruktsiya. 🧠 QISQA YODLASH UCHUN Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень сравнивает два объекта («The pain is worse than yesterday», «more severe»); превосходная выделяет один из группы («the most important sign»). Короткие прилагательные получают -er/-est, длинные — more/most; good, bad, far — исключения. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: tall → taller → the tallest nutritious → more nutritious → the most nutritious Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: Nutrition is one of the most important factors in child development.
examples.translation_uz: Ovqatlanish bola rivojlanishidagi eng muhim omillardan biridir.
examples.translation_ru: Питание — один из самых важных факторов развития ребёнка.

practice.setting: paediatric outpatient clinic / children's emergency department (the doctor talks to the parent)
practice.role_play: The student is the DOCTOR. You play the MOTHER of the sick child (speak about your child in the third person).

patient_profile.name: Olivia Brooks
patient_profile.personality_trait: worried parent, wants clear explanations

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good morning, doctor. Yes. He seems smaller than other children of the same age, and he is also a very selective eater. I'm worried that he may not be getting enough nutrients.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. Please have a seat. I understand you're concerned about your son's growth and eating habits. Could you tell me what worries you most?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good morning, doctor. Yes. He seems smaller than other children of the same age, and he is also a very selective eater. I'm worried that he may not be getting enough nutrients.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I understand your concern. Let's look at his growth measurements and compare them with the expected range for his age. How would you describe his appetite?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: His appetite is quite limited. He prefers bread, rice and sweets, but he refuses vegetables, meat and most dairy products.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. Compared with a balanced diet, his current diet sounds less nutritious. A variety of foods is generally more beneficial for healthy growth and development.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Does his height seem normal for his age?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: His height is slightly below the average for his age group, but his weight is within an acceptable range. We should consider his growth pattern rather than focusing on a single me…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Could his diet be affecting his growth?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It could be one contributing factor. Protein-rich foods, vegetables, fruits and dairy products provide more essential nutrients than foods that are high in sugar and low in nutrit…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should I give him to help him grow taller?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Instead of focusing on one particular food, I would recommend a more balanced and nutrient-dense diet. Foods containing adequate protein, calcium, iron and other essential nutrien…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: He usually drinks juice instead of milk. Is that a problem?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Large amounts of juice can be less nutritious than a balanced meal and may reduce his appetite for other foods. Water and nutritious meals should be the main components of his dai…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Which nutrients are the most important for his development?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Several nutrients are important, but adequate protein, iron, calcium and vitamin D are among the most important. They support physical growth, bone development and overall health.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: He also seems less active than some children in his class. Should I be worried?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We should assess his developmental progress as well. Physical activity, communication skills and social interaction are all important aspects of child development.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is there anything I can do at home?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. Offer smaller portions more frequently and introduce a wider variety of nutritious foods. Try to make mealtimes relaxed rather than stressful.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Should I force him to finish everything on his plate?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I would avoid that. A child may eat better when meals are calm and predictable. It is often more effective to offer healthy choices than to create pressure around food.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: When should we come back for another assessment?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: A follow-up assessment can help us determine whether his growth is progressing appropriately. We can compare his height and weight with his previous measurements and review his nu…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Thank you, doctor. I feel much more reassured now.

Includes a reference doctor–patient dialogue, 51 vocabulary items, 34 smart phrases, 8 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.
modules.grammar_focus: Relative Clauses — who, which, that, whose, where

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. Please have a seat. I understand you've brought your son because you have some concerns about his speech and overall development. Could you tell me what worries you most?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Good morning, doctor. I'm mainly worried about his speech. He is almost two years old, but he uses only a few words. He also sometimes seems less responsive than other children his age.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. Let me ask you a few questions about his developmental milestones. Does he respond when you call his name?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Yes, he usually looks at me when I call him. He also understands simple instructions, which is reassuring.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That is useful information. What about his communication skills? Does he point to objects that he wants?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Yes. He points to things that he wants and uses gestures to communicate. He also makes eye contact with us.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. Those are important social-communication skills. I'd also like to ask about his motor development. Is he able to walk, run, and climb independently?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Yes. He walks and runs without assistance. He can also climb onto a chair and come down safely.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Excellent. Have you noticed any loss of skills that he previously had?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: No, I haven't noticed any loss of skills. My main concern is his speech, which seems delayed compared with other children.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Understood. We should assess the areas of development that are relevant to his age. I'd like to evaluate his receptive language, which refers to his ability to understand what other people say, as well as his expressive language, which refers to his ability to use words and sounds to communicate.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Could this mean that he has a neurological problem?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: A speech delay does not necessarily indicate a neurological disorder. There are several factors that can affect language development. We need to assess the child as a whole rather than focus on one developmental area.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: What kind of neurological signs would concern you?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We would pay particular attention to children who have significant muscle weakness, abnormal movements, seizures, problems with coordination, or a loss of developmental skills. These are features that may require further neurological assessment.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: He has never had a seizure, and I haven't noticed any unusual movements.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That is reassuring. I'd also like to ask about his hearing, because hearing difficulties can affect speech development. Has he had a hearing assessment?

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: No, he hasn't. We haven't arranged one yet.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: In that case, a hearing assessment would be useful. A child who has difficulty hearing certain sounds may have problems developing clear speech.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Should we see a neurologist as well?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We can consider a neurological assessment if we identify any signs that require specialist review. A developmental specialist, who can assess several areas of child development, may also be helpful.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: What should we do at home while we are waiting for the assessment?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Spend time communicating with him during everyday activities. Use simple language, give him opportunities to express his needs, and respond to the gestures and sounds that he uses.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Should we be worried that he will never speak normally?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It is too early to make that conclusion. Children develop at different rates, and the reasons for speech delay can vary considerably. What matters now is identifying the areas that need support and arranging appropriate assessment.

dialogue.label: Mother
dialogue.text: Thank you, doctor. I feel much less worried now.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: You're welcome. We'll arrange the appropriate assessments and monitor his developmental progress. If we identify an area that requires additional support, we'll explain the next steps clearly.
