phrasebook.phrase: The pain is more intense today.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сегодня боль сильнее.

phrasebook.phrase: Is the pain worse than yesterday?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Боль сильнее, чем вчера?

phrasebook.phrase: The back pain is much stronger.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Боль в спине намного сильнее.

phrasebook.phrase: The pain is more severe than before.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðə peɪn ɪz mɔː sɪˈvɪə ðæn bɪˈfɔː/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Боль сильнее, чем раньше.

phrasebook.phrase: Last night was probably the worst.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kecha kechasi ehtimol eng og'iri bo'ldi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Прошлая ночь, вероятно, была самой тяжёлой.

phrasebook.phrase: Does anything make the pain better?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Что-нибудь уменьшает боль?

phrasebook.phrase: Does anything make it worse?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Что-нибудь усиливает боль?

phrasebook.phrase: Sitting makes it worse.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сидение усиливает боль.

phrasebook.phrase: Movement makes the pain considerably worse.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Движение значительно усиливает боль.

phrasebook.phrase: Lying down is slightly more comfortable.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Лежать немного комфортнее.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you taken your pain medication?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы приняли обезболивающее?

phrasebook.phrase: It hasn't helped very much.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Оно не очень помогло.

phrasebook.phrase: Is the medication less effective than before?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪz ðə ˌmedɪˈkeɪʃən les ɪˈfektɪv ðæn bɪˈfɔː/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Лекарство менее эффективно, чем раньше?

phrasebook.phrase: It used to control the pain better.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪt juːst tə kənˈtrəʊl ðə peɪn ˈbetə/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Avvallari u og'riqni yaxshiroq nazorat qilardi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Раньше оно лучше контролировало боль.

phrasebook.phrase: Not necessarily.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Не обязательно.

phrasebook.phrase: It does not always mean that the disease has progressed.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪt dʌz nɒt ˈɔːlweɪz miːn ðæt ðə dɪˈziːz hæz prəˈɡrest/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu har doim ham kasallik rivojlanganini anglatmaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это не всегда означает прогрессирование заболевания.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to assess your symptoms carefully.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wiː niːd tə əˈses jɔː ˈsɪmptəmz ˈkeəfəli/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz simptomlaringizni diqqat bilan baholashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо тщательно оценить ваши симптомы.

phrasebook.phrase: I understand your concern.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я понимаю ваше беспокойство.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll document your pain level.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я зафиксирую уровень вашей боли.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll inform the doctor.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я сообщу врачу.

phrasebook.phrase: Your medication may need to be adjusted.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /jɔː ˌmedɪˈkeɪʃən meɪ niːd tə bi əˈdʒʌstɪd/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Dori davolashingizni o'zgartirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Возможно, потребуется скорректировать лечение.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll monitor you closely.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы будем тщательно за вами наблюдать.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll monitor you for side effects.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы будем наблюдать за вами на предмет побочных эффектов.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to find the most comfortable position.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /traɪ tə faɪnd ðə məʊst ˈkʌmftəbəl pəˈzɪʃən/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Eng qulay holatni topishga harakat qiling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Постарайтесь найти наиболее удобное положение.

phrasebook.phrase: Avoid movements that make the pain worse.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /əˈvɔɪd ˈmuːvmənts ðæt meɪk ðə peɪn wɜːs/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Избегайте движений, которые усиливают боль.

phrasebook.phrase: Let us know if the pain changes.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /let ʌs nəʊ ɪf ðə peɪn ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сообщите нам, если боль изменится.

phrasebook.phrase: Tell me immediately if the pain becomes worse.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /tel mi ɪˈmiːdiətli ɪf ðə peɪn bɪˈkʌmz wɜːs/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Og'riq kuchaysa, darhol menga xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите мне, если боль усилится.

phrasebook.phrase: Does anything make the pain better or worse?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biror narsa og'riqni kamaytiradimi yoki kuchaytiradimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Что-нибудь уменьшает или усиливает боль?

phrasebook.phrase: The medication is less effective than before.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Лекарство менее эффективно, чем раньше.

phrasebook.phrase: The pain is much worse today.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сегодня боль намного сильнее.

phrasebook.phrase: This is the worst pain I've had recently.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu yaqinda boshdan kechirgan eng kuchli og'riq.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это самая сильная боль, которую я испытывал за последнее время.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll document your pain level and inform the doctor.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Og'riq darajangizni qayd qilaman va shifokorga xabar beraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я зафиксирую уровень боли и сообщу врачу.

phrasebook.phrase: Your treatment may need to be adjusted.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Возможно, потребуется скорректировать лечение.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll monitor you closely for side effects.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizni nojo'ya ta'sirlar bo'yicha diqqat bilan kuzatamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы будем тщательно наблюдать за вами на предмет побочных эффектов.

phrasebook.phrase: Let us know if the pain changes or becomes stronger.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Og'riq o'zgarsa yoki kuchaysa, bizga xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сообщите нам, если боль изменится или усилится.

phrasebook.phrase: Tell us immediately if the pain is no longer controlled by medication.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar og'riq endi dori bilan nazorat qilinmasa, darhol bizga xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите нам, если боль больше не контролируется лекарством.

grammar.title: Comparative Adjectives
grammar.structure_pattern: adjective + -er + than | more + adjective + than
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qiyosiy daraja ikki kishi, narsa, holat yoki vaziyatni taqqoslash uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень используется для сравнения двух людей, предметов, состояний или ситуаций. С короткими прилагательными обычно используется -er + than. С более длинными прилагательными используется more + прилагательное + than. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparative adjectives are used to compare two people, things, conditions, or situations. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: Short adjectives usually take -er + than.
Longer adjectives usually use more + adjective + than.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: The back pain is stronger than the abdominal pain.
examples.translation_uz: Bel og'rig'i qorin og'rig'iga qaraganda kuchliroq.
examples.translation_ru: Боль в спине сильнее, чем боль в животе.

examples.sentence: The pain is more severe than before.
examples.translation_ru: Боль сильнее, чем раньше.

grammar.title: Superlative Adjectives — Orttirma daraja
grammar.structure_pattern: the + adjective-est | the most + adjective
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Orttirma daraja uch yoki undan ortiq kishi, narsa yoki holatni taqqoslab, ular orasidan eng yuqori yoki eng past darajani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. eng kuchli / og'ir og'riq 4. Irregular Comparatives & Superlatives — Noto'g'ri darajalar — Неправильные степени сравнения Ba'zi sifatlar -er/-est yoki more/most qoidasi asosida o'zgarmaydi. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Превосходная степень используется, когда мы сравниваем три или более людей, предметов или состояний и определяем самый высокий или самый низкий уровень. самая сильная / тяжёлая боль Некоторые прилагательные образуют сравнительную и превосходную степень особым образом. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: Superlatives are used when we compare three or more people, things, conditions, or situations and identify the one with the highest or lowest degree.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: The pain has become worse since last night.
examples.translation_ru: С прошлой ночи боль усилилась.

examples.sentence: Last night was probably the worst night I've had recently.
examples.translation_uz: Kecha yaqinda boshdan kechirgan eng og'ir tunim bo'ldi.
examples.translation_ru: Прошлая ночь, вероятно, была самой тяжёлой за последнее время.

grammar.title: Much + Comparative
grammar.structure_pattern: Much + comparative adjective is used to show that the difference is large or significant. | Much + qiyosiy daraja farqning ancha katta yoki sezilarli ekanini bildiradi.
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); orttirma daraja guruhdan bittasini ajratadi ("the most important sign"). Qisqa sifatlar -er/-est, uzunlari more/most oladi; good, bad, far — istisno. "Used to" hozir mavjud bo'lmagan o'tmishdagi odat yoki holatni bildiradi: "I used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day". O'tmishdagi turmush tarzi va avvalgi dorilar haqida so'rashda qulay. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Much + сравнительная степень показывает, что разница является значительной или большой. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. "Used to" describes past habits or states that are no longer true: "I used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day". It is useful for past lifestyle and previous medication. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: The back pain is much stronger than the abdominal pain.
examples.translation_uz: Bel og'rig'i qorin og'rig'iga qaraganda ancha kuchli.
examples.translation_ru: Боль в спине намного сильнее, чем боль в животе.

grammar.title: Slightly + Comparative — Biroz
grammar.structure_pattern: Slightly + comparative shows a small difference.
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); orttirma daraja guruhdan bittasini ajratadi ("the most important sign"). Qisqa sifatlar -er/-est, uzunlari more/most oladi; good, bad, far — istisno. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Slightly + сравнительная степень показывает небольшую разницу между двумя состояниями. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: Lying down is slightly more comfortable.
examples.translation_ru: Лежать немного комфортнее.

grammar.title: Considerably + Comparative — Sezilarli darajada
grammar.structure_pattern: Considerably + comparative means that something changes to a significant degree.
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); orttirma daraja guruhdan bittasini ajratadi ("the most important sign"). Qisqa sifatlar -er/-est, uzunlari more/most oladi; good, bad, far — istisno. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Considerably + сравнительная степень означает, что состояние изменилось значительно. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: Movement makes the pain considerably worse.
examples.translation_ru: Движение значительно усиливает боль.

grammar.title: Comparative + Than
grammar.structure_pattern: not as + adjective + as
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Than qiyosiy darajadan keyin kelib, nima yoki kim bilan taqqoslanayotganini ko'rsatadi. O'zbekchada odatda "-ga qaraganda", "-dan ko'ra" ma'nosini beradi. Rus tilida odatda "чем" bilan tarjima qilinadi. Not as ... as esa biror narsa boshqasichalik emasligini bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Than используется после сравнительной степени и показывает, с чем или кем производится сравнение. 9. As ... As — Teng darajadagi taqqoslash — Сравнение равной степени As + прилагательное + as используется для выражения равной степени. Not as ... as означает "не такой ... как". Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Than is used after a comparative adjective to identify the person, thing, or situation being compared. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

examples.sentence: The pain is more intense today than it was yesterday.
examples.translation_ru: Сегодня боль сильнее, чем вчера.

examples.sentence: The medication is less effective than it was before.
examples.translation_ru: Лекарство менее эффективно, чем раньше.

examples.sentence: As + adjective + as is used to say that two things are equal in a particular quality.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: The pain is not as severe as it was last night.
examples.translation_ru: Боль не такая сильная, как прошлой ночью.

examples.sentence: The medication is not as effective as before.
examples.translation_ru: Лекарство не такое эффективное, как раньше.

grammar.title: Make + Object + Adjective
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Structure: Make + object + adjective strukturasi biror narsa boshqa biror narsa yoki odamning holatini o'zgartirishga sabab bo'lishini bildiradi..
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Конструкция make + object + adjective означает, что что-то заставляет кого-то или что-то стать в определённом состоянии.

examples.sentence: The structure make + object + adjective means that one thing causes a person or another thing to become a particular state.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: Movement makes the pain worse.
examples.translation_ru: Движение усиливает боль.

examples.sentence: Sitting makes the pain worse.
examples.translation_ru: Сидение усиливает боль.

examples.sentence: The medicine makes me sleepy.
examples.translation_ru: Лекарство вызывает у меня сонливость.

grammar.title: Present Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: have/has + V3 | Subject + have/has + V3
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, lekin hozirgi holat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan o'zgarish yoki natijani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Since biror holat yoki harakatning qachondan boshlanganini ko'rsatadi. since last night — kecha kechqurundan beri — с прошлой ночи Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect используется для описания действия или изменения, которое произошло в прошлом, но имеет связь с настоящим результатом. Since указывает на момент начала действия или состояния. Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect is used to describe a change or situation that started in the past and has a connection with the present. Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

examples.sentence: The pain has become worse since last night.
examples.translation_ru: Боль усилилась с прошлой ночи.

examples.sentence: The pain has become worse.
examples.translation_ru: Боль усилилась.

examples.sentence: Since is used to show the starting point of an action or situation.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

grammar.title: Used to
grammar.structure_pattern: used to + V1 | didn't use to + V1 | verb + V-ing (avoid, stop, keep, recommend) | verb + to + V1 (need, want, decide, advise sb to)
grammar.signal_words: before, in the past, previously
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Used to" hozir mavjud bo'lmagan o'tmishdagi odat yoki holatni bildiradi: "I used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day". O'tmishdagi turmush tarzi va avvalgi dorilar haqida so'rashda qulay. Gerund (V-ing) ot vazifasida keladi va avoid, stop, keep, recommend fe'llari hamda predloglardan keyin ishlatiladi ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitiv (to + V1) need, want, decide, advise someone dan keyin keladi va maqsadni bildiradi ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal so'zlar: before, in the past, previously.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Used to + V1 описывает действие или состояние, которое было характерно для прошлого, но сейчас уже изменилось или не происходит. Сигнальные слова: before, in the past, previously.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Used to" describes past habits or states that are no longer true: "I used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day". It is useful for past lifestyle and previous medication. Gerunds (V-ing) act as nouns and follow verbs like avoid, stop, keep, recommend and prepositions ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitives (to + V1) follow need, want, decide, advise someone and express purpose ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal words: before, in the past, previously.

examples.sentence: Used to + V1 describes a past situation or habit that was true before but is not true or not the same now.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: It used to control the pain better.
examples.translation_uz: Avvallari u og'riqni yaxshiroq nazorat qilardi.
examples.translation_ru: Раньше оно лучше контролировало боль.

grammar.title: Modal Verb — May — Can
grammar.structure_pattern: may / might + V1 | may / might + have + V3 (past possibility) | can / could + V1 | Can you …? | Could you …, please?
grammar.signal_words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Can imkoniyat yoki qobiliyatni bildiradi. May ehtimolni bildiradi. Tibbiy va rasmiy ingliz tilida may juda ko'p ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Can выражает возможность или способность. May выражает вероятность или возможность. В медицинском и официальном английском языке may используется очень часто. Сигнальные слова: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "May" and "might" express possibility and cautious clinical judgement: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" also gives polite permission. "Might have + V3" refers to a possible past event. "Can" expresses ability, permission and present possibility ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" is more tentative or polite ("Could you describe the pain?") and refers to past ability. Signal words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.

examples.sentence: Can expresses possibility or ability.
May expresses possibility, especially in formal or clinical language.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: Movement can make the pain worse.
examples.translation_ru: Движение может усилить боль.

examples.sentence: Stronger medicines may cause more drowsiness.
examples.translation_uz: Kuchliroq dorilar ko'proq uyquchanlik keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Более сильные лекарства могут вызвать большую сонливость.

grammar.title: Should
grammar.structure_pattern: should / ought to + V1 | shouldn't + V1
grammar.signal_words: advice, recommendation
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Should" va "ought to" maslahat va tavsiya beradi — bemorga nima qilish kerakligini aytishning eng keng tarqalgan usuli: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Should + V1 используется для выражения совета, рекомендации или желательного действия. Сигнальные слова: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal words: advice, recommendation.

examples.sentence: Should + V1 is used to give advice or recommendations.
examples.translation_ru: Русское правило

examples.sentence: You should report any change in your pain.
examples.translation_uz: Og'riqdagi har qanday o'zgarish haqida xabar berishingiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Вы должны сообщить о любых изменениях боли.

grammar.title: First Conditional
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Present Simple, will + V1
grammar.signal_words: if, unless, as soon as, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: First Conditional kelajakda haqiqatan sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: First Conditional используется для выражения реального или возможного условия в будущем и его результата. Сигнальные слова: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: The First Conditional is used for a real or possible situation in the future. Signal words: if, unless, as soon as, when.

grammar.title: Passive Voice — Majhul nisbat
grammar.structure_pattern: be + V3 | 1. The pain is + comparative + than... | 2. The pain has become + comparative... | 3. Much + comparative
grammar.signal_words: by, will be, has been, needs to be
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Majhul nisbatda ish-harakatni kim bajargani emas, balki harakatning o'zi yoki natijasi muhim bo'ladi. Signal so'zlar: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Страдательный залог используется, когда само действие или его результат важнее того, кто выполняет действие. Сигнальные слова: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Passive Voice is used when the action or result is more important than the person who performs the action. Signal words: by, will be, has been, needs to be.

grammar.title: Slightly + comparative
grammar.structure_pattern: 5. Make + object + comparative
grammar.signal_words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); orttirma daraja guruhdan bittasini ajratadi ("the most important sign"). Qisqa sifatlar -er/-est, uzunlari more/most oladi; good, bad, far — istisno. Signal so'zlar: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень сравнивает два объекта («The pain is worse than yesterday», «more severe»); превосходная выделяет один из группы («the most important sign»). Короткие прилагательные получают -er/-est, длинные — more/most; good, bad, far — исключения. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

Короткие прилагательные получают -er/-est, длинные — more/most; good, bad, far — исключения. Сигнальные слова: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: than, the most, much / slightly + comparative, as … as.

grammar.title: If + Present Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Much + comparative | Slightly + comparative | Make + adjective
grammar.signal_words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Simple odatiy, takrorlanuvchi harakatlar, umumiy faktlar va doimiy holatlarni bildiradi. Klinikada odatdagi simptomlar ("The pain usually starts at night"), muntazam dori qabuli va umumiy tibbiy faktlar uchun ishlatiladi. Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); orttirma daraja guruhdan bittasini ajratadi ("the most important sign"). Qisqa sifatlar -er/-est, uzunlari more/most oladi; good, bad, far — istisno. Signal so'zlar: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Simple описывает привычные, регулярные действия, общие факты и постоянные состояния. В клинике используется для типичных симптомов («The pain usually starts at night»), регулярного приёма лекарств и общих медицинских фактов. Сравнительная степень сравнивает два объекта («The pain is worse than yesterday», «more severe»); превосходная выделяет один из группы («the most important sign»). Короткие прилагательные получают -er/-est, длинные — more/most; good, bad, far — исключения. Сигнальные слова: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Comparatives compare two things ("The pain is worse than yesterday", "more severe"); superlatives pick out one from a group ("the most important sign"). Short adjectives take -er/-est, longer ones use more/most; good, bad and far are irregular. Signal words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.

practice.setting: hospital ward (the nurse talks to the patient, relatives or the doctor)
practice.role_play: The student is a NURSE. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Mr. Jhon
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative, sometimes confused about instructions

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good morning. I'm not feeling very well. The pain has become worse since last night.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning, Mr. Jhon. How are you feeling today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good morning. I'm not feeling very well. The pain has become worse since last night.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me where the pain is strongest?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: The pain is strongest in my lower back. It is also spreading to my abdomen.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Is the pain in your back more severe than the pain in your abdomen?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. The back pain is much stronger than the abdominal pain.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. How would you describe the pain? Is it sharp, dull, burning, or aching?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It is mostly a dull, aching pain, but sometimes it becomes sharper.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When is the pain most severe — during the day or at night?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It is usually worse at night. Last night was probably the worst night I've had recently.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: On a scale from zero to ten, where zero means no pain and ten means the worst pain imaginable, how would you rate your pain now?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: At the moment, it is about seven out of ten. Yesterday, it was around five.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: So, your pain is more intense today than it was yesterday.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes, definitely. It is much more difficult to tolerate today.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Does anything make the pain better or worse?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Sitting makes it worse. Walking is also difficult, but lying down is slightly more comfortable.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Is the pain worse when you move than when you are resting?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. Movement makes the pain considerably worse.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you taken your prescribed pain medication?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes, I took it two hours ago, but it hasn't helped very much.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Is the medication less effective than it was before?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I think so. It used to control the pain better.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you for telling me. Your pain seems to be more severe and less well controlled than it was previously.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Nurse, does this mean that my cancer is getting worse?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Not necessarily. An increase in pain does not always mean that the disease itself has progressed. We need to assess your symptoms carefully and report any changes to the doctor.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What can we do to make the pain easier to manage?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I'll document your pain level and inform the doctor. The doctor may review your current pain medication and decide whether your treatment needs to be adjusted.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'm worried that stronger pain medicine will make me too sleepy.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I understand. Some stronger medicines can cause more drowsiness, but the doctor will choose the most appropriate treatment for you. We'll also monitor you closely for any side eff…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is there anything I can do to make the pain less severe?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Try to find the position that is most comfortable for you. Avoid movements that make the pain significantly worse, and let us know if the pain changes or becomes stronger.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand. I just want the pain to become less severe.

Is there anything I can do to make the pain less severe?

modules.grammar_focus: Cause & Effect: because, due to, therefore, as a result

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good morning, Mr. Smith. How are you feeling at the moment?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'm having difficulty breathing. I feel short of breath, especially when I try to walk.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. When did the breathing problem start?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It started last night, but it has become worse this morning.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Do you feel short of breath while you are resting, or does it mainly happen when you move?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I feel slightly short of breath even when I'm resting. It becomes much worse when I walk.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I see. Are you experiencing any chest pain?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I don't have chest pain, but I feel a tightness in my chest.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Are you coughing?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I've been coughing since yesterday, and I'm bringing up some thick mucus.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: What colour is the mucus?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It's yellowish. I also feel very tired because I haven't been sleeping well.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you had a fever?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I had a temperature of 38.2°C last night.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Thank you for telling me. Your breathing may be more difficult because of the infection and the mucus in your airways.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Is that why I'm feeling so short of breath?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: It could be. Your airways may be partially blocked by mucus. As a result, it can become harder for air to move in and out of your lungs.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand. What are you going to do?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: First, I'm going to check your oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, pulse, and blood pressure. Because you are experiencing shortness of breath, we need to monitor your condition closely.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will I need oxygen?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Your oxygen saturation is lower than expected, so I'm going to start oxygen therapy as prescribed.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will the oxygen help me breathe more easily?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: It should help improve the oxygen level in your blood. Due to your current breathing difficulty, oxygen may help reduce your shortness of breath. I'm going to give it to you through a nasal cannula. It has two small prongs that fit gently inside your nostrils.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Will it hurt?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: No, it shouldn't hurt. You may feel some cool air around your nose. Try to breathe normally through your nose.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I feel a little more comfortable now.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: That's good. Your oxygen saturation has improved slightly. Therefore, we'll continue to monitor your oxygen level and breathing.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Why do I need to keep the oxygen on?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Because your oxygen level can fall again if your breathing becomes more difficult. Keeping the oxygen in place helps maintain an adequate oxygen level.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Can I remove it when I need to go to the bathroom?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Please let us know before you remove it. Due to your current condition, your oxygen level needs to be monitored, especially when you are moving around.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I see. Is there anything else I can do?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Yes. Try to sit in an upright position because it can make breathing easier. Take slow, controlled breaths and try to cough gently to help clear the mucus.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'll try.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: If your breathing becomes significantly worse, you develop chest pain, become very dizzy, or feel that you cannot get enough air, tell me immediately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand. Thank you for helping me.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: You're welcome. We'll continue to monitor you closely, and I'll inform the doctor if your breathing does not improve.

phrasebook.phrase: How are you feeling at the moment?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /haʊ ə juː ˈfiːlɪŋ æt ðə ˈməʊmənt/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как вы себя чувствуете в данный момент?

phrasebook.phrase: When did the breathing problem start?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Когда начались проблемы с дыханием?

phrasebook.phrase: Do you feel short of breath while you are resting?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /duː juː fiːl ʃɔːt əv breθ waɪl juː ɑː ˈrestɪŋ/
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас возникает одышка в состоянии покоя?

phrasebook.phrase: Does it mainly happen when you move?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /dʌz ɪt ˈmeɪnli ˈhæpən wen juː muːv/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu asosan harakat qilganingizda yuz beradimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это в основном происходит, когда вы двигаетесь?

phrasebook.phrase: Are you experiencing any chest pain?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы испытываете боль в груди?

phrasebook.phrase: Are you coughing?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы кашляете?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had a fever?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас была температура?

phrasebook.phrase: I'm having difficulty breathing.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мне трудно дышать.

phrasebook.phrase: I feel short of breath.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я чувствую одышку.

phrasebook.phrase: It becomes much worse when I walk.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪt bɪˈkʌmz mʌtʃ wɜːs wen aɪ wɔːk/
phrasebook.translation_ru: При ходьбе становится значительно хуже.

phrasebook.phrase: I feel a tightness in my chest.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪ fiːl ə ˈtaɪtnəs ɪn maɪ tʃest/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я чувствую стеснение в груди.

phrasebook.phrase: I've been coughing since yesterday.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я кашляю со вчерашнего дня.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm bringing up some thick mucus.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У меня отходит густая мокрота.

phrasebook.phrase: I feel very tired.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я чувствую сильную усталость.

phrasebook.phrase: What colour is the mucus?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какого цвета мокрота?

phrasebook.phrase: Is the mucus thick or thin?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мокрота густая или жидкая?

phrasebook.phrase: What was your temperature?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какая у вас была температура?

phrasebook.phrase: How long have you had these symptoms?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu simptomlar qancha vaqtdan beri bor?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как давно у вас эти симптомы?

phrasebook.phrase: Your breathing may be more difficult because of the infection.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Infeksiya sababli nafasingiz qiyinlashgan bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваше дыхание может быть затруднено из-за инфекции.

phrasebook.phrase: The mucus may be affecting your breathing.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Balg'am nafas olishingizga ta'sir qilayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мокрота может влиять на ваше дыхание.

phrasebook.phrase: Your airways may be partially blocked by mucus.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Nafas yo'llaringiz shilimshiq bilan qisman to'silgan bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваши дыхательные пути могут быть частично заблокированы слизью.

phrasebook.phrase: As a result, it can become harder for air to move in and out of your lungs.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Natijada havoning o'pkaga kirib-chiqishi qiyinlashishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: В результате воздуху может стать труднее поступать в лёгкие и выходить из них.

phrasebook.phrase: Because you are experiencing shortness of breath, we need to monitor you closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Nafasingiz qisayotganligi sababli, sizni diqqat bilan kuzatishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Поскольку вы испытываете одышку, нам необходимо тщательно вас наблюдать.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to check your oxygen saturation.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я проверю вашу сатурацию кислорода.

phrasebook.phrase: Your oxygen saturation is lower than expected.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваша сатурация кислорода ниже ожидаемой.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to monitor your oxygen level closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kislorod darajangizni diqqat bilan kuzatishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо тщательно контролировать уровень кислорода.

phrasebook.phrase: Your oxygen saturation has improved slightly.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваша сатурация кислорода немного улучшилась.

phrasebook.phrase: Your oxygen level can fall again.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Уровень кислорода может снова снизиться.

phrasebook.phrase: Will I need oxygen?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мне понадобится кислород?

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to start oxygen therapy as prescribed.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Shifokor ko'rsatmasiga muvofiq kislorod terapiyasini boshlayman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я начну кислородотерапию согласно назначению врача.

phrasebook.phrase: Oxygen may help reduce your shortness of breath.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kislorod nafas qisishini kamaytirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Кислород может помочь уменьшить одышку.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to give it through a nasal cannula.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я буду подавать кислород через носовую канюлю.

phrasebook.phrase: It has two small prongs that fit inside your nostrils.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uning burun teshiklariga joylashtiriladigan ikkita kichik uch qismi bor.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У неё есть два небольших наконечника, которые помещаются в ноздри.

phrasebook.phrase: You may feel some cool air around your nose.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Burun atrofida salqin havo sezishingiz mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы можете почувствовать прохладный воздух вокруг носа.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to breathe normally through your nose.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Burun orqali odatdagidek nafas olishga harakat qiling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Постарайтесь нормально дышать через нос.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to sit in an upright position.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Постарайтесь сидеть в вертикальном положении.

phrasebook.phrase: Take slow, controlled breaths.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sekin va nazorat ostida nafas oling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Делайте медленные, контролируемые вдохи.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to cough gently.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Постарайтесь слегка покашлять.

phrasebook.phrase: Please let us know before you remove it.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uni yechishdan oldin, iltimos, bizga xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пожалуйста, сообщите нам, прежде чем снять его.

phrasebook.phrase: Keep the oxygen in place.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Оставьте кислород на месте.

phrasebook.phrase: Tell me immediately if your breathing becomes worse.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите мне, если ваше дыхание ухудшится.

phrasebook.phrase: If your breathing becomes significantly worse, tell me immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar nafasingiz sezilarli darajada yomonlashsa, darhol menga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если ваше дыхание значительно ухудшится, немедленно сообщите мне.

phrasebook.phrase: If you develop chest pain, tell me immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar ko'krak qafasida og'riq paydo bo'lsa, darhol menga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если у вас появится боль в груди, немедленно сообщите мне.

phrasebook.phrase: If you become very dizzy, tell me immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar boshingiz qattiq aylansa, darhol menga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если у вас возникнет сильное головокружение, немедленно сообщите мне.

phrasebook.phrase: If you feel that you cannot get enough air, tell me immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar yetarlicha havo ololmayotgandek his qilsangiz, darhol menga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если вы чувствуете, что не можете получить достаточно воздуха, немедленно сообщите мне.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll continue to monitor you closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizni diqqat bilan kuzatishda davom etamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы продолжим тщательно за вами наблюдать.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll continue to monitor your oxygen level and breathing.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kislorod darajangiz va nafas olishingizni kuzatishda davom etamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы продолжим контролировать уровень кислорода и ваше дыхание.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll inform the doctor if your breathing does not improve.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я сообщу врачу, если ваше дыхание не улучшится.

phrasebook.phrase: Your condition needs to be monitored closely.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваше состояние необходимо тщательно контролировать.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to assess your symptoms carefully.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо тщательно оценить ваши симптомы.

phrasebook.phrase: As a result, it can become harder to breathe.
phrasebook.translation_ru: В результате может стать труднее дышать.

phrasebook.phrase: Kislorod saturatsiyangiz kutilganidan past.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваша сатурация кислорода ниже ожидаемой.

grammar.title: Because — Chunki
grammar.structure_pattern: because + Subject + Verb
grammar.signal_words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bog'lovchilar klinik faktlarni mantiqan bog'laydi: sabab (because, since, due to), natija (therefore, as a result, so), qarama-qarshilik (although, however, while) va vaqt (when, while, as soon as). Ular qisqa gaplarni aniq klinik tushuntirishga aylantiradi. Signal so'zlar: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Because используется для выражения причины. После because употребляется полноценное предложение: подлежащее + сказуемое. Сигнальные слова: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Connectors link clinical facts logically: cause (because, since, due to), result (therefore, as a result, so), contrast (although, however, while) and time (when, while, as soon as). They turn short statements into clear clinical explanations. Signal words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.

examples.sentence: I feel very tired because I haven't been sleeping well.
examples.translation_uz: Men juda charchaganman, chunki yaxshi uxlay olmayapman.
examples.translation_ru: Я очень устал, потому что плохо сплю.

examples.sentence: Because you are experiencing shortness of breath, we need to monitor your condition closely.
examples.translation_uz: Nafasingiz qisayotganligi sababli, holatingizni diqqat bilan kuzatishimiz kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Поскольку вы испытываете одышку, нам необходимо тщательно наблюдать за вашим состоянием.

grammar.title: Because of — Sababli
grammar.structure_pattern: because of + noun / noun phrase
grammar.signal_words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Because of ham sababni bildiradi, lekin undan keyin ot yoki ot birikmasi keladi. Signal so'zlar: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Because of также выражает причину, но после него используется существительное или именная группа. Сигнальные слова: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Connectors link clinical facts logically: cause (because, since, due to), result (therefore, as a result, so), contrast (although, however, while) and time (when, while, as soon as). They turn short statements into clear clinical explanations. Signal words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.

examples.sentence: Your breathing may be more difficult because of the infection.
examples.translation_uz: Infeksiya sababli nafasingiz qiyinlashgan bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Ваше дыхание может быть затруднено из-за инфекции.

examples.sentence: Because you have an infection, your breathing is difficult.
examples.translation_uz: Sizda infeksiya bo'lgani uchun, nafasingiz qiyinlashgan.
examples.translation_ru: Поскольку у вас инфекция, вам трудно дышать.

examples.sentence: Because of the infection, your breathing is difficult.
examples.translation_ru: Из-за инфекции вам трудно дышать.

grammar.title: Due to — Sababli
grammar.structure_pattern: due to + noun / noun phrase
grammar.signal_words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Due to sababni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. U ayniqsa rasmiy, akademik va tibbiy ingliz tilida keng qo'llanadi. Signal so'zlar: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Due to выражает причину и особенно часто используется в официальной, академической и медицинской речи. Сигнальные слова: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Connectors link clinical facts logically: cause (because, since, due to), result (therefore, as a result, so), contrast (although, however, while) and time (when, while, as soon as). They turn short statements into clear clinical explanations. Signal words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.

examples.sentence: Due to your current breathing difficulty, oxygen may help reduce your shortness of breath.
examples.translation_uz: Hozirgi nafas olish qiyinligingiz sababli, kislorod nafas qisishini kamaytirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: В связи с вашей текущей затруднённостью дыхания кислород может помочь уменьшить одышку.

examples.sentence: Due to your current condition, your oxygen level needs to be monitored.
examples.translation_uz: Hozirgi holatingiz sababli, kislorod darajangizni kuzatib turish kerak.
examples.translation_ru: В связи с вашим текущим состоянием необходимо контролировать уровень кислорода.

grammar.title_ru: Due to — в связи с, из-за

grammar.title: As a Result — Natijada
grammar.structure_pattern: because / since / as + clause | due to / because of + noun | although / while + clause | therefore / as a result + clause
grammar.signal_words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: As a result oldingi gapda aytilgan sababning natijasini ko'rsatadi. Signal so'zlar: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: As a result используется для обозначения результата или последствия того, что было сказано ранее. Сигнальные слова: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Connectors link clinical facts logically: cause (because, since, due to), result (therefore, as a result, so), contrast (although, however, while) and time (when, while, as soon as). They turn short statements into clear clinical explanations. Signal words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.

examples.sentence: Cause. As a result, + Effect.
Your airways may be partially blocked by mucus. As a result, it can become harder for air to move in and out of your lungs.
examples.translation_uz: Nafas yo'llaringiz shilimshiq bilan qisman to'silib qolgan bo'lishi mumkin. Natijada, havoning o'pkaga kirib-chiqishi qiyinlashishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Дыхательные пути могут быть частично заблокированы слизью. В результате воздуху может стать труднее поступать в лёгкие и выходить из них.

grammar.title: Therefore
grammar.structure_pattern: because / since / as + clause | due to / because of + noun | although / while + clause | therefore / as a result + clause
grammar.signal_words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Therefore sababdan kelib chiqadigan natija yoki xulosani bildiradi. Bu so'z rasmiy va akademik nutqda ko'p ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Therefore используется для выражения результата или вывода. Это более формальное слово, часто используемое в академической и медицинской речи. Сигнальные слова: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Connectors link clinical facts logically: cause (because, since, due to), result (therefore, as a result, so), contrast (although, however, while) and time (when, while, as soon as). They turn short statements into clear clinical explanations. Signal words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.

examples.sentence: Your oxygen saturation has improved slightly. Therefore, we'll continue to monitor your oxygen level and breathing.
examples.translation_uz: Kislorod saturatsiyangiz biroz yaxshilandi. Shuning uchun kislorod darajangiz va nafas olishingizni kuzatishda davom etamiz.
examples.translation_ru: Ваша сатурация кислорода немного улучшилась. Поэтому мы продолжим контролировать уровень кислорода и ваше дыхание.

grammar.title: Cause & Effect
grammar.structure_pattern: because / since / as + clause | due to / because of + noun | although / while + clause | therefore / as a result + clause
grammar.signal_words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bog'lovchilar klinik faktlarni mantiqan bog'laydi: sabab (because, since, due to), natija (therefore, as a result, so), qarama-qarshilik (although, however, while) va vaqt (when, while, as soon as). Ular qisqa gaplarni aniq klinik tushuntirishga aylantiradi. Signal so'zlar: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Связующие слова логически соединяют клинические факты: причина (because, since, due to), следствие (therefore, as a result, so), противопоставление (although, however, while) и время (when, while, as soon as). Они превращают короткие фразы в ясное клиническое объяснение. Сигнальные слова: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Connectors link clinical facts logically: cause (because, since, due to), result (therefore, as a result, so), contrast (although, however, while) and time (when, while, as soon as). They turn short statements into clear clinical explanations. Signal words: because, due to, therefore, as a result, although, while, so that.

examples.sentence: The infection affects your breathing.
examples.translation_ru: Инфекция влияет на ваше дыхание.

examples.sentence: Because you have an infection, your breathing may become difficult.
examples.translation_uz: Infeksiya bo'lgani uchun nafasingiz qiyinlashishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Поскольку у вас инфекция, дыхание может затрудниться.

examples.sentence: Because of the infection, your breathing may become difficult.
examples.translation_ru: Из-за инфекции дыхание может затрудниться.

examples.sentence: Due to the infection, your breathing may become difficult.
examples.translation_ru: В связи с инфекцией дыхание может затрудниться.

examples.sentence: The airways are blocked. As a result, breathing becomes difficult.
examples.translation_uz: Nafas yo'llari to'silgan. Natijada nafas olish qiyinlashadi.
examples.translation_ru: Дыхательные пути заблокированы. В результате дыхание затрудняется.

examples.sentence: The oxygen saturation is low. Therefore, we need to monitor the patient.

examples.translation_ru: Сатурация кислорода низкая. Поэтому необходимо наблюдать за пациентом.

grammar.title: Present Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + am/is/are + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Continuous ayni vaqtda davom etayotgan harakat yoki holatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Continuous используется для обозначения действия или состояния, происходящего в данный момент. Сигнальные слова: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Continuous describes what is happening now or a temporary, changing situation: "His condition is getting worse", "I am going to examine you now". It is also used for the immediate plan of the clinician. Signal words: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.

examples.sentence: I'm having difficulty breathing.
examples.translation_ru: Мне трудно дышать.

examples.sentence: I'm bringing up some thick mucus.
examples.translation_ru: У меня отходит густая мокрота.

examples.sentence: I'm feeling short of breath.

grammar.title_uz: Present Continuous — Hozir Davom Etayotgan Holat

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + have/has + been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu zamon o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatni ifodalaydi. Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Это время используется для действия, которое началось в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента. Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

examples.sentence: I've been coughing since yesterday.
examples.translation_ru: Я кашляю со вчерашнего дня.

examples.sentence: She has been experiencing shortness of breath since yesterday.

grammar.title: May — Could
grammar.structure_pattern: may / might + V1 | may / might + have + V3 (past possibility) | can / could + V1 | Can you …? | Could you …, please?
grammar.signal_words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: May va could tibbiy vaziyatlarda ehtimoliy sabab yoki natijani ehtiyotkorlik bilan ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: May и could используются в медицинской речи для осторожного выражения возможной причины или результата. Сигнальные слова: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "May" and "might" express possibility and cautious clinical judgement: "It may be an infection", "You might need to stay in hospital". "May" also gives polite permission. "Might have + V3" refers to a possible past event. "Can" expresses ability, permission and present possibility ("DKA can become life-threatening"); "could" is more tentative or polite ("Could you describe the pain?") and refers to past ability. Signal words: possibly, perhaps, it is possible that.

examples.sentence: Your breathing may be more difficult because of the infection.
examples.translation_uz: Infeksiya sababli nafasingiz qiyinlashgan bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Ваше дыхание может быть затруднено из-за инфекции.

examples.sentence: Your airways could be partially blocked by mucus.
examples.translation_uz: Nafas yo'llaringiz shilimshiq bilan qisman to'silgan bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: Ваши дыхательные пути могут быть частично заблокированы слизью.

grammar.title: Should
grammar.structure_pattern: Should + V1 tavsiya yoki kutilayotgan natijani ifodalashi mumkin.
grammar.signal_words: advice, recommendation
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: "Should" va "ought to" maslahat va tavsiya beradi — bemorga nima qilish kerakligini aytishning eng keng tarqalgan usuli: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal so'zlar: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Should + V1 может выражать рекомендацию или ожидаемый результат. Сигнальные слова: advice, recommendation.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Should" and "ought to" give advice and recommendations — the most common way to tell a patient what to do: "You should drink plenty of fluids", "You shouldn't stop your insulin without medical advice". Signal words: advice, recommendation.

examples.sentence: It should help improve the oxygen level in your blood.
examples.translation_uz: Bu qoningizdagi kislorod darajasini yaxshilashga yordam berishi kerak.
examples.translation_ru: Это должно помочь улучшить уровень кислорода в вашей крови.

grammar.title: First Conditional
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Present Simple, + will / imperative
grammar.signal_words: if, unless, as soon as, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Kelajakda yuz berishi mumkin bo'lgan holat va uning natijasini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. chest tightness — ko'krakdagi siqilish — стеснение в груди airway obstruction — nafas yo'lining to'silishi — обструкция дыхательных путей mucus — shilimshiq/balg'am — слизь/мокрота monitor closely — diqqat bilan kuzatmoq — тщательно наблюдать breathing difficulty — nafas olish qiyinligi — затруднённое дыхание Signal so'zlar: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Используется для описания реального или возможного условия в будущем и его результата. upright position — tik holat — вертикальное положение Сигнальные слова: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: First Conditional describes a real, possible future situation and its result. Clinicians use it for warnings, plans and safety-netting: "If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately". Do not use "will" after "if". Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: if, unless, as soon as, when.

practice.setting: hospital ward (the nurse talks to the patient, relatives or the doctor)
practice.role_play: The student is a NURSE. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Mr. Smith
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative, sometimes confused about instructions

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Good morning. I'm having difficulty breathing. I feel short of breath, especially when I try to walk.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning, Mr. Smith. How are you feeling at the moment?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good morning. I'm having difficulty breathing. I feel short of breath, especially when I try to walk.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I'm sorry to hear that. When did the breathing problem start?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It started last night, but it has become worse this morning.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Do you feel short of breath while you are resting, or does it mainly happen when you move?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I feel slightly short of breath even when I'm resting. It becomes much worse when I walk.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. Are you experiencing any chest pain?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I don't have chest pain, but I feel a tightness in my chest.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Are you coughing?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I've been coughing since yesterday, and I'm bringing up some thick mucus.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What colour is the mucus?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It's yellowish. I also feel very tired because I haven't been sleeping well.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had a fever?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I had a temperature of 38.2°C last night.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you for telling me. Your breathing may be more difficult because of the infection and the mucus in your airways.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is that why I'm feeling so short of breath?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It could be. Your airways may be partially blocked by mucus. As a result, it can become harder for air to move in and out of your lungs.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand. What are you going to do?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: First, I'm going to check your oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, pulse, and blood pressure. Because you are experiencing shortness of breath, we need to monitor your condition…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will I need oxygen?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your oxygen saturation is lower than expected, so I'm going to start oxygen therapy as prescribed.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will the oxygen help me breathe more easily?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It should help improve the oxygen level in your blood. Due to your current breathing difficulty, oxygen may help reduce your shortness of breath. I'm going to give it to you throu…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Will it hurt?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: No, it shouldn't hurt. You may feel some cool air around your nose. Try to breathe normally through your nose.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I feel a little more comfortable now.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That's good. Your oxygen saturation has improved slightly. Therefore, we'll continue to monitor your oxygen level and breathing.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Why do I need to keep the oxygen on?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Because your oxygen level can fall again if your breathing becomes more difficult. Keeping the oxygen in place helps maintain an adequate oxygen level.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Can I remove it when I need to go to the bathroom?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Please let us know before you remove it. Due to your current condition, your oxygen level needs to be monitored, especially when you are moving around.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I see. Is there anything else I can do?

questions_to_ask_doctor: Is that why I'm feeling so short of breath?
What are you going to do?
Will I need oxygen?
Will the oxygen help me breathe more easily?
Will it hurt?

modules.description_en: Clinical communication module: Emergency Nursing & First Response. Grammar focus: Imperatives & Infinitives for Instructions. Includes a reference nurse–patient dialogue, 49 vocabulary items, 61 smart phrases, 15 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Sir, can you hear me? Please stay calm and do not try to get up.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes, I can hear you. I suddenly feel very weak and dizzy.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: All right. Stay where you are and try to breathe slowly. Do not move until we assess your condition.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What is happening to me?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'm going to check your vital signs first. Please keep your arm still so I can measure your blood pressure accurately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I feel like I might faint.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Tell me immediately if you feel that you are going to lose consciousness. Try to keep your eyes open and focus on my voice.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'll try.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good. Lie back carefully and raise your legs slightly. I need you to remain in this position while I check your pulse and oxygen saturation.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: My chest feels uncomfortable.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Where exactly do you feel the discomfort? Point to the area with one finger.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Right here, in the middle of my chest.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Does the pain spread to your arm, shoulder, back, neck, or jaw?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It feels like it is spreading to my left arm.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I understand. Do not eat or drink anything for now. I'm going to inform the doctor immediately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Am I going to be all right?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: We are going to monitor you closely and provide the necessary care. Try not to worry. Just keep breathing slowly and remain still.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'm having trouble breathing now.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Sit upright if you can do so safely. Take slow, controlled breaths. Do not walk or stand up without assistance.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I feel very weak.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: That's why I want you to stay in bed. I'm going to attach the monitor to check your heart rate and oxygen level.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I do if I feel worse?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Press the call button and tell us immediately. If you feel severe chest pain, become extremely dizzy, or have increasing difficulty breathing, report it at once.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Should I try to take deep breaths?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Take slow, controlled breaths rather than very deep breaths. Try to remain as calm as possible.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good. Keep your arm relaxed and do not remove the monitoring equipment. I need to reassess your vital signs in a few minutes.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Thank you for helping me.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Stay calm, remain still, and let us take care of you.

grammar.title: Imperatives
grammar.signal_words: please, do not, never, always
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Imperative fe'lning oddiy shakli bo'lib, bemorga buyruq, ko'rsatma, maslahat yoki ogohlantirish berish uchun ishlatiladi. Shoshilinch tibbiy yordamda imperativlar juda muhim, chunki hamshira bemorga qisqa va aniq ko'rsatma berishi kerak. Signal so'zlar: please, do not, never, always.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Imperative — повелительное наклонение. Оно используется для выражения приказа, инструкции, рекомендации или предупреждения. В неотложной помощи медицинский персонал часто использует повелительное наклонение, чтобы дать пациенту короткие и чёткие инструкции. Сигнальные слова: please, do not, never, always.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Imperatives give direct instructions and emergency commands: "Take a deep breath", "Do not eat or drink anything", "Call an ambulance immediately". "Please" or "could you" softens them for patients. Signal words: please, do not, never, always.

grammar.rule_explanation_ru: В медицинской коммуникации форма Do not звучит более официально и чётко. Сигнальные слова: please, do not, never, always.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Imperatives give direct instructions and emergency commands: "Take a deep breath", "Do not eat or drink anything", "Call an ambulance immediately". "Please" or "could you" softens them for patients. Signal words: please, do not, never, always.

grammar.signal_words: please, do not, never, always

grammar.title: Try to + Infinitive
grammar.structure_pattern: try + to + V1
grammar.signal_words: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Gerund (V-ing) ot vazifasida keladi va avoid, stop, keep, recommend fe'llari hamda predloglardan keyin ishlatiladi ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitiv (to + V1) need, want, decide, advise someone dan keyin keladi va maqsadni bildiradi ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal so'zlar: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Try to + infinitive используется, когда мы хотим сказать пациенту, чтобы он постарался что-либо сделать. Сигнальные слова: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Gerunds (V-ing) act as nouns and follow verbs like avoid, stop, keep, recommend and prepositions ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitives (to + V1) follow need, want, decide, advise someone and express purpose ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal words: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing.

grammar.title: Be Careful + Infinitive
grammar.structure_pattern: Be careful + to + V1
grammar.signal_words: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Be careful xavfsizlik haqida ogohlantirishda ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Герундий (V-ing) выступает как существительное после глаголов avoid, stop, keep, recommend и предлогов («Avoid eating before the test»). Инфинитив (to + V1) стоит после need, want, decide, advise someone и выражает цель («We need to run some tests», «in order to rule out appendicitis»). Сигнальные слова: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Gerunds (V-ing) act as nouns and follow verbs like avoid, stop, keep, recommend and prepositions ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitives (to + V1) follow need, want, decide, advise someone and express purpose ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal words: avoid -ing, need to, in order to, before -ing.

examples.sentence: Be careful not to stand up suddenly.

grammar.title: Imperative vs Infinitive
grammar.structure_pattern: Please + imperative | Try to + infinitive | Need + object + infinitive | Ask + object + infinitive | Tell + object + infinitive
grammar.signal_words: please, do not, never, always
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Buyruq gaplar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatma va shoshilinch buyruqlar uchun ishlatiladi: "Take a deep breath", "Do not eat or drink anything", "Call an ambulance immediately". Bemorga nisbatan "please" yoki "could you" bilan yumshatiladi. Gerund (V-ing) ot vazifasida keladi va avoid, stop, keep, recommend fe'llari hamda predloglardan keyin ishlatiladi ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitiv (to + V1) need, want, decide, advise someone dan keyin keladi va maqsadni bildiradi ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal so'zlar: please, do not, never, always.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Повелительное наклонение даёт прямые инструкции и команды в неотложной ситуации: «Take a deep breath», «Do not eat or drink anything», «Call an ambulance immediately». Для пациента смягчается словами «please» или «could you». Герундий (V-ing) выступает как существительное после глаголов avoid, stop, keep, recommend и предлогов («Avoid eating before the test»). Инфинитив (to + V1) стоит после need, want, decide, advise someone и выражает цель («We need to run some tests», «in order to rule out appendicitis»). Сигнальные слова: please, do not, never, always.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Imperatives give direct instructions and emergency commands: "Take a deep breath", "Do not eat or drink anything", "Call an ambulance immediately". "Please" or "could you" softens them for patients. Gerunds (V-ing) act as nouns and follow verbs like avoid, stop, keep, recommend and prepositions ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitives (to + V1) follow need, want, decide, advise someone and express purpose ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal words: please, do not, never, always.
