phrasebook.phrase: I feel weak and a little dizzy.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪ fiːl wiːk ænd ə ˈlɪtl ˈdɪzi/
phrasebook.translation_uz: O'zimni holsiz va biroz boshim aylangandek his qilyapman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я чувствую слабость и небольшое головокружение.

phrasebook.phrase: I've had some muscle cramps.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У меня были мышечные судороги.

phrasebook.phrase: I've only been drinking a little water.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪv ˈəʊnli biːn ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ə ˈlɪtl ˈwɔːtə/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я пью только немного воды.

phrasebook.phrase: I haven't had much food.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я съел немного еды.

phrasebook.phrase: I've only eaten a few pieces of bread.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪv ˈəʊnli ˈiːtn ə fjuː ˈpiːsɪz əv bred/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men faqat bir nechta bo'lak non yedim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я съел только несколько кусочков хлеба.

phrasebook.phrase: My heart feels like it is beating irregularly.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /maɪ hɑːt fiːlz laɪk ɪt ɪz ˈbiːtɪŋ ɪˈreɡjələli/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мне кажется, что сердце бьётся нерегулярно.

phrasebook.phrase: Your blood pressure is slightly low.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваше артериальное давление немного снижено.

phrasebook.phrase: Your heart rate is irregular.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваш сердечный ритм нерегулярный.

phrasebook.phrase: You have an electrolyte imbalance.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас нарушение электролитного баланса.

phrasebook.phrase: Your potassium level is lower than normal.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /jɔː pəˈtæsiəm ˌlevəl ɪz ˈləʊə ðæn ˈnɔːməl/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Уровень калия ниже нормы.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to monitor your heart rhythm carefully.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wiː niːd tə ˈmɒnɪtə jɔː hɑːt ˈrɪðəm ˈkeəfəli/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yurak ritmingizni diqqat bilan kuzatishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо тщательно контролировать сердечный ритм.

phrasebook.phrase: An ECG will be performed.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ən ˌiː siː ˈdʒiː wɪl bi pəˈfɔːmd/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Будет выполнена ЭКГ.

phrasebook.phrase: The ECG shows some changes.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ði ˌiː siː ˈdʒiː ʃəʊz sʌm ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/
phrasebook.translation_ru: На ЭКГ имеются некоторые изменения.

phrasebook.phrase: The doctor will review the results.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Врач рассмотрит результаты.

phrasebook.phrase: Please remain still.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пожалуйста, не двигайтесь.

phrasebook.phrase: Please report any new symptoms immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Har qanday yangi simptom haqida darhol xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите о любых новых симптомах.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll continue monitoring your heart rhythm.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы продолжим контролировать ваш сердечный ритм.

phrasebook.phrase: How are you feeling at the moment?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /haʊ ɑː juː ˈfiːlɪŋ æt ðə ˈməʊmənt/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как вы сейчас себя чувствуете?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had any symptoms?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас были какие-нибудь симптомы?

phrasebook.phrase: When did these symptoms start?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Когда начались эти симптомы?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you been drinking enough fluids?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы пьёте достаточно жидкости?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had much to eat today?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæv juː hæd mʌtʃ tə iːt təˈdeɪ/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы много сегодня ели?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you noticed any changes in your heartbeat?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæv juː ˈnəʊtɪst ˈeni ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɪn jɔː ˈhɑːtbiːt/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы заметили какие-либо изменения в сердцебиении?

phrasebook.phrase: Your blood tests show an electrolyte imbalance.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /jɔː blʌd tests ʃəʊ ən ɪˈlektrəlaɪt ˌɪmbəˈlæns/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon tahlillaringiz elektrolitlar muvozanati buzilganini ko'rsatmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Анализы крови показывают нарушение электролитного баланса.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll check your sodium and potassium levels.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wiːl tʃek jɔː ˈsəʊdiəm ænd pəˈtæsiəm ˌlevəlz/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы проверим уровни натрия и калия.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to investigate the cause.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо выяснить причину.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to put you on a cardiac monitor.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪm ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə pʊt juː ɒn ə ˈkɑːdiæk ˈmɒnɪtə/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я подключу вас к кардиомонитору.

phrasebook.phrase: Please remain still while we record the ECG.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /pliːz rɪˈmeɪn stɪl waɪl wiː rɪˈkɔːd ði ˌiː siː ˈdʒiː/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пожалуйста, не двигайтесь, пока мы записываем ЭКГ.

phrasebook.phrase: You may need electrolyte replacement.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizga elektrolitlarni o'rnini to'ldirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам может потребоваться восполнение электролитов.

phrasebook.phrase: Further treatment may be required.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Может потребоваться дальнейшее лечение.

phrasebook.phrase: Please tell me if you develop any chest discomfort.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /pliːz tel mi ɪf juː dɪˈveləp ˈeni tʃest dɪsˈkʌmfət/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ko'krakda biror noqulaylik paydo bo'lsa, menga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сообщите мне, если появится какой-либо дискомфорт в груди.

phrasebook.phrase: Report worsening dizziness immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bosh aylanishi kuchaysa, darhol xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите об усилении головокружения.

phrasebook.phrase: Report any severe weakness immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Kuchli holsizlik paydo bo'lsa, darhol xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Немедленно сообщите о появлении выраженной слабости.

phrasebook.phrase: Pattern 3 — Describing a small amount
I've been drinking a little water.

grammar.title: Countable Nouns
grammar.structure_pattern: many / a few / several + countable plural | much / a little + uncountable | some / any / a lot of + both
grammar.signal_words: some, any, much, many, a lot of, a little, a few, several
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Countable nouns — sanash mumkin bo'lgan otlar. ko'plikda keladi: symptoms, cramps, pieces Ular bilan many, a few, few, several, any kabi so'zlardan foydalanish mumkin. Signal so'zlar: some, any, much, many, a lot of, a little, a few, several.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Countable nouns — исчисляемые существительные, то есть предметы или понятия, которые можно посчитать. единственное число: a symptom С ними употребляются many, a few, few, several, any и другие количественные слова. Сигнальные слова: some, any, much, many, a lot of, a little, a few, several.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Countable nouns can be counted (symptoms, tablets, episodes) and take many/a few; uncountable nouns (pain, blood, fluid, information) take much/a little and have no plural. "Some" is used in statements and offers, "any" in questions and negatives: "Do you have any pain?" Signal words: some, any, much, many, a lot of, a little, a few, several.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When did these symptoms start?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: They started yesterday, and they seem to be getting worse.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you been drinking enough fluids recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Not really. I've only been drinking a little water.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had much to eat today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I haven't had much food. I've only eaten a few pieces of bread.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you noticed any changes in your heartbeat?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. My heart sometimes feels like it is beating irregularly.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: All right. I'm going to check your vital signs and put you on a cardiac monitor.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Okay.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your blood pressure is slightly low, and your heart rate is irregular.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is that serious?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We need to investigate the cause. Your blood tests show that you have an electrolyte imbalance.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I see.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your potassium level is lower than normal, so we need to monitor your heart rhythm carefully.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: All right.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We'll also check your blood sodium, potassium, calcium, and magnesium levels.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Okay.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: An ECG will be performed to look for any changes in your heart rhythm.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Please remain still while we record the ECG.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Of course.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: The ECG shows some changes that may be related to your electrolyte imbalance.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What happens next?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: The doctor will review the results and decide whether you need electrolyte replacement or further treatment.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: All right.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: For now, please tell me if you develop any chest discomfort, severe weakness, worsening dizziness, or palpitations.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I will.

modules.title: Acute Gastrointestinal Bleeding & Initial Assessment
modules.title_uz: O'tkir oshqozon-ichak qon ketishi va dastlabki baholash
modules.title_ru: Острое желудочно-кишечное кровотечение и первичная оценка
modules.description: O'tkir oshqozon-ichak qon ketishi va dastlabki baholash mavzusida klinik muloqot moduli. Grammatika: Relative Clauses. Namunaviy dialog, 40 ta atama, 36 ta smart ibora, 11 ta grammatik qoida va virtual bemor bilan simulyatsiya.
modules.description_uz: O'tkir oshqozon-ichak qon ketishi va dastlabki baholash mavzusida klinik muloqot moduli. Grammatika: Relative Clauses. Namunaviy dialog, 40 ta atama, 36 ta smart ibora, 11 ta grammatik qoida va virtual bemor bilan simulyatsiya.
modules.description_ru: Модуль клинического общения: Острое желудочно-кишечное кровотечение и первичная оценка. Грамматика: Relative Clauses. Эталонный диалог, 40 терминов, 36 smart-фраз, 11 грамматических тем и симуляция с виртуальным пациентом.
modules.description_en: Clinical communication module: Acute Gastrointestinal Bleeding & Initial Assessment. Grammar focus: Relative Clauses. Includes a reference nurse–patient dialogue, 40 vocabulary items, 36 smart phrases, 11 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'm Nurse Aliya, who will be looking after you. Can you tell me what brought you to the emergency department?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I vomited some blood this morning, and I've been feeling very weak.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I understand. Was the blood bright red, or was it darker in colour?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: It was dark red, with some material that looked like coffee grounds.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Thank you. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I passed a black stool this morning.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: A black stool, which can indicate bleeding in the upper gastrointestinal tract, is important information. Have you had any further episodes since then?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I haven't vomited again.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you felt dizzy or light-headed, particularly when standing up?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I felt very dizzy when I got out of bed.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I see. Have you experienced any abdominal pain or discomfort?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have some mild discomfort in the upper part of my abdomen.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'm going to check your vital signs and assess your general condition.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Your blood pressure is slightly low, and your heart rate is faster than normal. It may be related to the blood loss, but we need to carry out further assessment to determine the cause.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Do you have any medical conditions that we should know about?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have high blood pressure, which I've been treating with medication.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: What medication are you currently taking?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I take tablets for my blood pressure, but I can't remember the name.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: That's all right. Do you take any medicines that can increase the risk of bleeding, such as blood thinners?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I don't take any blood thinners.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you had any previous stomach or intestinal problems?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had a stomach ulcer several years ago.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Thank you. That is relevant information, which I'll document for the doctor.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: We'll also take some blood samples to check your haemoglobin and other blood results.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: We need to monitor your vital signs closely and record any further vomiting or bowel movements that may contain blood.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Please remain in bed and avoid standing up without assistance, especially if you feel dizzy.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: If you feel faint, develop worsening weakness, or vomit more blood, please tell us immediately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I will.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good. The doctor will review your condition and the blood results before deciding what further investigations are required.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: We'll continue monitoring you closely while the assessment is being completed.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Please let me know immediately if you notice any change in your condition.

phrasebook.phrase: Can you tell me what brought you to the emergency department?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /kən juː tel miː wɒt brɔːt juː tə ði ɪˈmɜːdʒənsi dɪˈpɑːtmənt/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizni shoshilinch yordam bo'limiga olib kelgan sababni aytib bera olasizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Можете рассказать, что привело вас в отделение неотложной помощи?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы заметили какие-либо изменения в стуле?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had any further episodes since then?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Shundan keyin yana shunday holat kuzatildimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: После этого повторялись ли подобные эпизоды?

phrasebook.phrase: Was the blood bright red, or was it darker in colour?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon yorqin qizil rangda edimi yoki rangi to'qroq edimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Кровь была ярко-красной или более тёмного цвета?

phrasebook.phrase: It was dark red, with some material that looked like coffee grounds.
phrasebook.translation_uz: U to'q qizil rangda edi, ichida qahva quyqasiga o'xshagan moddalar bor edi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Она была тёмно-красной, с примесью содержимого, похожего на кофейную гущу.

phrasebook.phrase: I passed a black stool this morning.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сегодня утром у меня был чёрный стул.

phrasebook.phrase: A black stool can indicate bleeding in the upper gastrointestinal tract.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qora najas yuqori oshqozon-ichak yo'llarida qon ketishini ko'rsatishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Чёрный стул может указывать на кровотечение из верхних отделов желудочно-кишечного тракта.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you felt dizzy or light-headed, particularly when standing up?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ayniqsa o'rningizdan turganingizda boshingiz aylangan yoki ko'zingiz qorong'ilashganmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы чувствовали головокружение или предобморочное состояние, особенно при вставании?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you experienced any abdominal pain or discomfort?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы испытывали боль или дискомфорт в животе?

phrasebook.phrase: I have some mild discomfort in the upper part of my abdomen.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qornimning yuqori qismida biroz noqulaylik bor.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я чувствую небольшой дискомфорт в верхней части живота.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to check your vital signs and assess your general condition.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hozir hayotiy ko'rsatkichlaringizni tekshiraman va umumiy holatingizni baholayman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сейчас я проверю ваши жизненные показатели и оценю ваше общее состояние.

phrasebook.phrase: Your blood pressure is slightly low.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваше артериальное давление немного снижено.

phrasebook.phrase: Your heart rate is faster than normal.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Частота сердечных сокращений выше нормы.

phrasebook.phrase: It may be related to the blood loss.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu qon yo'qotish bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это может быть связано с кровопотерей.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to carry out further assessment to determine the cause.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sababini aniqlash uchun qo'shimcha baholash o'tkazishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо провести дополнительное обследование, чтобы определить причину.

phrasebook.phrase: Do you have any medical conditions that we should know about?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizda biz bilishimiz kerak bo'lgan biror kasallik bormi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас есть какие-либо заболевания, о которых нам следует знать?

phrasebook.phrase: What medication are you currently taking?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какие лекарства вы сейчас принимаете?

phrasebook.phrase: Do you take any medicines that can increase the risk of bleeding?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon ketish xavfini oshirishi mumkin bo'lgan dorilarni qabul qilasizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы принимаете какие-либо препараты, которые могут повысить риск кровотечения?

phrasebook.phrase: Do you take any blood thinners?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы принимаете препараты, разжижающие кровь?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had any previous stomach or intestinal problems?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Avval oshqozon yoki ichak bilan bog'liq muammolaringiz bo'lganmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас ранее были проблемы с желудком или кишечником?

phrasebook.phrase: I had a stomach ulcer several years ago.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bir necha yil oldin oshqozon yarasi bo'lgan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Несколько лет назад у меня была язва желудка.

phrasebook.phrase: That is relevant information, which I'll document for the doctor.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu muhim ma'lumot, men uni shifokor uchun qayd qilib qo'yaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это важная информация, которую я зафиксирую для врача.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll also take some blood samples to check your haemoglobin.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Gemoglobiningizni tekshirish uchun qon namunalarini ham olamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы также возьмём образцы крови, чтобы проверить уровень гемоглобина.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to monitor your vital signs closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hayotiy ko'rsatkichlaringizni diqqat bilan kuzatib borishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо тщательно контролировать ваши жизненные показатели.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll record any further vomiting or bowel movements that may contain blood.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan keyingi qusish yoki ich kelish holatlarini qayd etamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы будем фиксировать любые повторные эпизоды рвоты или стула, которые могут содержать кровь.

phrasebook.phrase: Please remain in bed.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пожалуйста, оставайтесь в постели.

phrasebook.phrase: Avoid standing up without assistance.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Не вставайте без посторонней помощи.

phrasebook.phrase: Especially if you feel dizzy.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Особенно если вы чувствуете головокружение.

phrasebook.phrase: If you feel faint, please tell us immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar hushdan ketgudek bo'lsangiz, darhol bizga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если вы почувствуете предобморочное состояние, немедленно сообщите нам.

phrasebook.phrase: If you develop worsening weakness, tell us immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar holsizlik kuchaysa, darhol bizga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если слабость усилится, немедленно сообщите нам.

phrasebook.phrase: If you vomit more blood, please tell us immediately.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar yana qon qussangiz, darhol bizga ayting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если вы снова будете рвать кровью, немедленно сообщите нам.

phrasebook.phrase: The doctor will review your condition and the blood results.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Shifokor holatingiz va qon tahlili natijalarini ko'rib chiqadi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Врач оценит ваше состояние и результаты анализа крови.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to determine what further investigations are required.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Yana qanday tekshiruvlar kerakligini aniqlashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо определить, какие дополнительные исследования требуются.

phrasebook.phrase: We'll continue monitoring you closely.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizni diqqat bilan kuzatishda davom etamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы продолжим тщательно наблюдать за вами.

phrasebook.phrase: Please let me know immediately if you notice any change in your condition.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Holatingizda biror o'zgarish sezsangiz, darhol menga xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пожалуйста, немедленно сообщите мне, если заметите какие-либо изменения в вашем состоянии.

phrasebook.phrase: to have a history of gastric ulcer
phrasebook.translation_ru: иметь язву желудка в анамнезе

grammar.title: Who — for People
grammar.structure_pattern: Person + who + verb
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Who faqat odamlar uchun ishlatiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Who используется для людей. Пациент, который пожаловался на головокружение, был немедленно обследован. Медсестра, которая осмотрела пациента, вызвала врача. Врач, который обследовал пациента, назначил анализы крови.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: Person + who + verb.

examples.sentence: The patient who reported dizziness was assessed immediately.
examples.translation_uz: Bosh aylanishidan shikoyat qilgan bemor darhol baholandi.
examples.translation_ru: РУССКИЙ

examples.sentence: The nurse who assessed the patient called the doctor.
The doctor who examined the patient ordered blood tests.
examples.translation_uz: Bemorni tekshirgan shifokor qon tahlillarini buyurdi.
examples.translation_ru: ПРАВИЛО

grammar.title: Which — for Things and Conditions
grammar.structure_pattern: Thing/condition + which + verb
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Which narsalar, hodisalar, belgilar yoki tibbiy holatlar uchun ishlatiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Which используется для предметов, явлений, симптомов и медицинских состояний. Чёрный стул, который может указывать на кровотечение из верхних отделов желудочно-кишечного тракта, является важной информацией. Анализ крови, который был взят при поступлении, показал низкий уровень гемоглобина.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: Thing/condition + which + verb.

examples.sentence: A black stool, which can indicate bleeding in the upper gastrointestinal tract, is important information.
examples.translation_uz: Yuqori oshqozon-ichak yo'llarida qon ketishini ko'rsatishi mumkin bo'lgan qora najas muhim ma'lumotdir.

examples.sentence: The blood test, which was taken on admission, showed a low haemoglobin level.
examples.translation_uz: Qabul vaqtida olingan qon tahlili gemoglobin darajasi pastligini ko'rsatdi.

examples.sentence: The symptom, which started this morning, has become worse.
examples.translation_ru: ПРАВИЛО

grammar.title: That — for People and Things
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: That odamlar va narsalar uchun ishlatilishi mumkin. U ko'pincha who yoki which o'rnida, ayniqsa defining relative clauselarda ishlatiladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: That может использоваться как для людей, так и для предметов. Обычно that используется в ограничительных определительных придаточных предложениях (defining relative clauses). Лекарство, которое может повысить риск кровотечения, следует пересмотреть.

examples.sentence: The medication that can increase the risk of bleeding should be reviewed.
examples.translation_uz: Qon ketish xavfini oshirishi mumkin bo'lgan dori qayta ko'rib chiqilishi kerak.

examples.sentence: The patient that reported severe weakness was monitored closely.
examples.translation_uz: Kuchli holsizlikdan shikoyat qilgan bemor diqqat bilan kuzatildi.

examples.sentence: The medication that the patient is taking may increase the risk of bleeding.
examples.translation_uz: Bemor qabul qilayotgan dori qon ketish xavfini oshirishi mumkin.
examples.translation_ru: ПРАВИЛО

grammar.title: Whose — Possession
grammar.structure_pattern: Person + whose + noun + verb
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Whose egalikni bildiradi va "kimning?" degan ma'noni beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Whose выражает принадлежность и обычно переводится как "чей / которого / у которого". Пациент, у которого низкое артериальное давление, должен оставаться в постели.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: Person + whose + noun + verb.

examples.sentence: The patient whose blood pressure is low should remain in bed.
examples.translation_uz: Qon bosimi past bo'lgan bemor yotoqda qolishi kerak.

examples.sentence: The patient whose haemoglobin level has fallen requires further assessment.
examples.translation_uz: Gemoglobin darajasi pasaygan bemorga qo'shimcha baholash kerak.

examples.sentence: The patient whose condition is deteriorating should be reviewed by the doctor.

grammar.title: Where — for Places
grammar.structure_pattern: Place + where + subject + verb
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Where joy haqida ma'lumot berish uchun ishlatiladi.

grammar.rule_explanation_en: Structure: Place + where + subject + verb.

examples.sentence: The emergency department where the patient was assessed was very busy.

grammar.title: When — for Time

grammar.rule_explanation_ru: When используется после существительных, обозначающих время. Утро, когда пациент вырвал кровь, было особенно тяжёлым.

grammar.title: Defining Relative Clauses
grammar.structure_pattern: noun + who / which / that / whose / where + clause
grammar.signal_words: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Defining Relative Clause — gap uchun muhim va zarur ma'lumot beradi. Bunday gaplarda odatda vergul qo'yilmaydi. Bu yerda who reported dizziness qaysi bemor haqida gap ketayotganini aniqlaydi. Signal so'zlar: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Defining Relative Clause содержит необходимую информацию, без которой невозможно точно определить, о каком человеке или предмете идёт речь. Запятые обычно не используются. Пациент, который пожаловался на головокружение, был немедленно обследован. Сигнальные слова: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Relative clauses add information about a noun: "the patient who collapsed at work", "a test which measures kidney function". Defining clauses have no commas and identify the noun; non-defining clauses add extra information between commas. Signal words: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.

examples.sentence: The patient who reported dizziness was assessed immediately.
examples.translation_uz: Bosh aylanishidan shikoyat qilgan bemor darhol baholandi.
examples.translation_ru: РУССКИЙ

grammar.title: Non-Defining Relative Clauses
grammar.structure_pattern: noun + who / which / that / whose / where + clause
grammar.signal_words: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Non-defining Relative Clause faqat qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi. Bunday gaplar vergul bilan ajratiladi. Bu yerda bemor allaqachon ma'lum. who had a history... faqat qo'shimcha ma'lumot. Non-defining Relative Clause bilan "that" ishlatilmaydi. Signal so'zlar: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Non-defining Relative Clause содержит дополнительную информацию, которая не является необходимой для понимания основной части предложения. Пациент, у которого в анамнезе была язва желудка, находился под тщательным наблюдением. Сигнальные слова: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Relative clauses add information about a noun: "the patient who collapsed at work", "a test which measures kidney function". Defining clauses have no commas and identify the noun; non-defining clauses add extra information between commas. Signal words: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.

grammar.title: Omitting the Relative Pronoun
grammar.structure_pattern: noun + who / which / that / whose / where + clause
grammar.signal_words: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Agar who / which / that gapda object (to'ldiruvchi) bo'lsa, uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin. Ammo relative pronoun subject (ega) bo'lsa, uni tushirib qoldirib bo'lmaydi. Signal so'zlar: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Если who / which / that является дополнением, относительное местоимение иногда можно опустить. Оба варианта грамматически правильные. Но если relative pronoun является подлежащим, его нельзя опускать. Сигнальные слова: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Relative clauses add information about a noun: "the patient who collapsed at work", "a test which measures kidney function". Defining clauses have no commas and identify the noun; non-defining clauses add extra information between commas. Signal words: who (people), which (things), that, whose, where.

patient_profile.name: Olivia Brooks
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative, sometimes confused about instructions

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I vomited some blood this morning, and I've been feeling very weak.
doctor_explanations_from_reference_dialo: A black stool, which can indicate bleeding in the upper gastrointestinal tract, is important information. Have you had any further episodes since then?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. I'm Nurse Aliya, who will be looking after you. Can you tell me what brought you to the emergency department?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I vomited some blood this morning, and I've been feeling very weak.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I understand. Was the blood bright red, or was it darker in colour?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: It was dark red, with some material that looked like coffee grounds.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I passed a black stool this morning.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: A black stool, which can indicate bleeding in the upper gastrointestinal tract, is important information. Have you had any further episodes since then?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I haven't vomited again.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you felt dizzy or light-headed, particularly when standing up?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I felt very dizzy when I got out of bed.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: I see. Have you experienced any abdominal pain or discomfort?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I have some mild discomfort in the upper part of my abdomen.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Thank you. I'm going to check your vital signs and assess your general condition.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Okay.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Do you have any medical conditions that we should know about?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I have high blood pressure, which I've been treating with medication.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What medication are you currently taking?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I take tablets for my blood pressure, but I can't remember the name.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That's all right. Do you take any medicines that can increase the risk of bleeding, such as blood thinners?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I don't take any blood thinners.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had any previous stomach or intestinal problems?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had a stomach ulcer several years ago.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We'll also take some blood samples to check your haemoglobin and other blood results.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: All right.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We need to monitor your vital signs closely and record any further vomiting or bowel movements that may contain blood.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Please remain in bed and avoid standing up without assistance, especially if you feel dizzy.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Okay.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If you feel faint, develop worsening weakness, or vomit more blood, please tell us immediately.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I will.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good. The doctor will review your condition and the blood results before deciding what further investigations are required.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: All right.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Doctor, could I update you on the patient in Bed 4? He has been experiencing increasingly severe shortness of breath since yesterday.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. What is his current condition?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: He is breathing quite rapidly, and his oxygen saturation is significantly lower than normal. He is also noticeably anxious.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What are his current vital signs?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: His blood pressure is 165 over 95, his heart rate is 112 beats per minute, and his respiratory rate is 28 per minute. His oxygen saturation is 88% on room air.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Has his condition changed since he arrived?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Yes. His breathing has become progressively worse over the last two hours. He was initially mildly breathless, but he is now considerably more short of breath.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Has he developed any other symptoms?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Yes. He has significant bilateral leg swelling and reports a feeling of heaviness in both legs. He also says that he has gained approximately three kilograms over the past five days.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That is a fairly rapid weight gain. Has he been passing urine normally?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: No. He has been passing considerably less urine since yesterday.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Does he have a history of heart failure?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Yes. He was diagnosed with chronic heart failure three years ago. According to his medical records, his condition has usually been relatively stable.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Has he been taking his medication regularly?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: He says that he normally takes his medication every day, but he missed several doses last week while he was travelling.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Did he mention any recent dietary changes?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Yes. He admitted that he had been eating unusually salty food and drinking more fluid than usual during his trip.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: That could have contributed to the fluid overload. What did you notice when you examined him?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: He had moderately severe peripheral oedema, and his lung sounds were slightly reduced at the bases with fine crackles bilaterally.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Is he experiencing chest pain?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: No, he denies any significant chest pain, but he says that his breathing becomes particularly difficult when he lies flat.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: So he is experiencing orthopnoea as well?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Yes. He has been sleeping with several extra pillows for the past three nights.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Has he had any similar episodes before?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: He has had mildly similar episodes in the past, but he says this is by far the most severe episode he has experienced.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What investigations have been done so far?

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: We have already taken blood samples. His preliminary results show mildly elevated creatinine. The ECG has been completed, and we are waiting for the chest X-ray.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. Please continue to monitor his vital signs very closely. We need to identify any rapid deterioration.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Should I start oxygen therapy?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. Start supplemental oxygen and keep him in a comfortably upright position. Please also prepare the prescribed IV diuretic.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Understood. Should I monitor his urine output as well?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Record his urine output accurately because it will help us assess his response to treatment.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: I'll do that. I'll also repeat his oxygen saturation shortly after the treatment begins.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. If his respiratory distress becomes significantly worse, inform me immediately.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Of course, doctor. I'll stay nearby and continue close monitoring.

phrasebook.phrase: Could I update you on the patient?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /kʊd aɪ ʌpˈdeɪt juː ɒn ðə ˈpeɪʃənt/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bemor haqida sizga ma'lumot bersam bo'ladimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Могу я сообщить вам о состоянии пациента?

phrasebook.phrase: He has been experiencing increasingly severe shortness of breath.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Unda tobora kuchayib borayotgan nafas qisishi kuzatilmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У него наблюдается постепенно усиливающаяся одышка.

phrasebook.phrase: What is his current condition?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Каково его текущее состояние?

phrasebook.phrase: He is breathing quite rapidly.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он дышит довольно часто.

phrasebook.phrase: His oxygen saturation is significantly lower than normal.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz ˈɒksɪdʒən ˌsætʃəˈreɪʃən ɪz sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli ˈləʊə ðən ˈnɔːml/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uning kislorod saturatsiyasi me'yordan sezilarli darajada past.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его сатурация значительно ниже нормы.

phrasebook.phrase: What are his current vital signs?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Каковы его текущие жизненные показатели?

phrasebook.phrase: His blood pressure is 165 over 95.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz blʌd ˈpreʃə ɪz wʌn sɪksti faɪv ˈəʊvə naɪnti faɪv/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его давление 165 на 95.

phrasebook.phrase: His heart rate is 112 beats per minute.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz hɑːrt reɪt ɪz wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ənd twelv biːts pə ˈmɪnɪt/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Частота сердечных сокращений — 112 ударов в минуту.

phrasebook.phrase: His respiratory rate is 28 per minute.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz rəˈspɪrətri reɪt ɪz twenti eɪt pə ˈmɪnɪt/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Частота дыхания — 28 в минуту.

phrasebook.phrase: His oxygen saturation is 88% on room air.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz ˈɒksɪdʒən ˌsætʃəˈreɪʃən ɪz eɪti eɪt pə sent ɒn ruːm eə/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сатурация на комнатном воздухе — 88%.

phrasebook.phrase: Has his condition changed?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его состояние изменилось?

phrasebook.phrase: His breathing has become progressively worse.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его дыхание постепенно ухудшилось.

phrasebook.phrase: He was initially mildly breathless.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Dastlab unda yengil nafas qisishi bor edi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Первоначально у него была лёгкая одышка.

phrasebook.phrase: He is now considerably more short of breath.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hi ɪz naʊ kənˈsɪdərəbli mɔːr ʃɔːt əv breθ/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Hozir uning nafasi ancha ko'proq qisilyapti.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сейчас одышка у него значительно сильнее.

phrasebook.phrase: We need to identify any rapid deterioration.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wi niːd tuː aɪˈdentɪfaɪ ˈeni ˈræpɪd dɪˌtɪəriəˈreɪʃən/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Har qanday tez yomonlashishni aniqlashimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Нам необходимо выявить любое быстрое ухудшение.

phrasebook.phrase: He has significant bilateral leg swelling.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uning ikkala oyog'ida sezilarli shish bor.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У него выраженный двусторонний отёк ног.

phrasebook.phrase: He reports a feeling of heaviness in both legs.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hi rɪˈpɔːts ə ˈfiːlɪŋ əv ˈhevɪnəs ɪn bəʊθ leɡz/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U ikkala oyog'ida og'irlik hissini aytmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он отмечает чувство тяжести в обеих ногах.

phrasebook.phrase: He has gained approximately three kilograms.
phrasebook.translation_uz: U taxminan uch kilogramm vazn orttirgan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он набрал примерно три килограмма.

phrasebook.phrase: He has been passing considerably less urine.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hi hæz bɪn ˈpɑːsɪŋ kənˈsɪdərəbli les ˈjʊərɪn/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он выделяет значительно меньше мочи.

phrasebook.phrase: That could have contributed to the fluid overload.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðæt kʊd hæv kənˈtrɪbjuːtɪd tuː ðə ˈfluːɪd ˈəʊvələʊd/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu suyuqlik ortiqchaligiga sabab bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это могло способствовать перегрузке жидкостью.

phrasebook.phrase: Does he have a history of heart failure?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /dʌz hi hæv ə ˈhɪstri əv hɑːrt ˈfeɪljə/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Есть ли у него сердечная недостаточность в анамнезе?

phrasebook.phrase: Has he been taking his medication regularly?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæz hi bɪn ˈteɪkɪŋ hɪz ˌmedɪˈkeɪʃən ˈreɡjələli/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U dorilarini muntazam qabul qilib kelganmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он регулярно принимал лекарства?

phrasebook.phrase: He missed several doses last week.
phrasebook.translation_uz: U o'tgan hafta bir nechta dozani o'tkazib yuborgan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: На прошлой неделе он пропустил несколько доз.

phrasebook.phrase: Did he mention any recent dietary changes?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /dɪd hi ˈmenʃən ˈeni ˈriːsənt ˈdaɪətri ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U yaqinda ovqatlanishidagi o'zgarishlar haqida aytdimi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он упоминал о недавних изменениях в питании?

phrasebook.phrase: He admitted that he had been eating unusually salty food.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hi ədˈmɪtɪd ðæt hi hæd bɪn ˈiːtɪŋ ʌnˈjuːʒuəli ˈsɔːlti fuːd/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U odatdagidan ancha sho'r ovqat yeb kelganini tan oldi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он признался, что ел необычно солёную пищу.

phrasebook.phrase: What did you notice when you examined him?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wɒt dɪd juː ˈnəʊtɪs wen juː ɪɡˈzæmɪnd hɪm/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Что вы заметили при его осмотре?

phrasebook.phrase: He had moderately severe peripheral oedema.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Unda o'rtacha-og'ir periferik shish bor edi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У него был умеренно выраженный периферический отёк.

phrasebook.phrase: His lung sounds were slightly reduced at the bases.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz lʌŋ saʊndz wɜːr ˈslaɪtli rɪˈdjuːst æt ðə ˈbeɪsɪz/
phrasebook.translation_uz: O'pkaning pastki qismlarida nafas tovushlari biroz susaygan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: В нижних отделах лёгких дыхательные шумы были несколько ослаблены.

phrasebook.phrase: Fine crackles were heard bilaterally.
phrasebook.translation_ru: С обеих сторон выслушивались мелкопузырчатые хрипы/крепитация.

phrasebook.phrase: His breathing becomes particularly difficult when he lies flat.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz ˈbriːðɪŋ bɪˈkʌmz pəˈtɪkjələli ˈdɪfɪkəlt wen hi laɪz flæt/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U tekis yotganda nafas olishi ayniqsa qiyinlashadi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: При горизонтальном положении дыхание у него становится особенно затруднённым.

phrasebook.phrase: Is he experiencing orthopnoea?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У него наблюдается ортопноэ?

phrasebook.phrase: He has been sleeping with several extra pillows.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hi hæz bɪn ˈsliːpɪŋ wɪð ˈsevrəl ˈekstrə ˈpɪləʊz/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U bir nechta qo'shimcha yostiq bilan uxlab kelmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Он спит, используя несколько дополнительных подушек.

phrasebook.phrase: He finds it difficult to breathe when lying flat.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hi faɪndz ɪt ˈdɪfɪkəlt tuː briːð wen ˈlaɪɪŋ flæt/
phrasebook.translation_uz: U tekis yotganda nafas olishni qiyin deb hisoblaydi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ему трудно дышать в горизонтальном положении.

phrasebook.phrase: What investigations have been done so far?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wɒt ɪnˌvestɪˈɡeɪʃənz hæv bɪn dʌn səʊ fɑːr/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какие обследования были проведены на данный момент?

phrasebook.phrase: We have already taken blood samples.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы уже взяли образцы крови.

phrasebook.phrase: His preliminary results show mildly elevated creatinine.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hɪz prɪˈlɪmɪnəri rɪˈzʌlts ʃəʊ ˈmaɪldli ˈeləveɪtɪd kriˈætɪniːn/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uning dastlabki natijalarida kreatinin biroz oshgan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Предварительные результаты показывают небольшое повышение креатинина.

phrasebook.phrase: The ECG has been completed.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðiː ˌiː siː ˈdʒiː hæz bɪn kəmˈpliːtɪd/
phrasebook.translation_ru: ЭКГ выполнена.

phrasebook.phrase: We are waiting for the chest X-ray.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /wi ɑː ˈweɪtɪŋ fə ðə tʃest eks reɪ/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы ждём рентген грудной клетки.

phrasebook.phrase: Please continue to monitor his vital signs very closely.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /pliːz kənˈtɪnjuː tuː ˈmɒnɪtə hɪz ˈvaɪtl saɪnz ˈveri ˈkləʊsli/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Iltimos, uning hayotiy ko'rsatkichlarini juda yaqindan kuzatishda davom eting.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Продолжайте тщательно контролировать его жизненные показатели.

phrasebook.phrase: Start supplemental oxygen.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Начните дополнительную кислородотерапию.

phrasebook.phrase: Keep him in a comfortably upright position.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /kiːp hɪm ɪn ə ˈkʌmftəbli ˈʌpraɪt pəˈzɪʃən/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Держите его в удобном вертикальном положении.

phrasebook.phrase: Prepare the prescribed IV diuretic.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Подготовьте назначенный внутривенный диуретик.

phrasebook.phrase: Monitor his urine output as well.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Также контролируйте его диурез.

phrasebook.phrase: Record his urine output accurately.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Точно регистрируйте диурез.

phrasebook.phrase: If his respiratory distress becomes significantly worse, inform me immediately.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪf hɪz rəˈspɪrətri dɪˈstres bɪˈkʌmz sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli wɜːrs, ɪnˈfɔːm mi ɪˈmiːdiətli/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar nafas yetishmovchiligi sezilarli darajada kuchaysa, darhol menga xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если дыхательная недостаточность значительно усилится, немедленно сообщите мне.

phrasebook.phrase: I'll stay nearby and continue close monitoring.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /aɪl steɪ ˈnɪəbaɪ ənd kənˈtɪnjuː kləʊs ˈmɒnɪtərɪŋ/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men yaqin atrofda bo'laman va yaqindan kuzatishda davom etaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я останусь рядом и продолжу тщательное наблюдение.

grammar.title: Present Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V1
grammar.signal_words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Simple bemorning odatiy holati, doimiy simptomlari, kasallik tarixi va muntazam qabul qiladigan dorilari haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Simple используется для описания обычного состояния пациента, постоянных симптомов, медицинского анамнеза и регулярного приёма лекарств. Сигнальные слова: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.

examples.sentence: Does he have a history of heart failure?
examples.translation_ru: У него есть анамнез сердечной недостаточности?

examples.sentence: He normally takes his medication every day.
examples.translation_uz: U odatda dorilarini har kuni qabul qiladi.
examples.translation_ru: Обычно он принимает лекарства каждый день.

examples.sentence: He usually sleeps well.
examples.translation_ru: Обычно он хорошо спит.

grammar.title: Present Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: am / is / are + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Continuous ayni vaqtda davom etayotgan simptom yoki bemorning hozirgi holatini tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Continuous используется для описания симптома или состояния пациента, которое происходит в данный момент. Сигнальные слова: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Continuous describes what is happening now or a temporary, changing situation: "His condition is getting worse", "I am going to examine you now". It is also used for the immediate plan of the clinician. Signal words: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.

examples.sentence: He is breathing quite rapidly.
examples.translation_ru: Он довольно быстро дышит.

examples.sentence: His condition is getting worse.
examples.translation_ru: Его состояние ухудшается.

examples.sentence: He is becoming increasingly breathless.
examples.translation_ru: Его одышка постепенно усиливается.

grammar.title: Past Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V2
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Simple o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va tugagan voqealar yoki simptom qachon boshlanganini aytishda ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Simple используется для завершённых действий в прошлом, а также для указания момента начала симптома. Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.

examples.sentence: When did the shortness of breath start?
examples.translation_ru: Когда началась одышка?

examples.sentence: It started two days ago.
examples.translation_ru: Она началась два дня назад.

examples.sentence: He missed several doses last week.
examples.translation_uz: U o'tgan hafta bir nechta dozani qabul qilmay qoldi.
examples.translation_ru: На прошлой неделе он пропустил несколько доз.

grammar.title: Past Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: was / were + V-ing | Past Continuous + when + Past Simple
grammar.signal_words: while, when, at that moment, all morning
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Continuous o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni tasvirlaydi. Ko'pincha when bilan birga ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Continuous описывает действие, которое происходило в определённый момент в прошлом. Часто используется с when. Сигнальные слова: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Continuous describes an action in progress at a moment in the past, often interrupted by a Past Simple event: "I was carrying boxes when I suddenly felt chest pain". It gives the background of the onset. Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: while, when, at that moment, all morning.

examples.sentence: He was resting at home when he suddenly became short of breath.
examples.translation_uz: U uyda dam olayotgan edi, shu paytda to'satdan nafasi qisilib qoldi.
examples.translation_ru: Он отдыхал дома, когда внезапно у него появилась одышка.

examples.sentence: He was sleeping when his breathing suddenly became worse.
examples.translation_uz: U uxlayotgan edi, shu paytda nafasi to'satdan yomonlashdi.
examples.translation_ru: Он спал, когда его дыхание внезапно ухудшилось.

grammar.title: Present Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: have / has + V3
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect o'tmishda boshlangan, lekin natijasi hozirgi holat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan voqealarni ifodalaydi. Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect используется для действий, которые произошли в прошлом, но имеют результат или связь с настоящим моментом. Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

examples.sentence: He has gained three kilograms.
examples.translation_ru: Он набрал три килограмма.

examples.sentence: He has missed several doses.
examples.translation_uz: U bir nechta dozani o'tkazib yuborgan.
examples.translation_ru: Он пропустил несколько доз.

examples.sentence: His symptoms have become more severe.
examples.translation_ru: Его симптомы стали более выраженными.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: have / has been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Bu zamon o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat yoki simptomni ko'rsatadi. over the past week — o'tgan hafta davomida — за последнюю неделю Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Это время используется для действия или симптома, который начался в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента. Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

examples.sentence: He has been experiencing increasing shortness of breath since yesterday.
examples.translation_uz: U kechadan beri kuchayib borayotgan nafas qisishini boshdan kechirmoqda.
examples.translation_ru: Со вчерашнего дня он испытывает усиливающуюся одышку.

examples.sentence: He has been feeling increasingly tired.
examples.translation_uz: U tobora ko'proq charchoqni his qilmoqda.
examples.translation_ru: Он всё больше чувствует усталость.

grammar.title_uz: Present Perfect Continuous — Hozirgi tugallangan davomiy zamon

grammar.title: Future Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: will + V1
grammar.signal_words: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Future Simple kelajakda bajariladigan tibbiy harakat, kuzatuv yoki qarorni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Future Simple используется для описания будущих действий, медицинских решений и дальнейшего наблюдения. Сигнальные слова: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Will" expresses decisions made now, promises, predictions and reassurance: "I will give you something for the pain", "The swelling will go down in a few days". Signal words: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.

examples.sentence: We will monitor him closely.
examples.translation_ru: Мы будем тщательно наблюдать за ним.

examples.sentence: We will reassess his condition later.
examples.translation_ru: Позже мы повторно оценим его состояние.

examples.sentence: We will adjust the treatment if necessary.
examples.translation_ru: При необходимости мы скорректируем лечение.

grammar.title: Be Going to
grammar.structure_pattern: am / is / are + going to + V1
grammar.signal_words: now, next, first, then
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: be going to oldindan rejalashtirilgan yoki hozirgi vaziyatga asoslangan kelajakdagi harakatni bildiradi. Modifiers asosiy grammar emas, balki zamonlar yordamida ifodalangan klinik holatni aniqroq qilish uchun ishlatiladi. o'tmishdagi harakati → simptomning boshlanishi → davom etayotgan simptom → hozirgi holati → kelajakdagi davolash Signal so'zlar: now, next, first, then.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: be going to используется для заранее запланированного действия или действия, основанного на очевидной ситуации. действие в прошлом → начало симптома → продолжающийся симптом → состояние сейчас → дальнейшее лечение. Сигнальные слова: now, next, first, then.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Be going to" describes a plan or intention and something about to happen: "I am going to examine your abdomen now", "We are going to run some tests". Clinicians use it to announce each step of the examination. Signal words: now, next, first, then.

practice.setting: hospital ward (the nurse talks to the patient, relatives or the doctor)
practice.role_play: The student is a NURSE. You play the DOCTOR.

patient_profile.name: Henry Cole
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative, sometimes confused about instructions

medical_condition.chief_complaint: Yes. What is his current condition?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Doctor, could I update you on the patient in Bed 4? He has been experiencing increasingly severe shortness of breath since yesterday.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. What is his current condition?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: He is breathing quite rapidly, and his oxygen saturation is significantly lower than normal. He is also noticeably anxious.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What are his current vital signs?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: His blood pressure is 165 over 95, his heart rate is 112 beats per minute, and his respiratory rate is 28 per minute. His oxygen saturation is 88% on room air.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Has his condition changed since he arrived?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. His breathing has become progressively worse over the last two hours. He was initially mildly breathless, but he is now considerably more short of breath.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Has he developed any other symptoms?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. He has significant bilateral leg swelling and reports a feeling of heaviness in both legs. He also says that he has gained approximately three kilograms over the past five da…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: That is a fairly rapid weight gain. Has he been passing urine normally?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: No. He has been passing considerably less urine since yesterday.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Does he have a history of heart failure?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. He was diagnosed with chronic heart failure three years ago. According to his medical records, his condition has usually been relatively stable.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Has he been taking his medication regularly?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: He says that he normally takes his medication every day, but he missed several doses last week while he was travelling.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Did he mention any recent dietary changes?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. He admitted that he had been eating unusually salty food and drinking more fluid than usual during his trip.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: That could have contributed to the fluid overload. What did you notice when you examined him?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: He had moderately severe peripheral oedema, and his lung sounds were slightly reduced at the bases with fine crackles bilaterally.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is he experiencing chest pain?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: No, he denies any significant chest pain, but he says that his breathing becomes particularly difficult when he lies flat.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: So he is experiencing orthopnoea as well?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. He has been sleeping with several extra pillows for the past three nights.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Has he had any similar episodes before?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: He has had mildly similar episodes in the past, but he says this is by far the most severe episode he has experienced.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What investigations have been done so far?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We have already taken blood samples. His preliminary results show mildly elevated creatinine. The ECG has been completed, and we are waiting for the chest X-ray.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Good. Please continue to monitor his vital signs very closely. We need to identify any rapid deterioration.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Should I start oxygen therapy?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. Start supplemental oxygen and keep him in a comfortably upright position. Please also prepare the prescribed IV diuretic.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Understood. Should I monitor his urine output as well?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Absolutely. Record his urine output accurately because it will help us assess his response to treatment.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good morning. I'd like to ask you a few questions about how you have been managing your diabetes. How are you feeling today?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'm feeling quite well today. I don't have any major symptoms at the moment.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: How long have you had diabetes?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have had type 2 diabetes for about six years.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Are you currently taking any medication for your diabetes?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I take metformin every day, usually with my meals.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you been taking it regularly recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. I have been taking it regularly for the past several months.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you missed any doses during the last two weeks?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I missed one dose last week, but I normally take it every day.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Do you check your blood glucose at home?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I usually check it in the morning before breakfast.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: What have your blood glucose readings been like recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: They have been slightly higher than usual. My morning readings have often been around 8 to 9 mmol/L.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you noticed any symptoms when your blood glucose is high?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I sometimes feel more thirsty and I urinate more frequently.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have these symptoms become more frequent recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. They have become a little more frequent over the past month.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: What has your diet been like recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have been eating more bread and rice than usual, and I have also been drinking sweetened tea.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: How often do you eat sugary or high-carbohydrate foods?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I usually eat them several times a week.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you made any recent changes to your diet?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I have recently started reducing sugary drinks, and I am trying to eat smaller portions.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: That's good. How physically active are you?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I usually walk for about 20 minutes a day, but I haven't been exercising regularly recently.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: When was the last time you exercised regularly?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I exercised regularly last year, but I stopped about four months ago because I became very busy at work.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you gained any weight since then?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I have gained about five kilograms over the past four months.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you experienced any problems with your feet?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I haven't. I haven't noticed any wounds, numbness, or significant pain.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Do you check your feet regularly?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I usually check them once or twice a week.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you had your blood pressure checked recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. It was checked last week, and it was slightly higher than normal.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Do you have any other chronic health problems?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have high blood pressure, and I take medication for it as well.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: How well are you sleeping?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I usually sleep for about six hours a night, but recently I have been sleeping less because of work.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you been feeling unusually tired?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I have been feeling more tired than usual for the past few weeks.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: How much water do you usually drink during the day?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I usually drink about one and a half to two litres of water a day.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I don't smoke. I rarely drink alcohol.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Have you been following your treatment plan?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I have been following it most of the time, but I know that I need to improve my diet and exercise more regularly.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: What changes are you willing to make from now on?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'm going to reduce sugary foods and drinks, eat more vegetables, and exercise more regularly.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: How often are you going to exercise?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I'm going to walk for at least 30 minutes, five days a week.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: That's a good plan. We will also continue to monitor your blood glucose and blood pressure. You should keep taking your medication as prescribed.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Okay. I will follow the plan.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Please remember to check your feet regularly and report any wounds, numbness, or changes in sensation.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I will. I'll also try to be more consistent with my diet and exercise.

dialogue.label: Nurse
dialogue.text: Good. We will review your progress at your next appointment.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Thank you.

Hozirda jiddiy alomatlaringiz bormi?
