phrasebook.phrase: I take metformin every day, usually with my meals.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men har kuni, odatda ovqat bilan birga metformin qabul qilaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я принимаю метформин каждый день, обычно во время еды.

phrasebook.phrase: I have been taking it regularly for the past several months.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men so'nggi bir necha oy davomida uni muntazam qabul qilib kelmoqdaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я регулярно принимаю его в течение последних нескольких месяцев.

phrasebook.phrase: I missed one dose last week.
phrasebook.translation_uz: O'tgan hafta bir marta dorini qabul qilishni unutdim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: На прошлой неделе я один раз пропустил приём лекарства.

phrasebook.phrase: Asking about glucose monitoring
Do you check your blood glucose at home?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы проверяете уровень глюкозы дома?

phrasebook.phrase: How often do you check your blood glucose?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как часто вы проверяете уровень глюкозы?

phrasebook.phrase: What have your blood glucose readings been like recently?
phrasebook.translation_uz: So'nggi paytlarda qondagi glyukoza ko'rsatkichlaringiz qanday bo'ldi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какими были показатели глюкозы в крови в последнее время?

phrasebook.phrase: I usually check it in the morning before breakfast.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men odatda ertalab nonushtadan oldin tekshiraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я обычно проверяю её утром перед завтраком.

phrasebook.phrase: My morning readings have often been around 8 to 9 mmol/L.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ertalabki ko'rsatkichlarim ko'pincha 8—9 mmol/L atrofida bo'ladi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мои утренние показатели часто составляют около 8—9 ммоль/л.

phrasebook.phrase: Common diabetes-related symptoms
Have you noticed any symptoms when your blood glucose is high?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qondagi glyukoza yuqori bo'lganda biror alomat sezganmisiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы замечали какие-либо симптомы при повышении уровня глюкозы в крови?

phrasebook.phrase: Do you feel more thirsty than usual?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы испытываете повышенную жажду?

phrasebook.phrase: Are you urinating more frequently?
Tez-tez siyayapsizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы мочитесь чаще обычного?

phrasebook.phrase: Have these symptoms become more frequent recently?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Эти симптомы стали возникать чаще в последнее время?

phrasebook.phrase: I sometimes feel more thirsty.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Иногда я испытываю повышенную жажду.

phrasebook.phrase: I urinate more frequently.
Men tez-tez siyaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я мочусь чаще.

phrasebook.phrase: They have become a little more frequent over the past month.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ular so'nggi bir oy davomida biroz ko'proq kuzatildi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Они стали немного чаще возникать в течение последнего месяца.

phrasebook.phrase: Asking about diet
What has your diet been like recently?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Каким было ваше питание в последнее время?

phrasebook.phrase: How often do you eat sugary or high-carbohydrate foods?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Shirin yoki uglevodlarga boy mahsulotlarni qanchalik tez-tez iste'mol qilasiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как часто вы употребляете сладкие продукты или продукты с высоким содержанием углеводов?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you made any recent changes to your diet?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вносили ли вы недавно изменения в свой рацион?

phrasebook.phrase: I have been eating more bread and rice than usual.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men odatdagidan ko'proq non va guruch iste'mol qilyapman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я ем больше хлеба и риса, чем обычно.

phrasebook.phrase: I have also been drinking sweetened tea.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я также пью чай с сахаром.

phrasebook.phrase: I have recently started reducing sugary drinks.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men yaqinda shirin ichimliklarni kamaytirishni boshladim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я недавно начал сокращать употребление сладких напитков.

phrasebook.phrase: I am trying to eat smaller portions.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men kichikroq porsiyalarda ovqatlanishga harakat qilyapman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я стараюсь есть меньшими порциями.

phrasebook.phrase: Assessing exercise habits
How physically active are you?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Насколько вы физически активны?

phrasebook.phrase: How often do you exercise?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как часто вы занимаетесь физическими упражнениями?

phrasebook.phrase: When was the last time you exercised regularly?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Oxirgi marta qachon muntazam ravishda mashq qilgansiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Когда вы в последний раз регулярно занимались физическими упражнениями?

phrasebook.phrase: I usually walk for about 20 minutes a day.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men odatda kuniga taxminan 20 daqiqa yuraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я обычно хожу пешком около 20 минут в день.

phrasebook.phrase: I haven't been exercising regularly recently.
phrasebook.translation_ru: В последнее время я не занимаюсь регулярно физическими упражнениями.

phrasebook.phrase: I stopped about four months ago because I became very busy at work.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men taxminan to'rt oy oldin ishlarim ko'payib ketgani sababli to'xtatdim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я прекратил около четырёх месяцев назад, потому что был очень занят на работе.

phrasebook.phrase: Asking about weight changes
Have you gained any weight recently?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы набрали вес в последнее время?

phrasebook.phrase: How much weight have you gained?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Сколько веса вы набрали?

phrasebook.phrase: I have gained about five kilograms over the past four months.
phrasebook.translation_uz: So'nggi to'rt oy davomida taxminan besh kilogramm vazn oldim.
phrasebook.translation_ru: За последние четыре месяца я набрал около пяти килограммов.

phrasebook.phrase: Checking for diabetic foot problems
Have you experienced any problems with your feet?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Oyoqlaringiz bilan bog'liq biror muammo bo'lganmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас были какие-либо проблемы со стопами?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you noticed any wounds or numbness?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы замечали какие-либо раны или онемение?

phrasebook.phrase: Do you check your feet regularly?
Oyoqlaringizni muntazam tekshirib turasizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы регулярно осматриваете стопы?

phrasebook.phrase: I haven't noticed any wounds, numbness, or significant pain.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men hech qanday yara, uvishish yoki sezilarli og'riqni sezmaganman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я не замечал ран, онемения или выраженной боли.

phrasebook.phrase: I usually check my feet once or twice a week.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men odatda oyoqlarimni haftasiga bir yoki ikki marta tekshiraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Обычно я осматриваю стопы один или два раза в неделю.

phrasebook.phrase: Asking about other conditions
Do you have any other chronic health problems?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас есть другие хронические заболевания?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had your blood pressure checked recently?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам недавно измеряли артериальное давление?

phrasebook.phrase: I have high blood pressure.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У меня повышенное артериальное давление.

phrasebook.phrase: I take medication for it as well.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Buning uchun ham dori qabul qilaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я также принимаю лекарства от этого заболевания.

phrasebook.phrase: It was checked last week, and it was slightly higher than normal.
phrasebook.translation_uz: U o'tgan hafta tekshirildi va odatdagidan biroz yuqori edi.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Его измеряли на прошлой неделе, и оно было немного выше нормы.

phrasebook.phrase: How well are you sleeping?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как вы спите?

phrasebook.phrase: Have you been feeling unusually tired?
phrasebook.translation_uz: O'zingizni odatdagidan ko'ra charchagan his qilyapsizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы чувствуете необычную усталость?

phrasebook.phrase: I usually sleep for about six hours a night.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men odatda kechasi taxminan olti soat uxlayman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Обычно я сплю около шести часов в сутки.

phrasebook.phrase: I have been feeling more tired than usual for the past few weeks.
phrasebook.translation_uz: So'nggi bir necha hafta davomida o'zimni odatdagidan ko'ra charchaganroq his qilyapman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: В течение последних нескольких недель я чувствую себя более уставшим, чем обычно.

phrasebook.phrase: Smoking and alcohol
Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Chekasizmi yoki spirtli ichimlik iste'mol qilasizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы курите или употребляете алкоголь?

phrasebook.phrase: I don't smoke.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я не курю.

phrasebook.phrase: I rarely drink alcohol.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men spirtli ichimliklarni kamdan-kam iste'mol qilaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я редко употребляю алкоголь.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you been following your treatment plan?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы соблюдаете план лечения?

phrasebook.phrase: Are you taking your medication as prescribed?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы принимаете лекарства согласно назначению врача?

phrasebook.phrase: I have been following it most of the time.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men ko'pincha unga amal qilib kelyapman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я в большинстве случаев соблюдаю его.

phrasebook.phrase: I know that I need to improve my diet and exercise more regularly.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men ovqatlanishimni yaxshilashim va muntazamroq mashq qilishim kerakligini bilaman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я знаю, что мне нужно улучшить питание и чаще заниматься физическими упражнениями.

phrasebook.phrase: You should keep taking your medication as prescribed.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Dorilaringizni shifokor buyurganidek qabul qilishda davom etishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует продолжать принимать лекарства согласно назначению врача.

phrasebook.phrase: You should check your feet regularly.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует регулярно осматривать стопы.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to reduce sugary foods and drinks.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Shirin mahsulotlar va ichimliklarni kamaytirishga harakat qiling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Старайтесь сократить употребление сладких продуктов и напитков.

phrasebook.phrase: Try to exercise more regularly.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Muntazamroq jismoniy mashq qilishga harakat qiling.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Старайтесь заниматься физическими упражнениями регулярнее.

phrasebook.phrase: You should report any wounds or changes in sensation.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Har qanday yara yoki sezuvchanlikdagi o'zgarishlar haqida xabar berishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вам следует сообщать о любых ранах или изменениях чувствительности.

phrasebook.phrase: Asking about planned changes
What changes are you willing to make from now on?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bundan buyon qanday o'zgarishlar qilishga tayyorsiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Какие изменения вы готовы внести с этого момента?

phrasebook.phrase: How often are you going to exercise?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Как часто вы собираетесь заниматься физическими упражнениями?

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to reduce sugary foods and drinks.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men shirin mahsulotlar va ichimliklarni kamaytiraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я собираюсь сократить употребление сладких продуктов и напитков.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to eat more vegetables.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я собираюсь есть больше овощей.

phrasebook.phrase: I'm going to walk for at least 30 minutes, five days a week.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Men haftasiga besh kun kamida 30 daqiqadan yuraman.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я собираюсь ходить пешком не менее 30 минут пять дней в неделю.

phrasebook.phrase: Closing the consultation
We will continue to monitor your blood glucose and blood pressure.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Biz qondagi glyukozangiz va qon bosimingizni nazorat qilishda davom etamiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы продолжим контролировать уровень глюкозы в крови и артериальное давление.

phrasebook.phrase: We will review your progress at your next appointment.
phrasebook.translation_ru: На следующем приёме мы оценим динамику вашего состояния.

phrasebook.phrase: Please report any changes in your condition.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Iltimos, holatingizdagi har qanday o'zgarish haqida xabar bering.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пожалуйста, сообщайте о любых изменениях в вашем состоянии.

phrasebook.phrase: I will follow the plan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Я буду следовать плану.

grammar.title: Present Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V1 / V(s)
grammar.signal_words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Simple odatlar, muntazam bajariladigan ishlar, doimiy holatlar va umumiy faktlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Tibbiy suhbatlarda quyidagilar haqida gapirganda juda ko'p ishlatiladi: Signal so'zlar: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Simple используется для выражения привычных, регулярных действий, постоянных состояний и общих фактов. В медицинской беседе он часто используется для описания: Сигнальные слова: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: usually, often, every day, sometimes, never.

examples.translation_uz: Men odatda ertalab qondagi glyukozamni tekshiraman.

grammar.title: Present Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + am/is/are + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Continuous hozir ayni paytda yoki hozirgi davrda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi. Tibbiy suhbatlarda bemorning hozirgi holati yoki vaqtinchalik o'zgarayotgan odatlari haqida gapirishda ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Continuous используется для действий, происходящих сейчас или в текущий период. действия, которые пациент предпринимает в настоящее время. Сигнальные слова: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Continuous describes what is happening now or a temporary, changing situation: "His condition is getting worse", "I am going to examine you now". It is also used for the immediate plan of the clinician. Signal words: now, at the moment, currently, today, these days.

examples.sentence: I'm feeling quite well today.
examples.translation_uz: Bugun o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.
examples.translation_ru: Сегодня я чувствую себя довольно хорошо.

examples.sentence: I am trying to eat smaller portions.
examples.translation_uz: Men kichikroq porsiyalarda ovqatlanishga harakat qilyapman.

examples.sentence: I am sleeping less because of work.
examples.translation_ru: Я сплю меньше из-за работы.

examples.sentence: I eat smaller portions.
I am eating smaller portions.
examples.translation_uz: Hozirgi davrda bu odatni amalga oshiryapman.

grammar.title: Past Simple
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + V2 | Subject + did not + V1
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Simple o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi. yesterday — kecha — вчера Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Simple используется для завершённых действий в прошлом, особенно когда указано конкретное время. В медицинском интервью он используется для описания: физической активности в прошлом; last week — o'tgan hafta — на прошлой неделе last year — o'tgan yil — в прошлом году four months ago — to'rt oy oldin — четыре месяца назад Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.

grammar.title: Present Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + have/has + V3 | For + Period | Since + Starting Point
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect o'tmishda boshlangan, lekin hozirgi holat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan harakat yoki o'zgarishlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. qancha vaqtdan beri kasalligi borligi; hozirgacha yuz bergan o'zgarishlari; yaqinda paydo bo'lgan simptomlari; so'nggi bir oy davomida Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect используется для действий или изменений, которые произошли в прошлом, но имеют связь с настоящим. В медицинской беседе он особенно важен для описания: в течение шести лет в течение последнего месяца Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". "Since" gives the starting point ("since yesterday"), "for" the length of time ("for three days") and "ago" counts back from now ("two hours ago"). Exact times ("at about 7:15 this morning") are essential in time-critical conditions such as stroke. Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

examples.sentence: I have had type 2 diabetes for about six years.
examples.translation_uz: Men taxminan olti yildan beri 2-tur diabet bilan og'riyman.
examples.translation_ru: Я болею сахарным диабетом 2 типа около шести лет.

examples.sentence: I have gained about five kilograms.
Men taxminan besh kilogramm vazn oldim.

examples.sentence: They have become more frequent.
examples.translation_ru: Они стали возникать чаще.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + have/has been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Hozirgi tugallangan davomiy zamon Bu zamon o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan yoki yaqinda davom etib kelgan jarayonni ifodalaydi. davolash rejasiga amal qilish; uzoq davom etayotgan holatlar Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect Continuous используется для действий, которые начались в прошлом и продолжаются до настоящего момента или продолжались в течение определённого периода до настоящего момента. Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

examples.sentence: I have been taking it regularly for the past several months.
examples.translation_uz: Men so'nggi bir necha oy davomida uni muntazam qabul qilib kelmoqdaman.
examples.translation_ru: Я регулярно принимаю его в течение последних нескольких месяцев.

examples.sentence: I have been feeling more tired than usual.
examples.translation_uz: Men o'zimni odatdagidan ko'ra charchaganroq his qilib kelyapman.

examples.sentence: I have been following my treatment plan.
examples.translation_uz: Men davolash rejamga amal qilib kelyapman.
examples.translation_ru: Я соблюдаю свой план лечения.

examples.sentence: I take metformin every day.
examples.translation_ru: Я принимаю метформин каждый день.

examples.sentence: I have been taking metformin regularly for several months.
examples.translation_uz: Men bir necha oydan beri uni muntazam qabul qilib kelmoqdaman.

grammar.title: Future Simple — Will
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + will + V1 | will not / won't + V1
grammar.signal_words: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Will kelajakdagi qaror, va'da, reja yoki kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan harakatni ifodalashi mumkin. haqida gapirganda ko'p ishlatadi. Signal so'zlar: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Will используется для выражения будущих действий, решений, обещаний и действий, которые будут выполнены в будущем. Сигнальные слова: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Will" expresses decisions made now, promises, predictions and reassurance: "I will give you something for the pain", "The swelling will go down in a few days". Signal words: tomorrow, next week, soon, in a few minutes, I think.

examples.sentence: We will continue to monitor your blood glucose.
examples.translation_uz: Biz qondagi glyukozangizni nazorat qilishda davom etamiz.
examples.translation_ru: Мы продолжим контролировать уровень глюкозы в крови.

examples.sentence: We will review your progress at your next appointment.
examples.translation_ru: На следующем приёме мы оценим динамику вашего состояния.

examples.sentence: I will follow the plan.
examples.translation_ru: Я буду следовать плану.

grammar.title: Be Going to
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + am/is/are going to + V1
grammar.signal_words: now, next, first, then
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Be going to oldindan qabul qilingan qaror yoki rejalashtirilgan harakat uchun ishlatiladi. Ushbu dialogda bemor turmush tarzini o'zgartirish bo'yicha aniq reja bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: now, next, first, then.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Be going to используется для заранее принятого решения или запланированного действия. В медицинском диалоге пациент использует эту конструкцию, чтобы рассказать о своих планах изменить образ жизни. Сигнальные слова: now, next, first, then.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Be going to" describes a plan or intention and something about to happen: "I am going to examine your abdomen now", "We are going to run some tests". Clinicians use it to announce each step of the examination. Gerunds (V-ing) act as nouns and follow verbs like avoid, stop, keep, recommend and prepositions ("Avoid eating before the test"). Infinitives (to + V1) follow need, want, decide, advise someone and express purpose ("We need to run some tests", "in order to rule out appendicitis"). Signal words: now, next, first, then.

examples.sentence: I'm going to reduce sugary foods and drinks.

examples.translation_ru: Я собираюсь сократить употребление сладких продуктов и напитков.

examples.sentence: I'm going to eat more vegetables.

grammar.title: Most key differencelar
grammar.structure_pattern: Past Simple + finished time | Present Perfect + unfinished/relevant time
grammar.signal_words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Simple o'tmishda aniq vaqtda tugagan voqealarni bildiradi: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Vaqt tugagan yoki aniq ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa shu zamon ishlatiladi. Present Perfect o'tmishdagi voqeani hozirgi holat bilan bog'laydi: tajriba, yaqinda bo'lgan voqea yoki hozir muhim bo'lgan natija. Anamnez yig'ishda hozirgacha bo'lgan simptomlar so'raladi: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Signal so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Simple описывает завершённые события в определённое время в прошлом: «The pain started yesterday», «When did you take the last dose?». Используется, когда время закончилось или названо. Present Perfect связывает прошлое событие с настоящим: опыт, недавнее событие или результат, важный сейчас. При сборе анамнеза так спрашивают о симптомах вплоть до настоящего момента: «Have you had any fever?», «I have vomited three times». Сигнальные слова: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Simple describes completed events at a definite time in the past: "The pain started yesterday", "When did you take the last dose?". Use it whenever the time is finished or stated. Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Signal words: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020, when.

grammar.title: Clinical Question Patterns
grammar.structure_pattern: Auxiliary (do/does/did/have/is/are/can) + subject + V? | Wh-word + auxiliary + subject + V?
grammar.signal_words: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Hamshira suhbatida quyidagi savol shakllari juda ko'p ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Общие вопросы начинаются со вспомогательного глагола («Do you have any allergies?», «Have you had a fever?»); специальные — с вопросительного слова («How long have you had the pain?», «Where exactly does it hurt?»). Открытые вопросы собирают историю, закрытые — уточняют детали. Сигнальные слова: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Yes/No questions start with an auxiliary ("Do you have any allergies?", "Have you had a fever?"); Wh-questions add a question word ("How long have you had the pain?", "Where exactly does it hurt?"). Open questions gather the story, closed questions confirm details. Signal words: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you.

practice.setting: hospital ward (the nurse talks to the patient, relatives or the doctor)
practice.role_play: The student is a NURSE. You play the PATIENT.

patient_profile.name: Charlotte Reed
patient_profile.personality_trait: cooperative, sometimes confused about instructions

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I'm feeling quite well today. I don't have any major symptoms at the moment.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Good morning. I'd like to ask you a few questions about how you have been managing your diabetes. How are you feeling today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I'm feeling quite well today. I don't have any major symptoms at the moment.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How long have you had diabetes?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I have had type 2 diabetes for about six years.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Are you currently taking any medication for your diabetes?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I take metformin every day, usually with my meals.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you been taking it regularly recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes, I have. I have been taking it regularly for the past several months.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you missed any doses during the last two weeks?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I missed one dose last week, but I normally take it every day.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Do you check your blood glucose at home?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I usually check it in the morning before breakfast.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What have your blood glucose readings been like recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: They have been slightly higher than usual. My morning readings have often been around 8 to 9 mmol/L.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you noticed any symptoms when your blood glucose is high?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I sometimes feel more thirsty and I urinate more frequently.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have these symptoms become more frequent recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. They have become a little more frequent over the past month.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What has your diet been like recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I have been eating more bread and rice than usual, and I have also been drinking sweetened tea.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How often do you eat sugary or high-carbohydrate foods?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I usually eat them several times a week.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you made any recent changes to your diet?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I have recently started reducing sugary drinks, and I am trying to eat smaller portions.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: That's good. How physically active are you?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I usually walk for about 20 minutes a day, but I haven't been exercising regularly recently.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When was the last time you exercised regularly?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I exercised regularly last year, but I stopped about four months ago because I became very busy at work.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you gained any weight since then?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I have gained about five kilograms over the past four months.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you experienced any problems with your feet?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I haven't. I haven't noticed any wounds, numbness, or significant pain.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What brings you in today?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've been feeling extremely unwell since yesterday. I'm very thirsty, I've been urinating constantly, and I've vomited several times.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Do you have diabetes?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. Type 1 diabetes.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you been taking your insulin regularly?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No. I've missed several doses over the last two days.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Why did you stop taking it?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I was vomiting and couldn't eat properly, so I thought I shouldn't take insulin.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had any abdominal pain?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. My abdomen has been hurting since last night.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed any changes in your breathing?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. My breathing has become deep and unusually fast.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had a fever or any signs of infection?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I've had a fever and a sore throat since yesterday.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you been able to keep fluids down?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Not really. Every time I drink a lot, I feel nauseous.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Your blood pressure is low, and your pulse and breathing rate are elevated. Your blood glucose is 26 mmol/L, and your ketones are strongly positive.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What does that mean?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Your symptoms and test results are highly suggestive of diabetic ketoacidosis, or DKA.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Is it dangerous?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. DKA can become life-threatening if it isn't treated promptly. We need to start treatment immediately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What are you going to do?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: We'll give you intravenous fluids, monitor your electrolytes and glucose closely, and administer insulin according to the DKA protocol.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Did missing my insulin cause this?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It may have contributed significantly. Infection can also trigger DKA.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I do if this happens again?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If you're unable to eat or drink, you shouldn't simply stop your insulin without medical advice. If you develop persistent vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, rapid breathing, or very high glucose levels, you should seek urgent medical attention.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. We're going to monitor you closely and start treatment now.

phrasebook.phrase: What brings you in today?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bugun sizni bu yerga nima olib keldi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Что привело вас сегодня?
phrasebook.patient_response: I've been feeling extremely unwell since yesterday. I'm very thirsty, I've been urinating constantly, and I've vomited several times.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Kechadan beri o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman. Juda chanqayapman, doimiy ravishda siyayapman va bir necha marta qusdim.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you been taking your insulin regularly?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæv juː biːn ˈteɪkɪŋ jɔːr ˈɪnsəlɪn ˈreɡjələli/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы регулярно принимаете инсулин?

phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Нет. За последние два дня я пропустил несколько доз.

phrasebook.phrase: Why did you stop taking it?
phrasebook.translation_uz: Uni nima sababdan qabul qilishni to'xtatdingiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Почему вы прекратили его принимать?
phrasebook.patient_response: I was vomiting and couldn't eat properly, so I thought I shouldn't take insulin.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Qusayotgan edim va to'g'ri ovqatlana olmadim, shuning uchun insulin qabul qilmasligim kerak deb o'yladim.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Меня рвало, и я не мог нормально есть, поэтому я решил, что мне не следует принимать инсулин.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you had any abdominal pain?
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас были боли в животе?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. My abdomen has been hurting since last night.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Ha. Kechadan beri qornim og'riyapti.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Да. Живот болит со вчерашнего вечера.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you noticed any changes in your breathing?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæv juː ˈnəʊtɪst ˈeni ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɪn jɔːr ˈbriːðɪŋ/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы заметили какие-либо изменения в дыхании?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. My breathing has become deep and unusually fast.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Ha. Nafasim chuqur va odatdagidan tezlashdi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Да. Моё дыхание стало глубоким и необычно частым.

phrasebook.phrase: Have you been able to keep fluids down?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæv juː biːn ˈeɪbəl tə kiːp ˈfluːɪdz daʊn/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ichgan suyuqligingizni qayt qilmay ushlab tura olyapsizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы можете удерживать жидкость, не вызывая рвоту?
phrasebook.patient_response: Not really. Every time I drink a lot, I feel nauseous.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Unchalik emas. Ko'p suyuqlik ichsam, har safar ko'nglim ayniydi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Не совсем. Каждый раз, когда я много пью, меня тошнит.

phrasebook.phrase: Your blood pressure is low, and your pulse and breathing rate are elevated.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /jɔː blʌd ˈpreʃə ɪz ləʊ ænd jɔː pʌls ænd ˈbriːðɪŋ reɪt ɑːr ˈelɪveɪtɪd/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Qon bosimingiz past, puls va nafas olish tezligingiz yuqori.
phrasebook.translation_ru: У вас низкое давление, а пульс и частота дыхания повышены.
phrasebook.patient_response: What does that mean?
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Bu nimani anglatadi?
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Что это значит?

phrasebook.phrase: Your symptoms and test results are highly suggestive of diabetic ketoacidosis, or DKA.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /jɔː ˈsɪmptəmz ænd test rɪˈzʌlts ɑː haɪli səˈdʒestɪv əv ˌdaɪəbetɪk ˌkiːtəʊəˌsɪˈdəʊsɪs/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizdagi belgilar va tahlil natijalari diabetik ketoatsidoz, ya'ni DKAga kuchli shubha uyg'otmoqda.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Ваши симптомы и результаты анализов позволяют предположить диабетический кетоацидоз.
phrasebook.patient_response: Is it dangerous?
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Bu xavflimi?
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Это опасно?

phrasebook.phrase: DKA can become life-threatening if it isn't treated promptly.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ˌdiː keɪ ˈeɪ kən bɪˈkʌm ˈlaɪf ˌθretnɪŋ ɪf ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈtriːtɪd ˈprɒmptli/
phrasebook.translation_uz: DKA o'z vaqtida davolanmasa, hayot uchun xavfli bo'lib qolishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если ДКА своевременно не лечить, он может стать опасным для жизни.
phrasebook.patient_response: What are you going to do?
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Siz nima qilmoqchisiz?
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Что вы собираетесь делать?

phrasebook.phrase: We'll give you intravenous fluids, monitor your electrolytes and glucose closely, and administer insulin according to the DKA protocol.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Sizga vena orqali suyuqlik yuboramiz, elektrolitlar va glyukozani yaqindan kuzatamiz hamda DKA protokoliga muvofiq insulin yuboramiz.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Мы введём вам жидкости внутривенно, будем тщательно контролировать электролиты и глюкозу и введём инсулин согласно протоколу ДКА.
phrasebook.patient_response: Did missing my insulin cause this?
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Insulinni o'tkazib yuborganim bunga sabab bo'ldimi?
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Это произошло из-за того, что я пропускал инсулин?

phrasebook.phrase: It may have contributed significantly. Infection can also trigger DKA.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu sezilarli darajada sabab bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin. Infeksiya ham DKAni qo'zg'atishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это могло значительно способствовать развитию состояния. Инфекция также может спровоцировать ДКА.
phrasebook.patient_response: What should I do if this happens again?

phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Что мне делать, если это снова произойдёт?

phrasebook.phrase: If you're unable to eat or drink, you shouldn't simply stop your insulin without medical advice.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪf jɔːr ʌnˈeɪbəl tə iːt ɔː drɪŋk/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar ovqat yoki suyuqlik qabul qila olmasangiz, shifokor maslahatisiz insulinni shunchaki to'xtatmasligingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если вы не можете есть или пить, вам не следует просто прекращать инсулин без консультации врача.
phrasebook.patient_response: I understand.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Tushundim.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Я понимаю.

phrasebook.phrase: If you develop persistent vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, rapid breathing, or very high glucose levels, you should seek urgent medical attention.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar davomli qusish, kuchli holsizlik, qorin og'rig'i, tez nafas olish yoki glyukoza juda yuqori bo'lsa, shoshilinch tibbiy yordamga murojaat qilishingiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если у вас появятся постоянная рвота, сильная слабость, боль в животе, учащённое дыхание или очень высокий уровень глюкозы, вам следует срочно обратиться за медицинской помощью.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous — Actions That Started in the Past and Continue Now
grammar.structure_pattern: have / has + been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: since, for, lately, recently
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect Continuous o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan yoki hozirgi natijasi sezilayotgan jarayonni bildiradi. Bu dialogda bemor kechadan beri davom etayotgan simptomlarini tasvirlayapti. Signal so'zlar: since, for, lately, recently.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect Continuous описывает действие, которое началось в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента или имеет заметный результат сейчас. В диалоге пациент описывает симптомы, продолжающиеся с прошлого дня. since = qachondan beri / с какого момента for = qancha vaqt davomida / в течение какого времени Сигнальные слова: since, for, lately, recently.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Signal words: since, for, lately, recently.

grammar.title: Present Perfect — Recent Events with a Present Result
grammar.structure_pattern: have / has + V3
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Present Perfect o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, ammo hozirgi holat uchun muhim bo'lgan tajriba yoki natijani bildiradi. Aniq tugagan vaqt aytilmasa, Present Perfect ayniqsa tabiiy. Compare: I've vomited several times. → hozirgi holatga aloqador. Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Present Perfect используется для действий в прошлом, которые связаны с настоящим результатом. В медицинском интервью он часто используется для выяснения недавних симптомов и действий пациента. Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous vs Present Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: have / has + been + V-ing | have / has + V3 | Have/Has + subject + V3?
grammar.signal_words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Jarayonning davomiyligi yoki davom etishi muhim bo'lsa, Present Perfect Continuous; hodisa yoki natija muhim bo'lsa, Present Perfect. Signal so'zlar: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Если важна длительность или продолжающийся процесс, используем Present Perfect Continuous; если важен факт или результат, используем Present Perfect. Сигнальные слова: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect Continuous describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing (or has just stopped and its effect is visible). It is the key tense for symptom duration: "How long have you been feeling unwell?" — "I have been coughing for five days". Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". Signal words: since, for, how long, lately, recently, all day.

examples.note: Present Perfect Continuous — Continuous → davom etayotgan jarayon / Present Perfect → sodir bo'lgan hodisa yoki natija.

grammar.title: Past Continuous — An Action in Progress in the Past
grammar.structure_pattern: was / were + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: while, when, at that moment, all morning
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Continuous o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir paytda davom etayotgan jarayonni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Continuous показывает действие, которое находилось в процессе в определённый момент в прошлом. Сигнальные слова: while, when, at that moment, all morning.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Continuous describes an action in progress at a moment in the past, often interrupted by a Past Simple event: "I was carrying boxes when I suddenly felt chest pain". It gives the background of the onset. Signal words: while, when, at that moment, all morning.

grammar.title: Present Perfect with Since
grammar.structure_pattern: have/has + V3 + since + starting point | have/has been + V-ing + since + starting point
grammar.signal_words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: since harakat boshlangan vaqtni ko'rsatadi: yesterday, last night, Monday va hokazo. Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: since указывает на момент, с которого началось действие: yesterday, last night, Monday и т. д. Сигнальные слова: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Present Perfect links a past event to the present: an experience, a recent event or a result that matters now. In history taking it asks about symptoms and events up to now: "Have you had any fever?", "I have vomited three times". "Since" gives the starting point ("since yesterday"), "for" the length of time ("for three days") and "ago" counts back from now ("two hours ago"). Exact times ("at about 7:15 this morning") are essential in time-critical conditions such as stroke. Signal words: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for, recently, so far.

grammar.title: First Conditional — Real Clinical Possibility
grammar.structure_pattern: If + Present Simple → will / can / should + verb
grammar.signal_words: if, unless, as soon as, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: First Conditional real yoki ehtimoliy kelajakdagi vaziyat va uning natijasini ifodalaydi. Emergency medicine'da bemorga xavf yoki keyingi harakatni tushuntirishda juda foydali. Important: If-clause ichida odatda will ishlatilmaydi / После if обычно не используется will. Signal so'zlar: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: First Conditional используется для реальной или возможной ситуации в будущем и её результата. В экстренной медицине он особенно полезен для объяснения риска и необходимых действий. Сигнальные слова: if, unless, as soon as, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: First Conditional describes a real, possible future situation and its result. Clinicians use it for warnings, plans and safety-netting: "If the pain gets worse, you should come back immediately". Do not use "will" after "if". Present Simple describes habits, routines, general facts and permanent states. In the clinic it is used for typical symptoms ("The pain usually starts at night"), regular medication and general medical facts. Signal words: if, unless, as soon as, when.

grammar.title: Modal Verbs — Clinical Necessity, Possibility & Advice
grammar.structure_pattern: modal (can / could / may / might / must / should / have to) + V1
grammar.signal_words: possibility, advice, necessity, permission
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: can — imkoniyat/ehtimoliy oqibat; may — ehtimol; should — tavsiya; shouldn't — tavsiya yoki xavfsizlik nuqtayi nazaridan qilmaslik kerak. Signal so'zlar: possibility, advice, necessity, permission.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: can — возможность; may — вероятность; should — рекомендация; shouldn't — рекомендация не делать что-либо. Сигнальные слова: possibility, advice, necessity, permission.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Modal verbs add the speaker's attitude: possibility (may, might, could), ability/permission (can, could), advice (should, ought to), obligation (must, have to) and prohibition (mustn't). The main verb after a modal is always the base form. Signal words: possibility, advice, necessity, permission.

grammar.title: Future Arrangement — Immediate Plan — Be Going to
grammar.structure_pattern: am / is / are + going to + V1
grammar.signal_words: now, next, first, then
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: be going to oldindan rejalashtirilgan yoki hozirgi vaziyatga asoslangan kelajakdagi harakatni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: now, next, first, then.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: be going to используется для намерения или действия, которое планируется выполнить на основании текущей ситуации. Сигнальные слова: now, next, first, then.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: "Be going to" describes a plan or intention and something about to happen: "I am going to examine your abdomen now", "We are going to run some tests". Clinicians use it to announce each step of the examination. Signal words: now, next, first, then.

grammar.title: Passive Voice in Clinical Communication
grammar.structure_pattern: be (am/is/are/was/were/will be/has been) + V3 | modal + be + V3
grammar.signal_words: by, will be, has been, needs to be
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Passive Voice harakatni kim bajarayotganidan ko'ra, harakatning o'zi yoki bemor holati muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Signal so'zlar: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Passive Voice используется, когда важнее само действие или состояние пациента, а не тот, кто выполняет действие. Сигнальные слова: by, will be, has been, needs to be.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Passive Voice is used when the action or the patient matters more than who performs it — typical for tests, procedures and treatment plans: "Blood samples will be taken", "You will be referred to a specialist", "The wound has been cleaned". Signal words: by, will be, has been, needs to be.

practice.setting: emergency department / resuscitation bay

patient_profile.name: Emily Watson
patient_profile.personality_trait: distressed, worried, answers briefly because of discomfort

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I've been feeling extremely unwell since yesterday. I'm very thirsty, I've been urinating constantly, and I've vomited several times.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What brings you in today?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've been feeling extremely unwell since yesterday. I'm very thirsty, I've been urinating constantly, and I've vomited several times.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Do you have diabetes?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. Type 1 diabetes.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you been taking your insulin regularly?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No. I've missed several doses over the last two days.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Why did you stop taking it?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I was vomiting and couldn't eat properly, so I thought I shouldn't take insulin.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had any abdominal pain?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. My abdomen has been hurting since last night.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you noticed any changes in your breathing?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. My breathing has become deep and unusually fast.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had a fever or any signs of infection?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I've had a fever and a sore throat since yesterday.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you been able to keep fluids down?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Not really. Every time I drink a lot, I feel nauseous.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your blood pressure is low, and your pulse and breathing rate are elevated. Your blood glucose is 26 mmol/L, and your ketones are strongly positive.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What does that mean?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Your symptoms and test results are highly suggestive of diabetic ketoacidosis, or DKA.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Is it dangerous?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Yes. DKA can become life-threatening if it isn't treated promptly. We need to start treatment immediately.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What are you going to do?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: We'll give you intravenous fluids, monitor your electrolytes and glucose closely, and administer insulin according to the DKA protocol.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Did missing my insulin cause this?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: It may have contributed significantly. Infection can also trigger DKA.
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: What should I do if this happens again?

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: If you're unable to eat or drink, you shouldn't simply stop your insulin without medical advice. If you develop persistent vomiting, severe weakness, abdominal pain, rapid breathi…
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I understand.

Is it dangerous?
What are you going to do?
Did missing my insulin cause this?
What should I do if this happens again?

modules.description_en: Clinical communication module: Acute Seizures & Status Epilepticus. Grammar focus: Past Perfect + Past Perfect Continuous. Includes a reference doctor–patient dialogue, 39 vocabulary items, 18 smart phrases, 3 grammar points and a virtual patient simulation.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What happened immediately before you lost consciousness?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had been feeling strange for about ten minutes. I felt dizzy, and I had a strange sensation in my right hand. Then everything went blank.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you ever experienced anything similar before?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I was diagnosed with epilepsy three years ago, but I hadn't had a seizure for almost a year.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What anti-seizure medication are you taking?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I take levetiracetam, 500 milligrams twice a day.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: When did you last take it?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I took my morning dose as usual, but I missed my evening dose yesterday.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Why did you miss the dose?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had run out of tablets and hadn't been able to get a new prescription.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you missed any other doses recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No. I had been taking the medication regularly until yesterday.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Did anyone witness the seizure?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. My wife was with me.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: What did she see?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: She said I suddenly fell to the floor and became unresponsive. My whole body became stiff first, and then my arms and legs started jerking.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Do you know how long the seizure lasted?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: My wife said the jerking had continued for about three minutes before it stopped.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Did you regain consciousness immediately?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No. I had remained unresponsive for another couple of minutes. When I finally opened my eyes, I was very confused.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: How long did the confusion last?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had been confused for about twenty minutes before I started speaking normally again.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Did you bite your tongue or lose control of your bladder?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I had bitten the side of my tongue and apparently lost bladder control during the seizure.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Did you injure yourself when you fell?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I hit my head on the floor, and my shoulder has been painful since then.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you been sleeping normally recently?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No. I had been sleeping only four or five hours a night for almost a week.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you consumed alcohol or taken any recreational drugs or new medication?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I had drunk some alcohol the previous evening, but I hadn't taken any recreational drugs or new medication.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had another seizure since this episode?

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I haven't.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. The sequence of events is important. You had a warning sensation before losing consciousness, followed by generalized stiffening and jerking, and then a period of reduced responsiveness and confusion. The missed levetiracetam dose may have contributed to the seizure, but we also need to consider other possible triggers.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Does this mean my epilepsy is getting worse?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Not necessarily. We need to assess your current condition and identify any factors that may have triggered this episode.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: Could I have another seizure?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: It is possible. If a seizure lasts five minutes or longer, or if seizures occur repeatedly without full recovery between them, this may indicate status epilepticus and requires immediate emergency treatment.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: What should someone do if I have another seizure?

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: They should protect you from injury, move dangerous objects away, protect your head if possible, and time the seizure. They should not put anything in your mouth or try to restrain you.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: If the seizure lasts five minutes or more, or another seizure starts before you have fully recovered, emergency medical help should be called immediately.

dialogue.label: Patient
dialogue.text: I understand.

dialogue.label: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. We'll assess you further, review your medication, and arrange the appropriate investigations.

phrasebook.patient_response: I had been feeling strange for about ten minutes. I felt dizzy, and I had a strange sensation in my right hand.

phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæd juː ˈevə ɪkˈspɪəriənst ˈeniθɪŋ ˈsɪmɪlə bɪˈfɔː/

phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Ha. Menga uch yil oldin epilepsiya tashxisi qo'yilgan, lekin deyarli bir yil davomida xuruj bo'lmagan.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Да. Три года назад мне поставили диагноз эпилепсия, но почти год у меня не было приступов.

phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Я принимаю леветирацетам по 500 миллиграммов два раза в день.

phrasebook.phrase: When did you last take it?

phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Утреннюю дозу я принял как обычно, но вчера пропустил вечернюю дозу.

phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. My whole body became stiff first, and then my arms and legs started jerking.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Ha. Avval butun tanam qotib qoldi, keyin qo'l va oyoqlarim tirisha boshladi.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Да. Сначала всё тело напряглось, а затем руки и ноги начали судорожно дёргаться.

phrasebook.phrase: Do you know how long the seizure lasted?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /duː juː nəʊ haʊ lɒŋ ðə ˈsiːʒə lɑːstɪd/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы знаете, сколько длился приступ?
phrasebook.patient_response: My wife said the jerking had continued for about three minutes before it stopped.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Xotinimning aytishicha, tirishish taxminan uch daqiqa davom etib, keyin to'xtagan.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Моя жена сказала, что судорожные подёргивания продолжались около трёх минут, прежде чем прекратились.

phrasebook.phrase: Did you regain consciousness immediately?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы сразу пришли в сознание?
phrasebook.patient_response: No. I had remained unresponsive for another couple of minutes. When I finally opened my eyes, I was very confused.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Yo'q. Yana bir necha daqiqa javob bermay yotganman. Nihoyat ko'zimni ochganimda juda chalkash holatda edim.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Нет. Ещё несколько минут я оставался без реакции. Когда я наконец открыл глаза, я был очень спутан.

phrasebook.phrase: Did you bite your tongue or lose control of your bladder?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /dɪd juː baɪt jɔː tʌŋ ɔː luːz kənˈtrəʊl əv jɔː ˈblædə/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Tilingizni tishlab oldingizmi yoki siydik pufagingiz ustidan nazoratni yo'qotdingizmi?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы прикусили язык или потеряли контроль над мочеиспусканием?
phrasebook.patient_response: Yes. I had bitten the side of my tongue and apparently lost bladder control during the seizure.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Ha. Tilimning yon tomonini tishlab olgan ekanman va xuruj paytida shekilli, siydikni ushlab turolmaganman.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Да. Я прикусил боковую часть языка и, по-видимому, потерял контроль над мочеиспусканием во время приступа.

phrasebook.phrase: Did you injure yourself when you fell?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /dɪd juː ˈɪndʒə jɔːˈself wen juː fel/
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы получили травму при падении?
phrasebook.patient_response: I hit my head on the floor, and my shoulder has been painful since then.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Boshim polga urildi, shundan beri yelkam og'riyapti.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Я ударился головой об пол, и с тех пор у меня болит плечо.

phrasebook.phrase: Had you been sleeping normally recently?
phrasebook.translation_ru: В последнее время вы нормально спали?
phrasebook.patient_response: No. I had been sleeping only four or five hours a night for almost a week.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Yo'q. Deyarli bir hafta davomida kechasi atigi to'rt-besh soat uxlayotgan edim.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Нет. Почти неделю я спал всего по четыре-пять часов в сутки.

phrasebook.phrase: Had you consumed alcohol before the seizure?
phrasebook.pronunciation: /hæd juː kənˈsjuːmd ˈælkəhɒl bɪˈfɔː ðə ˈsiːʒə/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Xurujdan oldin spirtli ichimlik iste'mol qilganmidingiz?
phrasebook.translation_ru: Вы употребляли алкоголь перед приступом?
phrasebook.patient_response: I had drunk some alcohol the previous evening, but I hadn't taken any recreational drugs or new medication.
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Avvalgi kechqurun biroz spirtli ichimlik ichgan edim, lekin giyohvand moddalar yoki yangi dori qabul qilmaganman.
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: Я выпил немного алкоголя накануне вечером, но не принимал наркотические вещества или новые лекарства.

phrasebook.phrase: The sequence of events is important. You had a warning sensation before losing consciousness, followed by generalized stiffening and jerking, and then a period of reduced responsiveness and confusion.
phrasebook.translation_uz: Voqealarning ketma-ketligi muhim. Hushingizni yo'qotishdan oldin ogohlantiruvchi sezgi bo'lgan, keyin butun tanada qotish va tirishish, undan so'ng esa javob berishning pasayishi va chalkashlik kuzatilgan.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Важна последовательность событий. Перед потерей сознания было предвестниковое ощущение, затем генерализованное напряжение и судорожные подёргивания, после чего наблюдались снижение реакции и спутанность сознания.

phrasebook.phrase: The missed levetiracetam dose may have contributed to the seizure, but we also need to consider other possible triggers.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðə mɪst ˌlevɪtɪˈræsɪtæm dəʊs meɪ hæv kənˈtrɪbjuːtɪd/
phrasebook.translation_uz: O'tkazib yuborilgan levetirasetam dozasi xurujga sabab bo'lgan omillardan biri bo'lishi mumkin, ammo boshqa ehtimoliy qo'zg'atuvchi omillarni ham hisobga olishimiz kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Пропущенная доза леветирацетама могла способствовать возникновению приступа, но нам также необходимо учитывать другие возможные провоцирующие факторы.
phrasebook.patient_response: Could I have another seizure?
phrasebook.patient_response_uz: Yana xuruj bo'lishi mumkinmi?
phrasebook.patient_response_ru: У меня может случиться ещё один приступ?

phrasebook.phrase: It is possible. However, if a seizure lasts five minutes or longer, or if seizures occur repeatedly without full recovery between them, this may indicate status epilepticus and requires immediate emergency treatment.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪt ɪz ˈpɒsəbəl haʊˈevə ɪf ə ˈsiːʒə lɑːsts faɪv ˈmɪnɪts/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Bu mumkin. Ammo xuruj besh daqiqa yoki undan ko'proq davom etsa yoki xurujlar bemor ular orasida to'liq o'ziga kelmasdan takrorlansa, bu status epilepticusdan dalolat berishi va zudlik bilan shoshilinch davolashni talab qilishi mumkin.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Это возможно. Однако если приступ длится пять минут или дольше или приступы повторяются без полного восстановления между ними, это может указывать на эпилептический статус и требует немедленного неотложного лечения.

phrasebook.phrase: They should not put anything in your mouth or try to restrain you.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ðeɪ ʃʊd nɒt pʊt ˈeniθɪŋ ɪn jɔː maʊθ/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Ular og'zingizga hech narsa solmasliklari yoki sizni majburan ushlab turishga urinmasliklari kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Они не должны ничего класть вам в рот или пытаться удерживать вас силой.

phrasebook.phrase: If the seizure lasts five minutes or more, or another seizure starts before you have fully recovered, emergency medical help should be called immediately.
phrasebook.pronunciation: /ɪf ðə ˈsiːʒə lɑːsts faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ɔː mɔː/
phrasebook.translation_uz: Agar xuruj besh daqiqa yoki undan ko'proq davom etsa yoki siz to'liq o'zingizga kelmasdan yana xuruj boshlansa, darhol shoshilinch tibbiy yordam chaqirilishi kerak.
phrasebook.translation_ru: Если приступ длится пять минут или дольше или новый приступ начинается до полного восстановления, необходимо немедленно вызвать скорую помощь.

grammar.title: Past Perfect
grammar.structure_pattern: had + V3 (Past Participle) | had been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Perfect bir o'tmishdagi voqea boshqa o'tmishdagi voqeadan OLDIN sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatadi. Bir voqea boshqa o'tmishdagi voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lganini bildiradi. Seizure historyda Past Perfect shifokorga voqealarning qaysi biri avval sodir bo'lganini aniq ko'rsatishga yordam beradi. 3. Past Perfect Continuous — O'tmishda ma'lum vaqt davom etib kelgan jarayon Past Perfect Continuous o'tmishdagi boshqa bir voqea sodir bo'lishidan OLDIN ma'lum vaqt davomida davom etgan harakat yoki holatni bildiradi. O'tmishda boshqa bir voqeadan oldin ma'lum vaqt davomida davom etib kelgan jarayonni bildiradi. Signal so'zlar: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Perfect показывает, что одно действие произошло раньше другого действия в прошлом. При сборе анамнеза при судорогах Past Perfect помогает чётко установить последовательность событий в прошлом. Past Perfect Continuous показывает действие, которое продолжалось в течение определённого времени до другого момента в прошлом. Сигнальные слова: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Perfect shows that one past action happened before another past action: "I had eaten a large meal before the pain started". It orders events in the clinical timeline. Present participles (-ing) describe an active process ("a spreading infection", "the patient lying in bed"); past participles (V3) describe a state or result ("an infected wound", "samples taken immediately"). They shorten relative clauses. Signal words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.

grammar.title: Negative Form
grammar.structure_pattern: Past Perfect: had not (hadn't) + V3 | Past Perfect Continuous: had not (hadn't) been + V-ing
grammar.signal_words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Past Perfect o'tmishdagi bir harakat boshqa o'tmishdagi harakatdan oldin bo'lganini ko'rsatadi: "I had eaten a large meal before the pain started". Klinik voqealar ketma-ketligini aniqlashda ishlatiladi. Past Perfect Continuous o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin bir muddat davom etgan harakatni bildiradi: "I had been feeling dizzy for ten minutes before I collapsed". Asosiy voqeadan oldingi davomiylikni ta'kidlaydi. Signal so'zlar: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: Past Perfect показывает, что одно действие в прошлом произошло раньше другого: «I had eaten a large meal before the pain started». Упорядочивает события в клинической хронологии. Past Perfect Continuous описывает действие, которое длилось некоторое время до другого события в прошлом: «I had been feeling dizzy for ten minutes before I collapsed». Подчёркивает длительность до ключевого события. Сигнальные слова: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Past Perfect shows that one past action happened before another past action: "I had eaten a large meal before the pain started". It orders events in the clinical timeline. Past Perfect Continuous describes an action that had been going on for some time before another past event: "I had been feeling dizzy for ten minutes before I collapsed". It stresses duration before the key event. Signal words: before, after, by the time, already, until, when.

grammar.title: Question Forms in Clinical History-Taking
grammar.structure_pattern: Auxiliary (do/does/did/have/is/are/can) + subject + V? | Wh-word + auxiliary + subject + V?
grammar.signal_words: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: 8. Clinical Meaning — Nega bu grammatika muhim? Emergency medicine va seizure historyda vaqt ketma-ketligini aniq ifodalash juda muhim. Past Perfect bemorga nima avval sodir bo'lganini tushuntirishga yordam beradi; Past Perfect Continuous esa simptom yoki risk factor qancha vaqt davom etganini ko'rsatadi. Shifokor uchun "nima bo'ldi?" bilan birga "undan oldin nima bo'lgan?" va "qancha vaqt davom etgan?" degan savollar ham muhim. Signal so'zlar: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: В экстренной медицине важно знать не только, что произошло, но и что произошло до этого и как долго продолжалось состояние. Сигнальные слова: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: 7. Time Expressions Commonly Used with These Tenses 5. Describe the sequence: warning sensation → loss of consciousness → stiffening → jerking → reduced responsiveness → confusion. Clinical pattern: BEFORE → identify the earlier event → describe duration → explain the sequence → assess possible triggers. Signal words: what, when, where, how long, how often, do you, have you.

patient_profile.name: Laura Bennett
patient_profile.personality_trait: distressed, worried, answers briefly because of discomfort

medical_condition.chief_complaint: I had been feeling strange for about ten minutes. I felt dizzy, and I had a strange sensation in my right hand. Then everything went blank.
doctor_explanations_from_reference_dialo: It is possible. If a seizure lasts five minutes or longer, or if seizures occur repeatedly without full recovery between them, this may indicate status epilepticus and requires immediate emergency treatment.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What happened immediately before you lost consciousness?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had been feeling strange for about ten minutes. I felt dizzy, and I had a strange sensation in my right hand. Then everything went blank.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you ever experienced anything similar before?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I was diagnosed with epilepsy three years ago, but I hadn't had a seizure for almost a year.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What anti-seizure medication are you taking?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I take levetiracetam, 500 milligrams twice a day.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: When did you last take it?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I took my morning dose as usual, but I missed my evening dose yesterday.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Why did you miss the dose?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had run out of tablets and hadn't been able to get a new prescription.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you missed any other doses recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No. I had been taking the medication regularly until yesterday.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did anyone witness the seizure?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. My wife was with me.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: What did she see?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: She said I suddenly fell to the floor and became unresponsive. My whole body became stiff first, and then my arms and legs started jerking.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Do you know how long the seizure lasted?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: My wife said the jerking had continued for about three minutes before it stopped.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you regain consciousness immediately?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No. I had remained unresponsive for another couple of minutes. When I finally opened my eyes, I was very confused.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: How long did the confusion last?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had been confused for about twenty minutes before I started speaking normally again.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you bite your tongue or lose control of your bladder?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: Yes. I had bitten the side of my tongue and apparently lost bladder control during the seizure.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Did you injure yourself when you fell?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I hit my head on the floor, and my shoulder has been painful since then.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you been sleeping normally recently?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No. I had been sleeping only four or five hours a night for almost a week.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Had you consumed alcohol or taken any recreational drugs or new medication?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: I had drunk some alcohol the previous evening, but I hadn't taken any recreational drugs or new medication.

expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.doctor_question_topic: Have you had another seizure since this episode?
expected_doctor_questions_and_answers.patient_answer: No, I haven't.
